6161e5822a38.text: 可选填以 BTC 为单位的金额（小数点用句点）、标签（例如你的名字）和留言。

5134e2605b8d.source: Scan the preview with a wallet and check that the address matches exactly.
5134e2605b8d.text: 用钱包扫描预览，并核对地址是否完全一致。

f88a38b8f2b6.source: Defined by BIP21. The amount is in BTC as a decimal number with a period, never with commas or in satoshis.
f88a38b8f2b6.text: 由 BIP21 定义。金额以 BTC 为单位，用带句点的小数表示，不能使用逗号，也不能以聪为单位。

953cab408ae1.source: label (who is being paid) and message (what for) are percent-encoded.
953cab408ae1.text: label（收款方）和 message（用途）采用百分号编码。

5ccc343ba6be.source: Legacy (1...), P2SH (3...) and SegWit or Taproot (bc1...) addresses all work. QRdx accepts addresses of 26 to 62 characters.
5ccc343ba6be.text: Legacy（1...）、P2SH（3...）以及 SegWit 或 Taproot（bc1...）地址均可使用。QRdx 接受 26 到 62 个字符的地址。

0da1324a4996.source: Is it safe to share my Bitcoin QR code?
0da1324a4996.text: 分享我的比特币二维码安全吗？

a7dd06aa79da.source: Yes. It contains your receiving address, which is meant to be shared. Never put a private key or seed phrase in a QR code.
a7dd06aa79da.text: 安全。二维码中包含的是你的收款地址，本来就是用来分享的。切勿把私钥或助记词放进二维码。

02304de58fdc.source: Most Bitcoin wallets read bitcoin: URIs. Support for the optional label and message varies between wallets.
02304de58fdc.text: 大多数比特币钱包都能读取 bitcoin: URI。可选的标签和留言，各钱包的支持情况不尽相同。

d3a25ac89d66.source: Can I request an amount in dollars?
d3a25ac89d66.text: 可以按美元金额收款吗？

dee9c92e552a.source: No. BIP21 amounts are always in BTC. Convert at the current rate, or leave the amount empty so the sender enters it.
dee9c92e552a.text: 不可以。BIP21 的金额始终以 BTC 为单位。请按当前汇率换算，或者留空金额，由付款方自行输入。

80cfbcc768ef.source: Share an EIP-681 Ethereum payment request.
80cfbcc768ef.text: 分享 EIP-681 以太坊收款请求。

7f57cac75ab7.source: Make an Ethereum QR code in the EIP-681 ethereum: format with an optional ETH amount (in wei) and gas limit. Free PNG and SVG, no signup.
7f57cac75ab7.text: 按 EIP-681 ethereum: 格式生成以太坊二维码，可选填 ETH 金额（以 wei 为单位）和 gas 上限。免费提供 PNG 和 SVG，无需注册。

e6df241fc5d0.source: An Ethereum QR code holds your wallet address in the EIP-681 ethereum: format, optionally with an amount of ETH and a gas limit. Scanning it with a compatible wallet opens a transfer to your address with those values filled in.
e6df241fc5d0.text: 以太坊二维码以 EIP-681 ethereum: 格式保存你的钱包地址，还可以附带 ETH 金额和 gas 上限。用兼容的钱包扫描后，会打开向你的地址转账的页面，并自动填好这些数值。

4cd43eafd110.source: Ethereum addresses are 42-character hexadecimal strings that are easy to mistype, which makes a QR code the safest way to share one at events, on invoices or on donation pages. The code contains only your public address; private keys and recovery phrases must never go into a QR code.
4cd43eafd110.text: 以太坊地址是 42 个字符的十六进制字符串，很容易输错，所以在活动现场、发票或捐赠页面上，二维码是分享地址最稳妥的方式。二维码中只包含你的公开地址；私钥和助记词绝不能放进二维码。

b2a3ae1b9d75.source: Copy your address (starting with 0x) from your wallet and paste it in.
b2a3ae1b9d75.text: 从钱包中复制你的地址（以 0x 开头），粘贴到这里。

4f1b1c80f3e8.source: Optionally enter an amount in ETH and a gas limit.
4f1b1c80f3e8.text: 可选填 ETH 金额和 gas 上限。

c54d35521f5a.source: Scan the preview with your wallet and check the address and amount.
c54d35521f5a.text: 用你的钱包扫描预览，并核对地址和金额。

155c506bf183.source: EIP-681 amounts (value) are in wei, the smallest unit: 1 ETH is 10^18 wei. This page converts the ETH amount you type by adding the e18 exponent, so 0.05 ETH is written as value=0.05e18.
155c506bf183.text: EIP-681 中的金额（value）以最小单位 wei 计：1 ETH 等于 10^18 wei。本页会在你输入的 ETH 金额后加上指数 e18 进行换算，因此 0.05 ETH 会写成 value=0.05e18。

e090a66eb3e0.source: gas is a synonym for gasLimit, a suggested limit the payer can edit. A plain ETH transfer uses 21000.
e090a66eb3e0.text: gas 是 gasLimit 的同义写法，表示建议的上限，付款方可以修改。普通的 ETH 转账使用 21000。

6134aa693235.source: EIP-681 can name a network with @chainId (for example @137), but this generator doesn't add one, so wallets use their current network.
6134aa693235.text: EIP-681 可以用 @chainId 指定网络（例如 @137），但本生成器不会添加，因此钱包会使用其当前所在的网络。

4a68f3f75c81.source: Wallet support for EIP-681 parameters varies; test with the wallet your payers use.
4a68f3f75c81.text: 各钱包对 EIP-681 参数的支持程度不一，请用付款方使用的钱包测试。

644fd366eca2.source: Can I request USDC or another token?
644fd366eca2.text: 可以请求 USDC 或其他代币吗？

2047498516c6.source: This generator creates native ETH transfers. Token requests need the token contract and a transfer function call in the URI, which this form doesn't build.
2047498516c6.text: 本生成器生成的是原生 ETH 转账。代币请求需要在 URI 中包含代币合约和 transfer 函数调用，而这个表单不会生成这些内容。

a921a84b6c82.source: Does it work on other EVM networks?
a921a84b6c82.text: 适用于其他 EVM 网络吗？

302941b105ef.source: The address format is the same on networks like Polygon or Arbitrum, but no chain ID is added, so the payer must pick the right network in their wallet.
302941b105ef.text: 在 Polygon 或 Arbitrum 等网络上，地址格式是相同的，但不会添加链 ID，因此付款方必须在钱包中选择正确的网络。

fb7cc9e20af8.source: Yes. The code contains your public address only. Never encode a private key or recovery phrase.
fb7cc9e20af8.text: 安全。二维码中只包含你的公开地址。切勿将私钥或助记词编码进去。

9870d299fb0b.source: Open your Etsy shop or a listing.
9870d299fb0b.text: 打开你的 Etsy 店铺或某个商品链接。

59b8c7fa8b99.source: Create an Etsy QR code for your shop or a listing. Add it to packaging inserts, thank-you cards and craft fairs. Free PNG and SVG download.
59b8c7fa8b99.text: 为你的店铺或商品创建 Etsy 二维码。可用于包裹内页、感谢卡和手工市集。免费下载 PNG 和 SVG。

ac05c09f0984.source: An Etsy QR code sends customers to your Etsy shop or a specific listing. Sellers add it to packaging inserts, thank-you cards, craft-fair booths and business cards to turn one-off buyers into repeat customers. An insert is one of the few places you reach a buyer after the sale, and a code turns the follow-up into one scan instead of a search.
ac05c09f0984.text: Etsy 二维码可以把顾客带到你的 Etsy 店铺或某个指定商品页面。卖家会把它印在包裹内页、感谢卡、手工市集摊位和名片上，让一次性买家变成回头客。内页是买家下单之后你为数不多还能触达对方的地方，有了二维码，回访只需扫描一次，不必再去搜索。

68337999fe9a.source: Paste your shop URL (etsy.com/shop/YourShopName) or any listing URL. The link opens in the Etsy app when installed, or on etsy.com otherwise.
68337999fe9a.text: 粘贴你的店铺网址（etsy.com/shop/YourShopName）或任意商品网址。已安装 Etsy 应用时，链接会在应用中打开，否则会在 etsy.com 上打开。

9b2cfeeb09fa.source: Open your shop or listing on Etsy and copy the URL.
9b2cfeeb09fa.text: 在 Etsy 上打开你的店铺或商品，复制网址。

3ed6497c0b4c.source: Remove tracking parameters such as ?ref=... from the end of the link.
3ed6497c0b4c.text: 删除链接末尾的 ?ref=... 等跟踪参数。

8d368199345a.source: Paste it and scan the preview to check the right page opens.
8d368199345a.text: 粘贴链接，然后扫描预览，确认打开的是正确的页面。

af738faf97d4.source: Download an SVG for printed inserts or a PNG for digital use.
af738faf97d4.text: 印刷内页请下载 SVG，数字用途请下载 PNG。

b2e8c12bc034.source: QRdx encodes the link exactly as pasted after checking it is a valid URL.
b2e8c12bc034.text: QRdx 会在确认链接是有效网址后，按你粘贴的内容原样编码。

09082268f50d.source: Linking the shop rather than a single listing keeps the code useful after an item sells out.
09082268f50d.text: 链接到店铺而不是单个商品，即使商品售罄，二维码依然有用。

1a16d2d99724.source: Shorter links without tracking parameters make simpler codes that print well on small inserts.
1a16d2d99724.text: 不带跟踪参数的短链接生成的二维码更简单，印在小尺寸内页上效果更好。

7f0e441b27ed.source: Shop URLs follow etsy.com/shop/ShopName; listing URLs contain /listing/ followed by a numeric ID.
7f0e441b27ed.text: 店铺网址格式为 etsy.com/shop/ShopName；商品网址包含 /listing/，后面跟一串数字 ID。

019df7862471.source: Shop or listing: which should I link?
019df7862471.text: 该链接到店铺还是商品？

c8a6191002d7.source: Link the shop on inserts and business cards. Link a listing for product-specific material, such as a refill or matching item.
c8a6191002d7.text: 内页和名片上建议链接到店铺。针对特定商品的材料，例如补充装或配套商品，则链接到该商品。

fe87a284be22.source: Will it open the Etsy app?
fe87a284be22.text: 会打开 Etsy 应用吗？

2bcd4f0f8577.source: When the Etsy app is installed, links usually open in it; otherwise they open on etsy.com.
2bcd4f0f8577.text: 已安装 Etsy 应用时，链接通常会在应用中打开，否则会在 etsy.com 上打开。

b881031f5e69.source: What if I rename my shop?
b881031f5e69.text: 如果我给店铺改名怎么办？

f62e4897f655.source: The shop name is part of the URL, so test-scan the code after a rename and generate a new one if needed.
f62e4897f655.text: 店铺名称是网址的一部分，所以改名后请扫描测试二维码，必要时重新生成一个。

38e2a9073ea3.source: Encode a Dub short link you can edit later.
38e2a9073ea3.text: 编码一个之后可以修改的 Dub 短链接。

6ed4eb02bbcc.source: Create a QR code for a Dub short link, so you can change the destination and see click analytics in Dub without reprinting. Free.
6ed4eb02bbcc.text: 为 Dub 短链接创建二维码，无需重新印刷即可更改目标地址，并在 Dub 中查看点击分析。免费。

8f6a7cf3f79a.source: A Dub QR code encodes a short link you created with Dub, on dub.sh or your own branded domain. Because the code contains the short link rather than the final page, you can change the destination in Dub later and see click analytics there; the printed code stays the same. That suits printed material with a long life, like packaging and signage.
8f6a7cf3f79a.text: Dub 二维码编码的是你用 Dub 创建的短链接，可以是 dub.sh 上的，也可以是你自己的品牌域名。由于二维码中包含的是短链接而不是最终页面，你之后可以在 Dub 中更改目标地址，并在那里查看点击分析，而已印刷的二维码保持不变。这很适合包装和标牌这类使用寿命长的印刷品。

bf9bba6bbab6.source: On this page, paste an existing Dub short link. In the full QRdx editor you can also connect your Dub account to pick from your links or create a new one without leaving QRdx.
bf9bba6bbab6.text: 在本页面中，粘贴一个现有的 Dub 短链接即可。在完整的 QRdx 编辑器中，你还可以连接 Dub 账号，从你的链接中选择，或者无需离开 QRdx 就新建一个链接。

52728fa36584.source: Create a short link in Dub, or copy one you already have.
52728fa36584.text: 在 Dub 中创建一个短链接，或复制你已有的短链接。

de29e396c7c6.source: Paste it into the field, including https://.
de29e396c7c6.text: 将它粘贴到输入框中，包括 https://。

246ff2ca176f.source: Scan the preview to check that it redirects to your destination.
246ff2ca176f.text: 扫描预览图，检查是否会跳转到你的目标地址。

77ffd3fdd3c3.source: QRdx encodes the short link as entered; redirects and analytics are handled by Dub.
77ffd3fdd3c3.text: QRdx 会按输入的内容原样编码短链接；跳转和分析由 Dub 负责处理。

0ba40493a06e.source: Short links make low-density codes that scan easily even when printed small.
0ba40493a06e.text: 短链接生成的二维码密度低，即使印得很小也容易扫描。

afa697ba3704.source: Dub itself can also generate QR codes; use QRdx when you want custom colors, patterns, a logo or SVG output for the same link.
afa697ba3704.text: Dub 本身也可以生成二维码；如果你想为同一个链接使用自定义颜色、图案、徽标或 SVG 输出，请使用 QRdx。

b1c7db36690d.source: Do I need a Dub account?
b1c7db36690d.text: 我需要 Dub 账号吗？

1dd93ae42814.source: Yes, to create short links. Encoding an existing link here doesn't require connecting it.
1dd93ae42814.text: 需要，创建短链接时要有账号。在这里编码已有的链接则无需连接账号。

72c77ce9af6d.source: Can I change where the code goes after printing?
72c77ce9af6d.text: 印刷后还能更改二维码的跳转地址吗？

e14afac1af24.source: Yes. Edit the short link's destination in Dub and the printed code follows it.
e14afac1af24.text: 可以。在 Dub 中编辑短链接的目标地址，已印刷的二维码就会随之跳转到新地址。

efeae2f021b9.source: Where do I see scan statistics?

39434f94ac7d.source: In your Dub dashboard, which counts clicks on the short link, including those from scans.
39434f94ac7d.text: 在你的 Dub 控制台中，它会统计短链接的点击次数，其中包括来自扫描的点击。

44adb3119512.source: Can I use my own domain?
44adb3119512.text: 可以使用我自己的域名吗？

82aa6d5e9e36.source: Yes. If your Dub workspace has a custom domain, paste the short link on that domain; it works the same way.
82aa6d5e9e36.text: 可以。如果你的 Dub 工作区设置了自定义域名，粘贴该域名下的短链接即可，使用方式相同。

591b9ce48553.source: Open a Drive file, folder, Doc or Sheet.
591b9ce48553.text: 打开 Drive 中的文件、文件夹、文档或表格。

779cbb095032.source: Make a Google Drive QR code for a file, folder, Doc, Sheet or Slides deck. Update the file without reprinting the code. Free PNG and SVG.
779cbb095032.text: 为 Google Drive 的文件、文件夹、文档、表格或幻灯片制作二维码。更新文件无需重新印刷二维码。免费提供 PNG 和 SVG。

106ce0610cfb.source: A Google Drive QR code opens a file or folder from Google Drive: a PDF menu, a price list, a photo album, course materials, or a shared folder for event photos.
106ce0610cfb.text: Google Drive 二维码可以打开 Google Drive 中的文件或文件夹，例如 PDF 菜单、价目表、相册、课程资料，或用于存放活动照片的共享文件夹。

cec413db22c0.source: Paste a Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drawings link. Before printing, set sharing to 'Anyone with the link', otherwise people who scan it will see a request-access screen. In the full editor you can also connect Google Drive and pick a file from your account.
cec413db22c0.text: 粘贴 Drive、Docs、Sheets、Slides 或 Drawings 的链接。打印前，请将共享权限设为“知道链接的任何人”，否则扫描二维码的人会看到申请访问权限的页面。在完整编辑器中，你也可以连接 Google Drive，并从你的账号中选择文件。

822ee7ff47da.source: In Google Drive, open Share, set General access to 'Anyone with the link' and copy the link.
822ee7ff47da.text: 在 Google Drive 中打开“共享”，将“常规访问权限”设为“知道链接的任何人”，然后复制链接。

e054dd4b822a.source: Scan the preview on a phone that isn't signed in to your account to check access.
e054dd4b822a.text: 用一部未登录你账号的手机扫描预览，检查访问权限是否正常。

647a6de96b4a.source: QRdx accepts drive.google.com links and Docs, Sheets, Slides and Drawings links from docs.google.com.
647a6de96b4a.text: QRdx 支持 drive.google.com 的链接，以及 docs.google.com 的 Docs、Sheets、Slides 和 Drawings 链接。

593b07cfe7d9.source: The link stays the same when you edit the file, so you can update a menu or schedule without reprinting, as long as you edit the same file.
593b07cfe7d9.text: 编辑文件时链接不会改变，所以只要编辑的是同一个文件，就可以更新菜单或日程，无需重新印刷。

39df6b75c0bf.source: Uploading a replacement file creates a new link. For PDFs and images, use Manage versions in Drive to keep the existing link.
39df6b75c0bf.text: 上传替换文件会生成新的链接。对于 PDF 和图片，请在 Drive 中使用“管理版本”来保留原有链接。

d9b77a97ffd3.source: Why do people see 'You need access'?
d9b77a97ffd3.text: 为什么有人会看到“你需要访问权限”？

900e6a540c27.source: The file isn't shared publicly. Set General access to 'Anyone with the link' in the Share dialog.
900e6a540c27.text: 该文件没有公开共享。请在“共享”对话框中将“常规访问权限”设为“知道链接的任何人”。

06abe9575d50.source: Can I update the file without a new code?
06abe9575d50.text: 不换二维码也能更新文件吗？

4df2b38ea950.source: Yes. Edit the same file, or upload a new version with Manage versions, and the link keeps working.
4df2b38ea950.text: 可以。编辑同一个文件，或通过“管理版本”上传新版本，链接都会继续有效。

6bb4a809f2ff.source: Does QRdx access my Google Drive?
6bb4a809f2ff.text: QRdx 会访问我的 Google Drive 吗？

81521453a022.source: Not on this page; pasting a link doesn't connect anything. Only if you connect Google Drive in the full editor can QRdx list files for you to pick.
81521453a022.text: 在此页面不会；粘贴链接不会连接任何内容。只有在完整编辑器中连接 Google Drive 后，QRdx 才能列出文件供你选择。

565e389b904b.source: Check people in with a Google Form.
565e389b904b.text: 用 Google Form 让大家签到。

d7799f7395c6.source: Create an attendance QR code that opens a Google Form check-in. Responses are timestamped in Google Sheets. For classes, trainings and events.
d7799f7395c6.text: 创建考勤二维码，扫描后打开 Google Form 签到表单。回复会带时间戳记录在 Google Sheets 中。适用于课堂、培训和活动。

5a876b182ed9.source: An attendance QR code opens a Google Form where people check in: students in a lecture, staff at a training session, volunteers at an event. Instead of passing a sign-in sheet around, attendees scan the code on the projector or the door and submit their name in seconds.
5a876b182ed9.text: 考勤二维码会打开一个 Google Form 表单，供人们签到：课堂上的学生、培训现场的员工、活动中的志愿者都可以使用。无需再传递签到表，参与者只要扫描投影屏幕或门口的二维码，几秒钟内就能提交姓名。

36fb024c7ca1.source: Google Forms stores each response with a timestamp and can send them to a Google Sheet, so you get an attendance log without retyping anything. Create the form in Google Forms first, then paste its link here.
36fb024c7ca1.text: Google Forms 会为每条回复记录时间戳，还能把回复发送到 Google Sheet，这样无需重新录入，就能得到一份考勤记录。请先在 Google Forms 中创建表单，再把链接粘贴到这里。

b198550b05ae.source: Create a Google Form with the fields you need, such as name and ID number.
b198550b05ae.text: 创建一个 Google Form，添加你需要的字段，例如姓名和编号。

42306e4942ec.source: Click Send, choose the link tab and copy the link (shortened forms.gle links work too).
42306e4942ec.text: 点击“发送”，选择链接标签页并复制链接（缩短后的 forms.gle 链接同样可用）。

e3cc486384b0.source: Paste it here and scan the preview to submit a test response.
e3cc486384b0.text: 把链接粘贴到这里，扫描预览中的二维码，提交一条测试回复。

e8ce1759f6cf.source: Download the code and show it on screen or print it at the entrance.
e8ce1759f6cf.text: 下载二维码，在屏幕上展示，或打印后贴在入口处。

ecf67f6aa52f.source: QRdx accepts docs.google.com/forms and forms.gle links.
ecf67f6aa52f.text: QRdx 支持 docs.google.com/forms 和 forms.gle 链接。

dab5c853785b.source: Google Forms timestamps every response. In the form settings you can collect email addresses or limit each person to one response, which requires respondents to sign in to Google.
dab5c853785b.text: Google Forms 会为每条回复记录时间戳。在表单设置中，你可以收集电子邮件地址，或限制每人只能回复一次，但这需要回复者登录 Google 账号。

106658426af4.source: A static code can be photographed and shared, so people could check in remotely. Close the form after each session if that matters.
106658426af4.text: 静态二维码可以被拍照和转发，因此有人可能远程签到。如果这一点很重要，请在每场活动结束后关闭表单。

126505fa4754.source: How do I stop duplicate check-ins?

bcbc34362fcb.source: Turn on 'Limit to 1 response' in the form's settings. Respondents then need to sign in with a Google account.
bcbc34362fcb.text: 在表单设置中开启“限制为 1 个回复”。这样回复者需要登录 Google 账号。

90fdf1385ec1.source: Where do I see who attended?

cda29dc46bf8.source: In the form's Responses tab, or in a linked Google Sheet with one row per check-in.
cda29dc46bf8.text: 在表单的“回复”标签页中查看，或在关联的 Google Sheet 中查看，每次签到对应一行。

edc2547b7484.source: Can I use one code for every session?
edc2547b7484.text: 每场活动可以使用同一个二维码吗？

60b994f33eb1.source: Yes, if you keep the same form. Use the timestamps or add a date question, and switch off 'Accepting responses' between sessions.
60b994f33eb1.text: 可以，只要继续使用同一个表单。你可以通过时间戳区分场次，或添加一个日期问题，并在两场活动之间关闭“接受回复”。

297b1a57d8ed.source: Open an Amazon product or store page.
297b1a57d8ed.text: 打开 Amazon 商品页或店铺页面。

27d5eee69430.source: Create an Amazon QR code for a product, brand store or book page on any Amazon marketplace. For packaging, inserts and posters. Free.
27d5eee69430.text: 为任意 Amazon 站点的商品、品牌店铺或图书页面创建 Amazon 二维码，适用于包装、内页卡和海报。免费。

20fd0805a765.source: An Amazon QR code links to a product, a brand store or an author page. Sellers put it on packaging and inserts so customers can reorder or find accessories, and authors put it on bookmarks and posters to link their book.
20fd0805a765.text: Amazon 二维码可链接到商品、品牌店铺或作者页面。卖家把它印在包装和内页卡上，方便顾客复购或查找配件；作者则把它印在书签和海报上，链接到自己的图书。

a4c56d12538f.source: Paste a link from any Amazon marketplace, such as amazon.com, amazon.co.uk, amazon.in or amazon.de. It opens in the Amazon app when installed, or in the browser otherwise.
a4c56d12538f.text: 粘贴任意 Amazon 站点的链接，例如 amazon.com、amazon.co.uk、amazon.in 或 amazon.de。已安装 Amazon 应用时会在应用中打开，否则在浏览器中打开。

fd723bb3fdab.source: Open the product or store page on Amazon and copy the URL.
fd723bb3fdab.text: 在 Amazon 上打开商品页或店铺页面，复制网址。

d5298e166da3.source: Shorten product links to amazon.com/dp/ followed by the 10-character product ID (ASIN).
d5298e166da3.text: 将商品链接缩短为 amazon.com/dp/ 加上 10 位字符的商品编号（ASIN）。

54922c06a041.source: Paste the link and scan the preview to check the right page opens.
54922c06a041.text: 粘贴链接，并扫描预览中的二维码，确认打开的是正确的页面。

1e0742dd6197.source: QRdx checks that the link is an Amazon URL and encodes it as pasted.
1e0742dd6197.text: QRdx 会检查链接是否为 Amazon 网址，并按粘贴的内容原样编码。

6115f229661d.source: The short /dp/ASIN form drops tracking parameters and makes a simpler code that prints well on small packaging.
6115f229661d.text: 简短的 /dp/ASIN 形式会去掉跟踪参数，生成更简单的二维码，在小型包装上也能清晰印刷。

fc12d89a2b0e.source: ASINs are 10 characters long. For books, the ASIN is usually the ISBN-10.
fc12d89a2b0e.text: ASIN 长度为 10 个字符。对于图书，ASIN 通常就是 ISBN-10。

5d4da33d935f.source: Which Amazon link is best on packaging?
5d4da33d935f.text: 包装上用哪种 Amazon 链接最合适？

d8033f9d403d.source: The short /dp/ link with the product's ASIN. It is stable and much shorter than a search or shared link.
d8033f9d403d.text: 使用带有商品 ASIN 的简短 /dp/ 链接。它稳定，而且比搜索链接或分享链接短得多。

96057ca7173c.source: Can I link my brand store?
96057ca7173c.text: 可以链接我的品牌店铺吗？

8f4af5e6ce0f.source: Yes. Copy your store's URL and paste it here.
8f4af5e6ce0f.text: 可以。复制店铺的网址，粘贴到这里即可。

b00dd3f57083.source: What do customers in other countries see?
b00dd3f57083.text: 其他国家的顾客会看到什么？

b6e3f0abbc3f.source: The link opens the marketplace in the URL. Availability and prices depend on that marketplace, so use a regional link for regional packaging.
b6e3f0abbc3f.text: 链接会打开网址中指定的站点。商品供应和价格取决于该站点，因此地区性包装请使用对应地区的链接。

2860dda8e366.source: What happens if the listing is removed?
2860dda8e366.text: 如果商品被下架会怎样？

7a6234cf26f6.source: The code leads to an unavailable page. For packaging that stays in circulation for years, consider linking your brand store instead of a single product.
7a6234cf26f6.text: 二维码会指向一个无法访问的页面。对于会流通多年的包装，建议链接到品牌店铺，而不是单个商品。

db87e3a0956b.source: Open a Flipkart product or seller page.
db87e3a0956b.text: 打开 Flipkart 商品页或卖家页面。

1d36a447c0c6.source: Make a Flipkart QR code for a product or seller page. For boxes, inserts and in-store displays in India. Free, no signup, PNG and SVG.
1d36a447c0c6.text: 为商品或卖家页面生成 Flipkart 二维码，适用于印度的包装盒、随箱卡片和店内陈列。免费，无需注册，支持 PNG 和 SVG。

74a497cf460d.source: A Flipkart QR code takes customers to a Flipkart product page or your brand's store. Indian brands and sellers print it on boxes, inserts and in-store displays so customers can reorder, find related products or leave a review on Flipkart.
74a497cf460d.text: Flipkart 二维码可以把顾客带到 Flipkart 商品页或您品牌的店铺。印度的品牌和卖家会把它印在包装盒、随箱卡片和店内陈列上，方便顾客复购、查看相关商品或在 Flipkart 上留下评价。

0943d1d75404.source: Paste the product or store link from Flipkart. It opens in the Flipkart app when installed, or on flipkart.com otherwise, so customers land on the exact listing instead of searching among similar products.
0943d1d75404.text: 粘贴来自 Flipkart 的商品或店铺链接。已安装 Flipkart 应用时会在应用中打开，否则在 flipkart.com 上打开，顾客可以直接进入对应的商品页，而不用在相似商品中再去搜索。

8dd8b70e2012.source: Open the product on Flipkart and copy its link (or use Share in the app).
8dd8b70e2012.text: 在 Flipkart 上打开该商品并复制链接（或使用应用中的分享功能）。

971147a161e5.source: Scan the preview to check that the right product opens.
971147a161e5.text: 扫描预览图，确认打开的是正确的商品。

76d8878e25a4.source: QRdx checks that the link is a flipkart.com URL and encodes it as pasted.
76d8878e25a4.text: QRdx 会检查链接是否为 flipkart.com 网址，并按粘贴的原样编码。

5c2e0a95909b.source: Flipkart links can be long, which makes denser codes. Test-scan at the size you'll print, and print larger if needed.
5c2e0a95909b.text: Flipkart 链接可能很长，会让二维码更密集。请按实际打印尺寸试扫，必要时放大打印。

fe2ab07f9854.source: Pick the exact size or color on Flipkart before copying the link, since variants usually have their own product link.
fe2ab07f9854.text: 复制链接之前，请先在 Flipkart 上选好具体的尺寸或颜色，因为不同规格通常有各自的商品链接。

e088d3b0d013.source: Can I link my seller or brand store?
e088d3b0d013.text: 可以链接到我的卖家店铺或品牌店铺吗？

873328ba41a8.source: Yes, any flipkart.com link works, including brand and category pages.
873328ba41a8.text: 可以，任何 flipkart.com 链接都可以，包括品牌页面和分类页面。

d7d3adcd45da.source: Will it open the Flipkart app?
d7d3adcd45da.text: 会打开 Flipkart 应用吗？

00d6358863e2.source: When the app is installed, Flipkart links usually open in it; otherwise they open in the browser.
00d6358863e2.text: 已安装应用时，Flipkart 链接通常会在应用中打开；否则会在浏览器中打开。

0a8f8399b064.source: The code looks very dense. What can I do?
0a8f8399b064.text: 二维码看起来很密集，怎么办？

1fb250360c96.source: Print it larger, use error-correction level L or M in the full editor, or shorten the link with a link shortener first.
1fb250360c96.text: 可以放大打印，在完整编辑器中使用纠错级别 L 或 M，或者先用短链接工具缩短链接。

d82a02a421b2.source: The code opens anywhere, but Flipkart sells to customers in India, so it is most useful on products sold there.
d82a02a421b2.text: 二维码在任何地方都能打开，但 Flipkart 面向印度的顾客销售，因此对在印度销售的商品最有用。

78080ca9138f.text: 打开你的 Cal.com 预约页面。

f907d02bce67.source: Create a Cal.com QR code that opens your booking page so people can schedule a meeting in a few taps. For cards, slides and booths. Free.
f907d02bce67.text: 创建 Cal.com 二维码，打开你的预约页面，让他人轻点几下即可预约会议。适用于名片、幻灯片和展位。免费。

936212ba715d.source: A Cal.com QR code opens your booking page so people can pick a time that suits you both, without back-and-forth emails. Consultants, coaches, recruiters and salespeople put it on business cards, conference slides and event booths.
936212ba715d.text: Cal.com 二维码会打开你的预约页面，让对方选择双方都合适的时间，无需来回发邮件。顾问、教练、招聘人员和销售人员常把它放在名片、会议幻灯片和活动展位上。

1fd5a47348fd.source: Paste your Cal.com link: your profile (cal.com/yourname) to show all event types, or a specific event (cal.com/yourname/30min) to go straight to it. Cal.com handles time zones, availability and calendar invites, so the person scanning sees open slots in their own time zone.
1fd5a47348fd.text: 粘贴你的 Cal.com 链接：个人主页（cal.com/yourname）可显示所有活动类型，具体活动（cal.com/yourname/30min）则直接进入该活动。Cal.com 会处理时区、可预约时间和日历邀请，因此扫描的人看到的是按其所在时区显示的空闲时段。

7134efe5f27f.source: Copy your profile or event link from Cal.com.
7134efe5f27f.text: 从 Cal.com 复制你的个人主页或活动链接。

767f36485672.source: Scan the preview to check that the booking page opens.
767f36485672.text: 扫描预览，检查预约页面是否能打开。

64bc93436f1c.source: QRdx encodes the link as pasted. This form expects a link containing cal.com; for a self-hosted or custom domain, use the URL generator.
64bc93436f1c.text: QRdx 会按粘贴的内容原样编码链接。此表单要求链接包含 cal.com；如果使用自托管或自定义域名，请使用 URL 生成器。

f0ea05cd7066.source: An event link skips a step for the person scanning, so use it when you mainly offer one meeting type.
f0ea05cd7066.text: 活动链接可以让扫描的人少一个步骤，所以如果你主要提供一种会议类型，建议使用它。

527fe4be08f7.text: 个人主页还是活动链接？

1413d208df7f.source: Use the event link for a single meeting type, such as an intro call, and the profile link when people should choose between several.
1413d208df7f.text: 只有一种会议类型（例如初次沟通电话）时，使用活动链接；需要让对方在多种类型中选择时，使用个人主页链接。

fc97cd71b0ab.source: Does the person scanning need a Cal.com account?
fc97cd71b0ab.text: 扫描的人需要 Cal.com 账号吗？

559e731591e2.source: No. They pick a time and enter their name and email; Cal.com sends the invite.
559e731591e2.text: 不需要。对方选择时间并填写姓名和邮箱，Cal.com 会发送邀请。

f82b1195f756.source: Can I use Calendly or another scheduler?
f82b1195f756.text: 可以使用 Calendly 或其他预约工具吗？

5de515bb423b.source: Yes. Paste any booking link into the URL generator; this one is set up for Cal.com links.
5de515bb423b.text: 可以。把任意预约链接粘贴到 URL 生成器即可；此页面是为 Cal.com 链接设置的。

c86870b95e29.source: Can I control when people can book?
c86870b95e29.text: 我可以控制别人能在什么时候预约吗？

7cd231a293f5.source: Yes, in Cal.com. Each event type has its own duration, availability, buffer times and booking limits; the QR code just opens the page.
7cd231a293f5.text: 可以，在 Cal.com 中设置。每种活动类型都有各自的时长、可预约时间、缓冲时间和预约限制；二维码只负责打开页面。

05150fd5a364.source: Menus that change daily, guest Wi-Fi, reviews, ordering and bottle labels.
05150fd5a364.text: 每日更换的菜单、访客 Wi-Fi、评价、点单和瓶身标签。

21f5362c6f9d.source: QR Codes for Restaurants: Menus, Wi-Fi and Reviews
21f5362c6f9d.text: 餐厅二维码：菜单、Wi-Fi 和评价

a7b84c90e5ed.source: How restaurants use QR codes for menus, guest Wi-Fi, reviews and table ordering: which code type to pick, what size to print and copy that gets scans.
a7b84c90e5ed.text: 餐厅如何用二维码做菜单、访客 Wi-Fi、评价和桌边点单：该选哪种二维码类型、打印多大尺寸，以及能带来扫描的文案。

540d3687d1d3.source: Menus you can update, guest Wi-Fi, review requests and table ordering.
540d3687d1d3.text: 可随时更新的菜单、访客 Wi-Fi、评价邀请和桌边点单。

1787513c60ba.source: A restaurant QR code usually does one of three jobs: open the menu, join the Wi-Fi or ask for a review. Each needs a different kind of code. Menus change with the season and the supplier, so they belong behind a dynamic code you can edit. A Wi-Fi password rarely changes, so a free static code is enough.
1787513c60ba.text: 餐厅二维码通常承担三项任务之一：打开菜单、连接 Wi-Fi，或邀请顾客留下评价。每项任务需要不同类型的二维码。菜单会随季节和供应商变化，所以应放在可以编辑的动态二维码后面。Wi-Fi 密码很少更换，用免费的静态二维码就够了。

a90128e1e055.source: Below: where restaurants put QR codes, which QRdx code type fits each job, how big to print them for a table or a front window, and short lines of copy that make guests scan.
a90128e1e055.text: 下面介绍：餐厅把二维码放在哪里、每项任务适合哪种 QRdx 二维码类型、桌面和门口橱窗各应打印多大，以及让顾客愿意扫描的简短文案。

ed910395df17.source: A menu you can edit tonight

2badd1ff5286.source: Put a hosted menu page behind every table code. Mark a dish sold out, change a price or add the weekend special from your phone, and the printed table tents stay exactly as they are.
2badd1ff5286.text: 在每张餐桌的二维码后面放一个托管的菜单页面。用手机就能把某道菜标为售罄、改价格，或加上周末特供，而已印好的桌牌完全不用动。

cd25f810a1a0.source: Guest Wi-Fi without spelling the password
cd25f810a1a0.text: 访客 Wi-Fi，不用再念密码

b8ecd01c01a6.source: A static Wi-Fi code on the counter or the back of the menu joins the network in one scan, so staff stop reading the password out to every table.
b8ecd01c01a6.text: 把静态 Wi-Fi 二维码放在收银台或菜单背面，扫描一次即可连上网络，服务员就不用再给每桌逐个念密码了。

8287e352fdf6.source: Reviews while the meal is fresh
8287e352fdf6.text: 趁用餐体验还新鲜时收集评价

6b5584a5f690.source: Print a Google review code on the bill folder or receipt. Ask every guest the same way; selectively asking happy guests breaks Google's review rules.
6b5584a5f690.text: 把 Google 评价二维码印在账单夹或小票上。请每位顾客都用同样的方式邀请；只挑满意的顾客邀请，会违反 Google 的评价规则。

14adbf434ab6.source: Ordering and paying at the table

cdca959bf0b5.source: Point table codes at your ordering or payment provider. If the provider needs a table number in the URL, make one dynamic code per table.
cdca959bf0b5.text: 让餐桌二维码指向你的点单或支付服务商。如果服务商要求在 URL 中带上桌号，就为每张餐桌各做一个动态二维码。

4b54538f242f.source: Edit dishes, prices, allergen tags and sold-out items without reprinting. Use separate codes for the terrace, the bar and takeaway bags to see in analytics where guests scan.
4b54538f242f.text: 修改菜品、价格、过敏原标签和售罄状态，无需重新印刷。为露台、吧台和外卖袋分别使用不同的二维码，就能在数据分析中看到顾客在哪里扫描。

84a99305a1ed.source: The network name and password live in the code itself, so it needs no account and never expires. Reprint only when you change the password.
84a99305a1ed.text: 网络名称和密码就保存在二维码本身里，所以不需要账号，也永不过期。只有更换密码时才需要重新印刷。

82fff62177f4.source: Opens the 'write a review' box for your Google Business Profile directly, one tap fewer than a link to your listing.
82fff62177f4.text: 直接打开你的 Google Business Profile 的“写评价”窗口，比指向商家页面的链接少点一次。

83697a982319.source: Dynamic link to your ordering page
83697a982319.text: 指向点单页面的动态链接

4fe1ffee8e78.source: If you switch ordering or payment providers, change the destination and keep every printed table code.
4fe1ffee8e78.text: 如果更换点单或支付服务商，只需修改目标地址，已印好的每个桌面二维码都可以继续使用。

2505059e95d7.text: 临街橱窗，从人行道上看

e56acc7f0378.source: Stand table codes up on a tent or holder at a seated guest's eye level. Codes lying flat get covered by plates and catch glare from pendant lights.
e56acc7f0378.text: 把桌面二维码竖立在桌牌或支架上，与就座顾客的视线齐平。平放的二维码容易被餐盘遮住，还会反射吊灯的眩光。

5838e93eea8b.source: Choose a matte finish for laminated menus and table tents; glossy lamination reflects overhead light straight into the camera.
5838e93eea8b.text: 覆膜的菜单和桌牌请选哑光效果；亮面覆膜会把头顶的灯光直接反射进摄像头。

9248c753e6b3.source: Evening lighting is where pale brand colours fail first. Keep the code dark on a light background and test it at your dimmest service.
9248c753e6b3.text: 晚间灯光下，浅色的品牌色最先失效。请使用深色二维码配浅色背景，并在最暗的营业时段测试一下。

4de1fab98e8f.source: Keep a blank margin of four modules around the code, and don't let the table number or logo touch it.
4de1fab98e8f.text: 二维码四周要留出四个模块宽的空白边距，桌号或标志也不要碰到它。

2e7d99b65b74.source: Scan for today's menu and specials
2e7d99b65b74.text: 扫描查看今日菜单和特色菜

1b32196f4c07.source: Join our Wi-Fi: scan, no password needed
1b32196f4c07.text: 连接我们的 Wi-Fi：扫描即可，无需密码

282b0855d728.source: Enjoyed your meal? Scan to leave a review
282b0855d728.text: 用餐愉快？扫描留下评价

8c25808f5000.source: Scan to order and pay from your table
8c25808f5000.text: 扫描即可在座位上点餐并付款

4e4f9bba8e24.source: Should a restaurant menu QR code be static or dynamic?
4e4f9bba8e24.text: 餐厅菜单二维码应该用静态二维码还是动态二维码？

d672eec9a4ad.source: Dynamic. A static code that encodes a PDF link breaks as soon as the file moves, and every menu change means reprinting. A dynamic code opens a short link you can repoint, or a hosted menu page you edit directly, so the printed code outlives every menu revision.
d672eec9a4ad.text: 动态。编码 PDF 链接的静态二维码，一旦文件被移动就会失效，而且每次菜单改动都要重新印刷。动态二维码会打开一个可以重新指向的短链接，或是可直接编辑的托管页面菜单，这样印出来的二维码能经得起每一次菜单修订。

7bda9c146bb5.source: Do I still need printed menus?

31296a5b11c1.source: Keep some. Not every guest carries a charged phone or wants to use it at dinner, and some places expect an accessible alternative. Treat the QR menu as the faster option, not the only one.
31296a5b11c1.text: 要保留一些。不是每位客人的手机都有电，也不是人人愿意在用餐时玩手机，有些场所还要求提供无障碍的替代方案。把二维码菜单当作更快捷的选择，而不是唯一的选择。

b8dc0fef8c2c.source: Can I ask only happy guests for a Google review?
b8dc0fef8c2c.text: 可以只请满意的客人留 Google 评价吗？

39e7ca40d477.source: No. Google's policies prohibit selectively soliciting positive reviews (review gating). Show the review link to every guest. QRdx feedback forms show the Google review link to everyone, whatever rating they give.
39e7ca40d477.text: 不可以。Google 的政策禁止有选择地征集好评（评价筛选）。请向每位客人展示评价链接。QRdx 的反馈表单会向所有人显示 Google 评价链接，无论他们打几分。

6c7309cae8a5.source: QR codes for coffee shops and cafés
6c7309cae8a5.text: 咖啡店和咖啡馆的二维码

219c2ef95f31.source: QR Codes for Coffee Shops and Cafés
219c2ef95f31.text: 咖啡店和咖啡馆二维码

a2f93b5a108b.source: QR code ideas for coffee shops: loyalty sign-ups, Wi-Fi, mobile ordering, bean origin stories and reviews, plus print sizes for cups, counters and windows.
a2f93b5a108b.text: 咖啡店二维码创意：会员注册、Wi-Fi、移动点单、咖啡豆产地故事和评价，以及杯子、柜台和橱窗的印刷尺寸。

ad71cb397db9.source: Wi-Fi for laptop regulars, loyalty sign-ups, order-ahead and bean stories.
ad71cb397db9.text: 为带笔记本的常客提供 Wi-Fi，还有会员注册、提前点单和咖啡豆故事。

0d5a3529fbb1.source: Coffee shops have two audiences: the regular in a hurry who wants to order ahead, and the guest who stays for two hours on a laptop and wants the Wi-Fi. A small café can serve both with a couple of well-placed codes rather than a wall of them.
0d5a3529fbb1.text: 咖啡店有两类客人：赶时间、想提前下单的常客，以及带着笔记本坐上两小时、需要 Wi-Fi 的客人。小咖啡馆只需摆放得当的几个二维码，而不是满墙都是，就能兼顾两者。

b4975636be5c.source: Cups, sleeves and bags also leave the shop, which makes them the cheapest advertising a café has. A code on a sleeve that opens your order-ahead page brings people back from the office down the road.
b4975636be5c.text: 杯子、杯套和纸袋还会被带出店外，是咖啡馆成本最低的广告。杯套上的二维码如果打开你的提前点单页面，就能把附近写字楼里的人再招回来。

cb5445df7a8b.source: A static Wi-Fi code on a small table card saves the barista from answering the same question all day. Change the password monthly? Reprint the cards, or link to a page that shows the current one.
cb5445df7a8b.text: 小桌卡上的静态二维码 Wi-Fi 码，让咖啡师不必整天回答同一个问题。每月更换密码？重印桌卡，或链接到显示当前密码的页面。

e5ff4f015780.source: Order ahead from the cup sleeve

aa328b6183f8.source: Sleeves and takeaway bags travel. A code that opens your ordering app or page turns a passer-by's empty cup into the next order.
aa328b6183f8.text: 杯套和外带袋会被带到各处。打开你的点单应用或页面的二维码，能让路人手中的空杯变成下一笔订单。

7e02eb28788c.source: Replace paper stamp cards with a code at the till that opens your loyalty programme's sign-up page or a short feedback form.
7e02eb28788c.text: 用收银台的二维码取代纸质集章卡，打开会员计划的注册页面或简短的反馈表单。

2d4fed08fd0e.source: On retail bags of beans, link to the farm, roast date and brewing guide. A hosted page lets you update it for every new lot.
2d4fed08fd0e.text: 在零售装咖啡豆袋上，链接到农场、烘焙日期和冲泡指南。用托管页面，每有新批次就能更新内容。

64f4cc5c70d4.source: Joins the network without typing. Works offline and never expires, but needs a reprint whenever the password changes.
64f4cc5c70d4.text: 无需输入即可连上网络。离线也能用，永不过期，但密码一变就要重新印刷。

c1f6e365d11e.source: If you have an ordering app, one code on the sleeve shows the App Store button on iPhones and Google Play on Android.
c1f6e365d11e.text: 如果你有点单应用，杯套上的一个二维码会在 iPhone 上显示 App Store 按钮，在 Android 上显示 Google Play。

dfdae4d8b5f9.source: One page for the menu, Instagram, opening hours and the loyalty sign-up, so the counter needs a single code.
dfdae4d8b5f9.text: 一个页面汇集菜单、Instagram、营业时间和会员注册，柜台上只需一个二维码。

76a0d43495d3.source: Latte art and new pastries are what cafés post. A profile code on the pastry case gets you followers who see every post.
76a0d43495d3.text: 拉花和新出炉的糕点是咖啡馆爱发的内容。糕点柜上的主页二维码能带来会看到你每条动态的粉丝。

2e1c94fa101d.source: Cups and sleeves are curved. Keep the code small enough to sit on the flattest part, roughly a third of the sleeve's height, and test it on a filled cup.
2e1c94fa101d.text: 杯子和杯套都是弧形的。二维码要小到能放在最平整的位置，大约为杯套高度的三分之一，并在装满饮品的杯子上测试。

4fee8d57bb1b.source: Kraft paper is brown and absorbent. Print the code in solid black, without a gradient, and check that the ink doesn't spread and fill the gaps.
4fee8d57bb1b.text: 牛皮纸呈棕色且吸墨。请用纯黑色印刷二维码，不要使用渐变，并检查油墨是否会晕开、填满空隙。

8105b1c71411.source: Put the ordering code where people queue, not behind the till where the barista stands.
8105b1c71411.text: 把点单二维码放在顾客排队的地方，而不是咖啡师所在的收银台后面。

04ac99b6631d.source: Steam and condensation fog acrylic stands near the machine; place codes away from it.
04ac99b6631d.text: 咖啡机附近的蒸汽和冷凝水会让亚克力展架起雾，二维码要远离它放置。

d1babc5342a6.source: Skip the queue next time: scan to order ahead
d1babc5342a6.text: 下次不用排队：扫描即可提前点单

cd29f38eb31f.source: Scan to join our loyalty club and get your 10th coffee free
cd29f38eb31f.text: 扫描加入会员俱乐部，第10杯咖啡免费

0bae0b5ec376.source: Meet the farm behind this roast
0bae0b5ec376.text: 认识这款烘焙豆背后的农场

2268dc2d0122.source: What should a coffee shop QR code link to?
2268dc2d0122.text: 咖啡店的二维码应该链接到哪里？

1c337e5d04ef.source: Start with the question staff hear most. For most cafés that is the Wi-Fi password, then the menu or ordering page. A link list page can hold the menu, socials, hours and loyalty sign-up behind one counter code.
1c337e5d04ef.text: 先从店员被问得最多的问题入手。对大多数咖啡馆来说，那是 Wi-Fi 密码，其次是菜单或点单页面。链接列表页面可以把菜单、社交账号、营业时间和会员注册集中放在柜台的一个二维码后面。

ef430069bf60.source: Will a QR code on a paper cup still scan?
ef430069bf60.text: 纸杯上的二维码还能扫描吗？

984b6d5f7323.source: Usually, if it is big enough and printed in a dark solid colour. Curvature distorts the code, so keep it on the flattest area and about 3 to 3.5 cm wide, and test on real cups before ordering a full print run.
984b6d5f7323.text: 通常可以，只要尺寸够大，并用深色纯色印刷。弧面会使二维码变形，所以请放在最平整的区域，宽度约 3 到 3.5 厘米，并在下整批印刷订单之前用真实杯子测试。

5f089ba39f7d.source: How do I know if the cup codes bring people back?
5f089ba39f7d.text: 怎么知道杯上的二维码有没有带来回头客？

aa7a6dcb32d6.source: Use a dynamic code for the sleeves, separate from the one at the counter. QRdx counts scans per code, so you can compare sleeve scans with in-store scans week by week.
aa7a6dcb32d6.text: 杯套使用单独的动态二维码，与柜台上的分开。QRdx 按每个二维码统计扫描次数，所以你可以逐周比较杯套扫描和店内扫描。

3e0691233290.source: QR codes for bars and pubs

018cb5276e27.source: QR Codes for Bars and Pubs: Drinks Menus and Events
018cb5276e27.text: 酒吧和酒馆二维码：酒水单与活动

166cfc9085aa.source: QR codes for bars and pubs: drinks menus that track what's on tap, event nights, table ordering, Wi-Fi and reviews. Sizing for dim light and print tips.
166cfc9085aa.text: 酒吧和酒馆二维码：随在售生啤更新的酒水单、活动之夜、桌边点单、Wi-Fi 和评价。附昏暗灯光下的尺寸与印刷建议。

2b05f21d4fd9.source: What's on tap tonight, event nights, table service and dim-light tips.
2b05f21d4fd9.text: 今晚有什么生啤、活动之夜、桌边服务和昏暗灯光下的使用建议。

2242be5e2f8f.source: Bars change what they pour more often than restaurants change what they cook. Guest taps rotate, cocktails go seasonal and happy-hour prices move by the hour. A drinks menu behind a dynamic code keeps up without a new print run every keg.
2242be5e2f8f.text: 酒吧更换酒品的频率比餐厅更换菜品还要高。客座啤酒龙头轮换，鸡尾酒按季节更新，欢乐时光的价格按小时变动。放在动态二维码后面的酒水单可以随时跟上，不必每换一桶酒就重印一次。

6b742e0539c1.source: The other challenge is light. Bars are dark on purpose, and a code that scans fine in the office can fail at the end of the bar at 11 pm. Contrast and size matter more here than almost anywhere else.
6b742e0539c1.text: 另一个难题是光线。酒吧本来就刻意调暗，在办公室里扫得好好的二维码，晚上11点在吧台尽头可能就扫不出来。对比度和尺寸在这里比几乎任何地方都重要。

b740813d3f15.source: Keep a hosted menu page with sections for draught, bottles and cocktails. Mark a keg empty from behind the bar and guests stop ordering it.
b740813d3f15.text: 维护一个托管页面作为菜单，分为生啤、瓶装和鸡尾酒几个板块。在吧台后把某桶酒标记为已售罄，客人就不会再点它。

14c428bbaaf7.source: Quiz nights, live music and match days
14c428bbaaf7.text: 问答之夜、现场音乐和比赛日

bd9db69486f9.source: A code on posters and beer mats that opens an event page with the date and an add-to-calendar button fills the room on a slow Tuesday.
bd9db69486f9.text: 海报和杯垫上的二维码可以打开活动页面，页面带有日期和添加到日历按钮，能让冷清的周二也坐满客人。

f3bef6c992ea.source: Table codes linked to your ordering system keep people in their seats during busy rounds. Repoint them if you change provider.
f3bef6c992ea.text: 与点单系统关联的桌面二维码，能让客人在繁忙的几轮点单中不必离座。如果更换服务商，重新指向新的链接即可。

e8ab0bf49ae5.source: A review code on the bill tray, or a payment code for tips where your provider supports links, catches guests at the end of the night.
e8ab0bf49ae5.text: 在账单托盘上放一个评价二维码，或者在服务商支持链接的情况下放一个用于小费的支付二维码，就能在夜晚结束时触达客人。

66360b7692b9.source: Sections, prices and sold-out flags suit a rotating tap list. Diet tags cover gluten-free and alcohol-free options.
66360b7692b9.text: 分区、价格和售罄标记很适合经常更换的生啤酒单。饮食标签可涵盖无麸质和无酒精选项。

7a56d8b6768b.source: One page per event night with time, details and calendar buttons. Swap it for next week's event on the same printed poster.
7a56d8b6768b.text: 每个活动之夜一个页面，包含时间、详情和日历按钮。同一张印好的海报，下周换成新的活动页面即可。

ab8b5c8eee5c.source: Sends guests straight to the review box. Show it to everyone, not just the regulars you know are happy.
ab8b5c8eee5c.text: 直接把客人带到评价框。请展示给每一位客人，而不只是你确信满意的熟客。

56ab3fc526f7.source: Dim, warm lighting cuts contrast. Use pure black on white (or white on very dark) and avoid red or amber codes, which wash out under warm bulbs.
56ab3fc526f7.text: 昏暗的暖色灯光会降低对比度。请使用白底纯黑（或极深底色上的白色），避免使用红色或琥珀色二维码，它们在暖光灯泡下会褪色发白。

17f5601ce488.source: Go one size up from what the calculator says for anything at the far end of the bar.
17f5601ce488.text: 对于吧台远端的任何位置，请在计算器给出的尺寸基础上再加大一档。

b95e740e615d.source: Beer mats get wet. Use coated board, or put the code on a table card that stays dry.
b95e740e615d.text: 杯垫会被打湿。请使用涂层纸板，或把二维码放在不会受潮的桌卡上。

9a61e1b91106.source: Place the event poster code at chest height near the door, where people pause, not above the bar.
9a61e1b91106.text: 把活动海报的二维码放在门口附近胸口高度、人们会停下脚步的位置，而不是吧台上方。

9c74441be75d.source: Quiz every Tuesday: scan to save the date
9c74441be75d.text: 每周二问答之夜：扫描即可保存日期

118c3bf2aafc.source: Order another round without leaving your seat
118c3bf2aafc.text: 不用离开座位，再来一轮

ffed5bf22fd2.source: Had a good night? Leave us a review
ffed5bf22fd2.text: 今晚玩得开心吗？欢迎给我们留个评价

081b496ca80b.source: Why won't my bar's QR code scan in the evening?
081b496ca80b.text: 为什么我酒吧的二维码在晚上扫描不出来？

16fef9dbd4d1.source: Usually contrast and size. Phone cameras raise their sensitivity in the dark and lose detail, so fine modules and pale colours fail first. Print larger, in black on white, and test at your darkest table during service.
16fef9dbd4d1.text: 通常是对比度和尺寸的问题。手机相机在暗处会提高感光度，从而丢失细节，所以精细的模块和浅色最先失效。请放大打印，使用白底黑码，并在营业期间到最暗的桌子上测试。

dc0fa63d4bc4.source: Can one code show different drinks at happy hour?
dc0fa63d4bc4.text: 一个二维码可以在欢乐时光显示不同的饮品吗？

c2a341d283f9.source: Yes. With a dynamic code you can change the destination yourself at the start and end of happy hour, or keep one menu page and edit the prices. Time-based routing rules on Pro can switch destinations automatically.
c2a341d283f9.text: 可以。使用动态二维码，你可以在欢乐时光开始和结束时自行更改目标地址，也可以保留一个菜单页面并修改价格。Pro 上基于时间的路由规则可以自动切换目标地址。

108ac7d46fb6.source: Do I need a different QR code for every event?
108ac7d46fb6.text: 每场活动都需要不同的二维码吗？

2f04e7c608fa.source: No. Print one dynamic code on the permanent poster frame and point it at the next event's page each week. Scans are counted per code, so you also see which nights draw interest.
2f04e7c608fa.text: 不需要。在固定的海报框上印一个动态二维码，每周把它指向下一场活动的页面即可。扫描次数按二维码统计，因此你还能看出哪些夜晚更受关注。

3faa7bbd75ef.source: QR codes for food trucks and market stalls
3faa7bbd75ef.text: 适用于餐车和市集摊位的二维码

783f40d0ce7f.source: QR Codes for Food Trucks and Market Stalls
783f40d0ce7f.text: 餐车和市集摊位二维码

0c5d259eeaea.source: QR codes for food trucks: tomorrow's location, the menu, payments, social follows and catering enquiries. Sizes that scan from the queue and print tips.
0c5d259eeaea.text: 餐车二维码：明天的位置、菜单、支付、社交媒体关注和外烩咨询。排队时也能扫描的尺寸，以及印刷提示。

0f4931e84ec5.source: Where you'll be tomorrow, menus, payments and catering enquiries.
0f4931e84ec5.text: 明天在哪里、菜单、支付和外烩咨询。

b501e09f3efe.source: A food truck's biggest problem is that customers can't find it twice. A QR code painted or stuck on the side of the truck can answer the question every regular asks: where will you be next week?
b501e09f3efe.text: 餐车最大的难题是，顾客很难第二次找到它。喷涂或贴在车身侧面的二维码，可以回答每位回头客都会问的问题：下周你们会在哪里？

4c20941dbb4f.source: Trucks also queue people outdoors, in sunlight, at a distance. Codes have to be large, high-contrast and placed where the queue actually stands, usually beside the order window.
4c20941dbb4f.text: 餐车还会让顾客在户外、阳光下、隔着一段距离排队。二维码必须够大、对比度够高，并放在队伍实际站立的位置，通常就在点餐窗口旁边。

f45ac1f4ed71.source: Point a code on the truck at a page with your schedule and update it each morning. The printed decal never changes.
f45ac1f4ed71.text: 让车身上的二维码指向一个排期页面，每天早上更新内容，印好的贴纸无需更换。

2176c238722f.source: The menu before people reach the window
2176c238722f.text: 走到窗口前就能看菜单

fc7433309fc0.source: A menu code on an A-frame at the back of the queue lets people choose before they order, which shortens the line.
fc7433309fc0.text: 在队尾的 A 字牌上放一个菜单二维码，顾客排队时就能先选好餐，队伍也会缩短。

752b876f7757.source: In India, a UPI code at the window is how most customers pay. Elsewhere, link to your PayPal or card-payment page.
752b876f7757.text: 在印度，大多数顾客通过窗口的 UPI 二维码付款。其他地区，可以链接到你的 PayPal 或银行卡支付页面。

a2aaf0919dc9.source: Weddings and office lunches are where trucks make margin. A code on napkins or the side panel can open a catering enquiry form.
a2aaf0919dc9.text: 婚礼和公司午餐是餐车的主要利润来源。餐巾纸或车身侧面的二维码可以打开餐饮预订咨询表单。

0e1c167c31ad.source: Schedule, menu, Instagram and catering form on one page behind the decal, edited from your phone between stops.
0e1c167c31ad.text: 排期、菜单、Instagram 和餐饮预订表单集中在贴纸背后的一个页面上，停靠间隙用手机就能编辑。

a212f2563188.source: Customers pay in any UPI app with your ID and name filled in. Static, free and works without an account.
a212f2563188.text: 顾客用任意 UPI 应用即可付款，你的 ID 和名称已自动填好。这是静态二维码，免费，无需注册账户。

412a0760f7c1.source: Prices and sold-out flags you can change mid-service, with allergen tags for the questions you hear at the window.
412a0760f7c1.text: 营业期间可随时修改价格和售罄标记，并附有过敏原标签，应对窗口前常听到的提问。

59bb1132d47a.source: A short catering enquiry form: date, headcount and contact details, delivered to your dashboard.
59bb1132d47a.text: 一份简短的餐饮预订咨询表单：日期、人数和联系方式，直接送达你的控制台。

854f97eee664.source: A-frame at the back of the queue

c1b973d2bb90.source: Truck side, from across the street

b85798deb510.source: Bright sun creates glare on vinyl. Use a matte laminate on truck decals and avoid placing the code under the awning edge where shadows cut across it.
b85798deb510.text: 强烈的阳光会让乙烯基贴纸反光。车身贴纸请使用哑光覆膜，并避免把二维码放在遮阳篷边缘下方，以免阴影横穿其上。

0256d6efe16c.source: Put the payment code at hand height on the window ledge so people can scan it while holding their phone at arm's length.
0256d6efe16c.text: 把付款二维码放在窗口台面的手部高度，这样顾客伸直手臂拿着手机就能扫描。

e11ce146f640.source: A code on the truck side meant for people across the street needs to be over half a metre wide. If that doesn't fit, aim it at the queue instead.
e11ce146f640.text: 车身侧面的二维码如果是给街对面的人扫描，宽度需要超过半米。如果放不下，就改为面向排队的顾客。

e799ad585e24.source: Print the truck's name or handle as text under the code for people who don't scan.
e799ad585e24.text: 在二维码下方用文字印上餐车的名称或账号，方便不扫描的顾客。

cc0750e0e2e0.source: Find us tomorrow: scan for this week's spots
cc0750e0e2e0.text: 明天来找我们：扫描查看本周营业地点

9a1308608f9a.source: Scan the menu while you wait

1b4c64b5d566.text: 可用任意 UPI 应用付款

c747a33b8dbe.text: 邀请我们参加你的活动

fd8d88b3bc2b.source: What's the best QR code for a food truck?
fd8d88b3bc2b.text: 餐车最适合用哪种二维码？

94fd4324fbf7.source: A dynamic code on the truck that opens a page you edit daily: today's location, the menu and your socials. Add a static payment code at the window. The truck decal then never needs to change.
94fd4324fbf7.text: 在车身上放一个动态二维码，指向你每天编辑的页面：今天的营业地点、菜单和社交账号。再在窗口放一个静态付款二维码。这样车身贴纸就无需更换。

784654c23e07.source: Can I accept UPI payments with a QRdx code?
784654c23e07.text: 可以用 QRdx 二维码收取 UPI 付款吗？

7e051931870c.source: Yes. The UPI generator creates a standard upi://pay code with your UPI ID, payee name and an optional fixed amount. It works with any UPI app, is free, and doesn't route money through QRdx.
7e051931870c.text: 可以。UPI 生成器会创建标准的 upi://pay 二维码，包含你的 UPI ID、收款人名称和可选的固定金额。它适用于任何 UPI 应用，免费，资金也不会经过 QRdx。

763841209770.source: How big should the QR code be on the side of a truck?
763841209770.text: 餐车侧面的二维码应该多大？

e58262c3350b.source: It depends on the distance. From 5 metres a short-link code needs to be roughly 58 cm wide. If people only scan from the queue, 2 metres away, about 23 cm is enough.
e58262c3350b.text: 这取决于扫描距离。在 5 米外扫描时，短链接二维码宽度需要约 58 厘米。如果顾客只在 2 米外的队伍中扫描，约 23 厘米就够了。

49ceb57c1037.source: QR codes for wineries and beverage brands
49ceb57c1037.text: 酒庄与饮品品牌的二维码

3165c928092c.source: QR Codes for Wine and Beverage Labels
3165c928092c.text: 葡萄酒与饮品酒标二维码

ae9cc206e74e.source: QR codes on wine, beer and spirits labels: tasting notes, ingredient and nutrition info, cocktail recipes and club sign-ups. Label sizes and copy ideas.
ae9cc206e74e.text: 把二维码印在葡萄酒、啤酒和烈酒酒标上：品鉴笔记、配料与营养信息、鸡尾酒配方和会员注册。附酒标尺寸与文案创意。

733fa764daab.source: Tasting notes, ingredient info, recipes and club sign-ups from the label.
733fa764daab.text: 从酒标直达品鉴笔记、配料信息、配方和会员注册。

f44ee207b14e.source: A bottle label has room for a name, a vintage and the legal text, and not much else. A QR code gives it a second label: tasting notes, food pairings, the vineyard story, or the ingredient and nutrition list that some markets now expect producers to make available.
f44ee207b14e.text: 酒瓶标签上能放下名称、年份和法定文字，几乎就没有多余空间了。二维码相当于多出一张标签：品鉴笔记、佐餐搭配、酒庄故事，或是一些市场现在要求生产商提供的配料和营养成分表。

19706fb78bde.source: Labels are printed months before a bottle is opened, so the destination has to stay editable. A dynamic code lets each vintage or batch point at the right page, and keeps working long after the run is bottled.
19706fb78bde.text: 标签在酒瓶开启前几个月就已印好，所以目标页面必须可以随时修改。动态二维码可以让每个年份或批次指向对应的页面，即使整批酒灌装多年之后，二维码依然有效。

e9458091a0b3.source: Link each wine to a page with tasting notes, serving temperature and pairings. Update it when a critic's score or award comes in.
e9458091a0b3.text: 为每款酒链接到一个页面，介绍品鉴笔记、饮用温度和搭配建议。有评论家评分或奖项时随时更新。

1c80ba6cc2fd.source: Where rules allow information to be provided electronically, a code can open the ingredient and energy list. Check the regulations for each market you sell in.
1c80ba6cc2fd.text: 在法规允许以电子方式提供信息的地区，二维码可以打开配料和能量表。请查阅您销售的每个市场的相关规定。

8ca47bf97abb.source: A code on the neck tag or back label that opens your club sign-up or the next tasting event turns a bottle bought in a shop into a direct customer.
8ca47bf97abb.text: 在瓶颈挂牌或背标上放一个二维码，指向会员注册页或下一场品鉴活动，就能把在商店买酒的顾客变成您的直接客户。

115d7463e833.source: Spirits labels can link to a video or gallery of cocktail recipes, refreshed for every season.
115d7463e833.text: 烈酒标签可以链接到鸡尾酒配方的视频或图集，并按季节更新。

5a5ce1bcfb12.source: Dynamic link per vintage or batch
5a5ce1bcfb12.text: 按年份或批次设置动态链接

6a9dbb9a9d3f.source: One code per SKU and vintage, each pointing at its own page. Change the destination if your website moves; the bottles in shops keep working.
6a9dbb9a9d3f.text: 每个 SKU 和年份各用一个二维码，分别指向各自的页面。网站迁移时只需更改目标地址，已在商店售卖的酒瓶依然有效。

cd40620ba53b.source: Cellar-door tastings and harvest events with the date, venue map and calendar buttons.
cd40620ba53b.text: 酒庄品鉴和采收季活动，附日期、场地地图和日历按钮。

ccf898686f9f.source: A recipe or vineyard video from YouTube or Vimeo, embedded on a page that loads fast on a phone.
ccf898686f9f.text: 来自 YouTube 或 Vimeo 的配方或酒庄视频，嵌入在手机上加载很快的页面中。

918b864f4df1.source: Bottles curve. On a standard 75 cl bottle a code much wider than 3 cm starts to wrap out of view; if you need it bigger, use a flat neck tag.
918b864f4df1.text: 酒瓶是弧形的。在标准 75 cl 的酒瓶上，二维码宽度远超 3 cm 就会绕到视线之外；如果需要更大的尺寸，请使用平整的瓶颈挂牌。

37bb602dd179.source: Textured and uncoated wine label papers soften edges. Use solid ink, at least 0.4 mm per module, and proof on the real stock.
37bb602dd179.text: 有纹理和未涂布的酒标纸会使边缘变模糊。请使用实地油墨，每个模块至少 0.4 mm，并在实际纸张上打样。

87c730fec16e.source: Gold foil and embossing look great and scan terribly. Keep them away from the code.
87c730fec16e.text: 烫金和压凸效果很好看，但会严重影响扫描。请让它们远离二维码。

7ee5a376b4b2.source: Ask the printer for vector artwork (SVG or PDF) so the code stays sharp at small sizes; QRdx exports both, including CMYK PDF.
7ee5a376b4b2.text: 请向印刷厂索取矢量文件（SVG 或 PDF），这样二维码在小尺寸下也能保持清晰；QRdx 两种格式都可导出，包括 CMYK PDF。

d4aa1c27c295.source: Scan for tasting notes and pairings
d4aa1c27c295.text: 扫描查看品鉴笔记和搭配

f2072bc961c9.source: Three cocktails to make with this bottle
f2072bc961c9.text: 用这瓶酒调制三款鸡尾酒

34e80c43c6a6.source: Can a QR code replace the ingredient list on a wine label?
34e80c43c6a6.text: 二维码可以取代葡萄酒标签上的配料表吗？

f39045359b8b.source: Sometimes, partly. In the EU, for example, wine labels must show energy value on the label but can provide the full ingredient and nutrition list through a QR code. Rules differ by country and product, so check with your regulator or trade body before relying on it.
f39045359b8b.text: 有时可以，但只是部分取代。例如在欧盟，葡萄酒标签上必须标示能量值，但完整的配料和营养成分表可以通过二维码提供。各国和各类产品的规定不尽相同，所以在依赖这种做法之前，请先向监管机构或行业协会确认。

c900af5325cd.source: Should every vintage have its own QR code?
c900af5325cd.text: 每个年份都应该有自己的二维码吗？

5e8b08bb6093.source: Yes, if the content differs. Separate dynamic codes per vintage or batch let you show the right notes and compliance data, and scan analytics show which wines people look up most.
5e8b08bb6093.text: 如果内容不同，就应该有。为每个年份或批次分别设置动态二维码，就能展示对应的品鉴笔记和合规数据，而且扫描分析还能显示人们查询最多的是哪些酒款。

7cb65f128e6a.source: Will the code work on a curved bottle?
7cb65f128e6a.text: 二维码在弧形的酒瓶上能用吗？

f3e42810f4a1.source: Phones handle mild curvature, but a wide code wraps around too far to read. Keep it narrow relative to the bottle's diameter, or place it on a flat neck tag, and test on a filled bottle.
f3e42810f4a1.text: 手机能应对轻微的弧度，但过宽的二维码会绕到瓶身另一侧，导致无法识读。请让二维码相对瓶身直径保持窄一些，或者把它放在平整的瓶颈挂牌上，并在装满酒的瓶子上测试。

52c29df96d38.source: Shelf tags, product details, bookings, memberships and service history.
52c29df96d38.text: 货架标签、商品详情、预约、会员和服务记录。

8cc2e5f6cc84.source: QR Codes for Retail Stores and Shelf Tags
8cc2e5f6cc84.text: 零售门店与货架标签二维码

ac99bd889054.source: How retail stores use QR codes on shelf tags, windows and receipts: product details, reviews, stock alerts and loyalty, with sizes and copy that work.
ac99bd889054.text: 零售门店如何在货架标签、橱窗和小票上使用二维码：商品详情、评价、到货提醒和会员积分，并附实用的尺寸与文案建议。

0c354024bca3.source: Shelf-tag product details, after-hours window shopping and loyalty.
0c354024bca3.text: 货架标签上的商品详情、打烊后的橱窗购物和会员积分。

17b96475b94f.source: In a shop, a QR code answers the questions a shelf tag has no room for: what is it made of, does it come in blue, what do other buyers think, and is there one in the back? It also keeps working after closing time, when a code in the window can take an order from someone looking in.
17b96475b94f.text: 在店里，二维码能回答货架标签写不下的问题：用什么材质做的，有没有蓝色，其他买家怎么评价，库房里还有没有货。打烊之后它也照常工作，橱窗里的二维码可以让站在门外的人直接下单。

8e1a871426dd.source: Retail codes are printed in large numbers and stay up for months, so mistakes are expensive. Dynamic codes let you fix a wrong link or move a campaign without reprinting a single tag, and per-code scan counts show which displays people actually use.
8e1a871426dd.text: 零售二维码印刷量大，一贴就是好几个月，出错的代价很高。动态二维码让你无需重印任何一张标签，就能改正错误的链接或调整活动；每个二维码单独的扫描次数，则能看出哪些陈列真正被人用到。

2de40bc7ceec.source: Product details on the shelf tag
2de40bc7ceec.text: 货架标签上的商品详情

6b7d6dbb82ef.source: Link each tag to the product page with sizes, materials, care instructions and reviews, so a shopper can decide without finding a staff member.
6b7d6dbb82ef.text: 把每张标签链接到商品页，展示尺码、材质、洗护说明和评价，顾客无需找店员就能做决定。

8b75adb7829b.source: A large code in the window that opens the online shop or this week's featured product turns evening foot traffic into orders.
8b75adb7829b.text: 橱窗里放一个大尺寸二维码，打开网店或本周主推商品，就能把晚间的路过人流变成订单。

c20702558dea.source: A code on the counter or receipt that opens your loyalty or newsletter sign-up is faster than staff typing email addresses.
c20702558dea.text: 在柜台或小票上放一个二维码，打开会员或订阅通讯的注册页，比店员手动输入邮箱地址更快。

dbf85a78bf61.source: Shops that also sell on Amazon, Flipkart or Etsy can link displays to the listing where reviews and stock already live.
dbf85a78bf61.text: 同时在 Amazon、Flipkart 或 Etsy 上销售的店铺，可以把陈列链接到评价和库存都已就绪的商品页面。

74ee72e3b79b.source: Dynamic link per product or display
74ee72e3b79b.text: 每件商品或每处陈列一个动态链接

bbf2a9946b4a.source: Point each tag at its product page, then change it when the product page moves or the item is replaced. Scan counts per code show which displays work.
bbf2a9946b4a.text: 让每张标签指向对应的商品页，商品页变动或商品更换时再随时修改。每个二维码的扫描次数能显示哪些陈列有效。

66653c65e5c7.source: In-store offers with a code or barcode the till can scan, validity dates and terms, without printing new coupons.
66653c65e5c7.text: 店内优惠可使用收银台能扫描的二维码或条形码，并设置有效期和使用条款，无需重新印刷优惠券。

b7fc6bc206ba.source: Opens the product or store page on Amazon, where your ratings and delivery options already are.
b7fc6bc206ba.text: 打开 Amazon 上的商品或店铺页面，你的评分和配送选项都已在那里。

092657e56fa7.source: For makers selling at markets and pop-ups: the stall sign opens the Etsy shop for anything sold out on the day.
092657e56fa7.text: 适合在集市和快闪店摆摊的手作者：摊位招牌上的二维码可打开 Etsy 店铺，购买当天已售罄的商品。

4a03a2ee0f40.text: 店铺橱窗，从人行道扫描

6f45c674c3fc.source: Put shelf-tag codes on the tag face, not on the strip below the shelf edge where shoppers have to crouch.
6f45c674c3fc.text: 货架标签的二维码要放在标签正面，不要放在货架边缘下方的条形区域，否则顾客得蹲下来才能扫描。

db3ab5058776.source: Shelf tags are small. Keep the code at least 2.5 cm wide and give it the full height of the tag rather than squeezing it beside the price.
db3ab5058776.text: 货架标签很小。二维码宽度至少保持 2.5 cm，并占满标签的整个高度，而不要挤在价格旁边。

0fbd05c5d554.source: Window codes face reflections and sunlight. Print on the inside of the glass with an opaque white backing, and test from the pavement at midday.
0fbd05c5d554.text: 橱窗二维码会遇到反光和阳光直射。请印在玻璃内侧，并加不透明的白色底衬，中午时分再从人行道上测试一下。

272e0cbe713c.source: Use one dynamic code per display, not one for the whole store, so you can compare which displays get scanned.
272e0cbe713c.text: 每处陈列使用一个动态二维码，而不是整家店共用一个，这样就能比较哪些陈列被扫描得更多。

61ec4cebb1a6.source: Scan for sizes, colours and reviews
61ec4cebb1a6.text: 扫描查看尺码、颜色和评价

c9024f92dada.source: Shop this window, even when we're closed
c9024f92dada.text: 打烊后也能继续逛这个橱窗

ac818026089c.source: Join our rewards club in 10 seconds
ac818026089c.text: 10 秒加入我们的会员俱乐部

db474b0d3f6c.source: Scan to check stock in other sizes
db474b0d3f6c.text: 扫描查看其他尺码的库存

1d89a3c3c909.source: How do I track which shelf tags get scanned?
1d89a3c3c909.text: 如何追踪哪些货架标签被扫描了？

c40b3e210629.source: Give each tag or display its own dynamic code. QRdx counts scans per code with time, country, city and device, so you can compare displays, see when people scan, and export the data as CSV.
c40b3e210629.text: 为每个标签或陈列准备各自的动态二维码。QRdx 会按二维码统计扫描次数,并记录时间、国家、城市和设备,方便你比较各个陈列、了解人们何时扫描,还能将数据导出为 CSV。

bea3b900cd29.source: What if a product's web page changes after the tags are printed?
bea3b900cd29.text: 标签印好后,产品的网页发生变化怎么办？

ea8aedb0f9a4.source: With a dynamic code, change the destination in the dashboard and every printed tag follows. With a static code, the tag points at the old address until you reprint it.
ea8aedb0f9a4.text: 使用动态二维码,在控制台中修改目标地址,所有已印刷的标签都会同步指向新地址。使用静态二维码的话,标签会一直指向旧地址,直到你重新印刷。

d2ff810da7fb.source: Can I put one QR code on the whole store?
d2ff810da7fb.text: 可以整家店只用一个二维码吗？

3bdb51a68c9e.source: You can, but you lose the detail that makes codes useful in retail. One code per product line or display costs nothing extra to print and tells you what shoppers were looking at when they scanned.
3bdb51a68c9e.text: 可以,但这样会失去让二维码在零售中真正有用的细节。每条产品线或每个陈列使用一个二维码,印刷不会增加成本,还能告诉你顾客扫描时在看什么。

c3571ba36f67.source: QR codes for cosmetics and beauty brands
c3571ba36f67.text: 化妆品和美妆品牌的二维码

12b603459956.source: QR Codes for Cosmetics and Beauty Packaging
12b603459956.text: 化妆品和美妆包装二维码

1aa71df11101.source: QR codes on cosmetics packaging: full ingredient lists, how-to videos, shade finders, authenticity and refills. Tiny-package sizing tips and example copy.
1aa71df11101.text: 化妆品包装上的二维码:完整成分表、使用教程视频、色号查找、正品验证和补充装。附小尺寸包装的尺寸建议和文案示例。

c75d2961e2df.source: Ingredient lists, tutorials, shade finders and refill programmes.
c75d2961e2df.text: 成分表、教程、色号查找和补充装计划。

35569cd72af1.source: A lipstick tube has about a square centimetre of free space, and the legal text takes most of it. A QR code on the outer box or the tube lets a beauty brand add everything else: the full ingredient list with explanations, a tutorial, the shade range and the refill programme.
35569cd72af1.text: 一支口红管身的空白处只有大约一平方厘米,法规要求的文字就占掉了大部分。在外盒或管身上放一个二维码,美妆品牌就能补充其余所有内容:附说明的完整成分表、教程、色号系列和补充装计划。

0246114a9ae5.source: Beauty buyers research before they commit, often in the store aisle. A code that opens a short video or a shade guide can close that sale on the spot, and per-code scans show which products shoppers want to know more about.
0246114a9ae5.text: 美妆消费者在下单前会先做功课,常常就在店里的货架前。一个能打开短视频或色号指南的二维码,可以当场促成这笔交易,而按二维码统计的扫描数据也能显示顾客最想进一步了解哪些产品。

cc14fddff917.source: The INCI list on the pack is mandatory and unreadable. Link to a page that explains each ingredient, its purpose and any allergens.
cc14fddff917.text: 包装上的 INCI 成分表是强制要求的,却几乎读不懂。链接到一个页面,逐一解释每种成分、其用途以及过敏原。

d66352567898.source: A 30-second tutorial on the box answers 'how do I use this?' better than any leaflet, and it can be reshot for new shades.
d66352567898.text: 包装盒上的 30 秒教程比任何说明书都更能回答'这个怎么用？',还能为新色号重新拍摄。

68feb7d017b3.source: Testers in stores are a hygiene problem. A code on the display can open a shade guide with swatches on different skin tones.
68feb7d017b3.text: 店内试用装存在卫生问题。陈列上的二维码可以打开色号指南,展示不同肤色上的试色。

a59fc1b8fe04.source: Link the empty container to your refill shop or take-back programme, the moment the customer is holding the empty.
a59fc1b8fe04.text: 在顾客手握空瓶的那一刻,把空容器链接到你的补充装商店或回收计划。

02a72c81035a.source: Embed the tutorial from YouTube or Vimeo on a fast mobile page; change the video for new launches without new packaging.
02a72c81035a.text: 将 YouTube 或 Vimeo 上的教程嵌入到加载快速的移动页面中;新品上市时更换视频即可,无需更换包装。

3a1702af5ae7.source: Swatches on a range of skin tones as a gallery, which shows a shade more honestly than the photo on the box.
3a1702af5ae7.text: 以图集形式展示不同肤色上的试色,比包装盒上的照片更真实地呈现色号。

9f08804f6854.text: 每个 SKU 一个动态链接

e4a7fb0864ec.source: One code per product points at its ingredient and safety page. Update the page when a formula changes and old stock still points at accurate information.
e4a7fb0864ec.text: 每个产品一个二维码,指向其成分和安全页面。配方变更时更新页面,库存中的旧包装仍然指向准确的信息。

db3e2758239b.source: On small packs, put the code on the outer carton or a flat side, not on a curved tube or cap.
db3e2758239b.text: 小包装请把二维码印在外包装盒或平整的一面，不要印在弧形的管身或瓶盖上。

0990b35eef3b.source: Metallic and holographic packaging confuses cameras. Print the code on a white or matte panel.
0990b35eef3b.text: 金属质感和镭射包装会干扰摄像头识别。请把二维码印在白色或哑光的区域。

0bc881346f94.source: Leave a quiet zone even on crowded packaging: four modules of blank space on every side, which matters more than an extra millimetre of code.
0bc881346f94.text: 即使包装上空间紧凑，也要留出静区：四周各留出四个模块宽度的空白，这比把二维码多放大一毫米更重要。

6368fab13c18.source: Export the code as vector (SVG or CMYK PDF) for the packaging printer; raster images get blurry at 2 cm.
6368fab13c18.text: 请以矢量格式（SVG 或 CMYK PDF）导出二维码交给包装印刷厂；位图在 2 cm 大小时会变模糊。

3cc55afefc2e.source: Scan for the full ingredient guide
3cc55afefc2e.text: 扫描查看完整成分指南

62c16c81fea5.source: Watch how to apply it in 30 seconds

8b547c24e54a.source: Empty? Scan to refill or recycle
8b547c24e54a.text: 用完了？扫描即可补充装或回收

db8888465b0e.source: Can a QR code replace the ingredient list on cosmetics?
db8888465b0e.text: 二维码可以代替化妆品上的成分表吗？

42fef7115408.source: Not in most markets. Regulations such as the EU Cosmetics Regulation require the ingredient list on the packaging itself. A QR code is a good place for the explanation and extra detail, not a substitute for mandatory labelling.
42fef7115408.text: 大多数市场都不行。欧盟化妆品法规等规定要求成分表必须印在包装上。二维码适合放说明和更多详细信息，但不能取代法定标签。

3db049a19e72.source: How small can a QR code on cosmetics packaging be?
3db049a19e72.text: 化妆品包装上的二维码最小可以做到多小？

05b6e61a3e7b.source: With a short link, about 2.3 cm works for a product held 20 cm from the phone, as long as each module stays above about 0.4 mm and there is a blank margin around it. Test with several phones on the printed proof.
05b6e61a3e7b.text: 使用短链接时，手机距离产品 20 cm 的情况下，约 2.3 cm 的尺寸就可以使用，前提是每个模块不小于约 0.4 mm，且二维码四周留有空白边距。请用多款手机测试印刷样张。

a31d9738f197.source: Can I see which products people scan most?
a31d9738f197.text: 我能看到哪些产品被扫描得最多吗？

9e24bc65f333.source: Yes, if each product has its own dynamic code. QRdx shows scans over time per code, plus countries, cities and devices, which tells you which products shoppers want to learn more about.
9e24bc65f333.text: 可以，前提是每个产品都有自己的动态二维码。QRdx 会按二维码显示扫描量随时间的变化，以及国家、城市和设备，让你了解顾客最想进一步了解哪些产品。

00555653a83d.source: QR codes for salons, barbers and spas
00555653a83d.text: 适用于美发沙龙、理发店和水疗的二维码

4827719a29f3.source: QR Codes for Salons, Barbers and Spas
4827719a29f3.text: 适用于美发沙龙、理发店和水疗的二维码

16436743a729.source: QR codes for salons and spas: rebook from the mirror, price lists, before-and-after galleries, reviews and tips. Placement ideas and CTA copy that converts.
16436743a729.text: 适用于美发沙龙和水疗的二维码：在镜前预约下次到店、价目表、前后对比作品集、评价和小费。附摆放位置建议和高转化的行动号召文案。

05b6703a3f98.source: Rebooking from the chair, price lists, portfolios and reviews.
05b6703a3f98.text: 在座位上预约下次到店、价目表、作品集和评价。

7161294e2753.source: The best moment to rebook a salon client is while they are still in the chair, looking at the result in the mirror. A code on the mirror or the station card that opens your booking page makes that a ten-second task instead of a phone call next month.
7161294e2753.text: 让沙龙顾客再次预约的最佳时机，就是他们还坐在座位上、对着镜子看效果的时候。在镜子或工位卡片上放一个能打开预约页面的二维码，十秒就能搞定，不用等到下个月再打电话。

1eabfe78d58a.source: Salons also live on their portfolio and their reviews. Codes at reception can send happy clients to your Google review box and curious ones to a gallery of recent work.
1eabfe78d58a.text: 沙龙也靠作品集和评价吸引顾客。前台的二维码可以把满意的顾客引到你的 Google 评价页面，把好奇的顾客引到近期作品集。

40d436f54626.source: A sticker on the mirror or the station that opens your booking page, ideally straight to that stylist's calendar.
40d436f54626.text: 在镜子或工位上贴一张贴纸，扫描后打开预约页面，最好直接进入该发型师的日程。

43c51ce2304b.source: A price list behind a dynamic code is easier to keep current than a printed board, and you can add seasonal treatments.
43c51ce2304b.text: 放在动态二维码背后的价目表，比印刷的价目牌更容易保持最新，还可以随时加入季节性项目。

69445fb43bfa.source: A gallery of cuts, colours and nails at reception sells add-ons better than describing them.
69445fb43bfa.text: 在前台展示发型、染发和美甲作品集，比口头介绍更能促成加购项目。

f4663fc742db.source: A review code at the till and a tip link for stylists, where your payment provider supports it.
f4663fc742db.text: 收银台放一个评价二维码，若支付服务商支持，还可为造型师提供小费链接。

9af7ae6362d1.source: If you book through Cal.com, each stylist can have a code that opens their own booking page.
9af7ae6362d1.text: 如果你通过 Cal.com 预约，每位造型师都可以有一个二维码，直接打开自己的预约页面。

37422ff7ed0e.source: Before-and-after photos in a gallery you refresh every week, behind one printed code at reception.
37422ff7ed0e.text: 前后对比照片放在每周更新的图库里，前台只需印一个二维码。

8eb84ece7b7e.source: Opens the review box directly. Ask every client the same way, whatever their visit was like.
8eb84ece7b7e.text: 直接打开评价框。无论顾客这次体验如何，都用同样的方式邀请他们评价。

73afdda6f082.source: Hours, address, services and contact buttons for a window or business-card code.
73afdda6f082.text: 营业时间、地址、服务项目和联系按钮，适合橱窗或名片上的二维码。

01f879d771bf.text: 坐着时的镜子或工位卡片

08cd77e6aa08.source: On mirrors, place the sticker in the lower corner the client can reach without leaning, and keep it out of the stylist's working area.
08cd77e6aa08.text: 贴在镜子上时，请把贴纸放在顾客不用探身就能够到的下角，并避开造型师的操作区域。

c7ffca07a77e.source: Mirror stickers are behind or on glass; use an opaque white backing so the reflection doesn't show through the light modules.
c7ffca07a77e.text: 镜面贴纸贴在玻璃背面或表面；请使用不透明的白色底衬，避免镜面反光透过浅色模块。

800b2db06dc7.source: Steam and hair products leave a film. Choose a wipeable laminate and clean the code with the mirror.
800b2db06dc7.text: 蒸汽和护发产品会留下一层薄膜。请选用可擦拭的覆膜，并在擦镜子时一并清洁二维码。

a048a1b993e8.source: Name the stylist next to the booking code if each station has its own.
a048a1b993e8.text: 如果每个工位都有自己的预约二维码，请在旁边注明造型师的名字。

81462e881815.source: Book your next visit before you go

36aa35cb5343.text: 看看我们最新的染发作品

e7e105fc8d1f.source: What's the best place for a booking QR code in a salon?
e7e105fc8d1f.text: 在美发沙龙里，预约二维码放在哪里最合适？

cef1c720d127.source: At the station, where clients see it while the stylist finishes. A second code at reception catches people waiting to pay. Both can point to the same booking page, but separate dynamic codes show which spot works better.
cef1c720d127.text: 放在工位上，造型师收尾时顾客就能看到。前台再放一个，可以覆盖等待结账的人。两个码可以指向同一个预约页面，但分别使用动态二维码，就能看出哪个位置效果更好。

15b2413321da.source: Can each stylist have their own QR code?
15b2413321da.text: 每位造型师可以有自己的二维码吗？

ada00fc554ba.source: Yes. Create a code per stylist that opens their booking page or a vCard Plus page with their portfolio. If a stylist leaves, repoint their codes to the salon's main page instead of throwing away printed cards.
ada00fc554ba.text: 可以。为每位造型师创建一个二维码，打开其预约页面或带有作品集的 vCard Plus 页面。如果造型师离职，把他们的二维码改指向沙龙主页即可，不必丢掉已印好的卡片。

9bd068397284.source: Will a QR code sticker on a mirror scan?
9bd068397284.text: 贴在镜子上的二维码贴纸能扫描吗？

2d64ef716fe5.source: Yes, if it has an opaque backing. A clear sticker lets the mirror reflect through the light modules and confuses the camera.
2d64ef716fe5.text: 能，前提是带有不透明底衬。透明贴纸会让镜子的反光透过浅色模块，干扰摄像头。

069cd82680cb.source: QR codes for gyms and fitness studios
069cd82680cb.text: 健身房和健身工作室的二维码

1e87558db16c.source: QR Codes for Gyms and Fitness Studios
1e87558db16c.text: 健身房和健身工作室二维码

cda1719cd32a.source: QR codes for gyms: exercise videos on every machine, class timetables, check-in, membership sign-ups and feedback. Sizing for equipment and wall signs.
cda1719cd32a.text: 健身房二维码：每台器械上的锻炼视频、课程表、签到、会员注册和反馈。含器械和墙面标牌的尺寸建议。

5974191fb8ec.source: Machine tutorials, class timetables, check-in and trial sign-ups.
5974191fb8ec.text: 器械教程、课程表、签到和体验课报名。

828b2d7db252.source: Every gym has members who walk past a machine because they don't know how to use it. A code on the machine that opens a 40-second demonstration video fixes that without a trainer, and helps prevent injuries from bad form.
828b2d7db252.text: 每家健身房都有会员因为不知道怎么用而从器械旁走过。在器械上放一个二维码，打开 40 秒的示范视频，不需要教练就能解决这个问题，还有助于避免动作不规范造成的受伤。

4ffda6f35291.source: Timetables change every term and class instructors swap shifts, so the timetable code belongs behind a dynamic link too. Studios that run trials can put a sign-up code on flyers and the front window.
4ffda6f35291.text: 课程表每学期都会变，教练也会换班，所以课程表二维码同样应该放在动态链接之后。开设体验课的工作室可以把报名二维码印在传单和前窗上。

e408b112e545.source: A video per machine, linked from a sticker at eye level when seated or standing at the station.
e408b112e545.text: 每台器械对应一段视频，通过贴在器械旁的贴纸链接，无论坐着还是站着使用，贴纸都在视线高度。

9842d8cc089e.source: A code in the changing rooms and at reception that opens the current timetable with booking links.
9842d8cc089e.text: 放在更衣室和前台的二维码，扫描后打开当前课程表，并附带预约链接。

fd91dfb01ba4.source: Flyers and window decals that open a trial-pass form, with separate codes per campaign to see which one works.
fd91dfb01ba4.text: 传单和橱窗贴纸扫描后打开试练券申请表单，每个推广活动使用不同的二维码，以便了解哪种效果更好。

ee4410f9ba0f.source: A short form behind each machine's code lets members flag a problem, and because every machine has its own code, you know which one it is.
ee4410f9ba0f.text: 每台器械的二维码后面是一份简短的表单，会员可以用它反馈问题。由于每台器械都有各自的二维码，你能直接知道是哪一台出了问题。

b32d0fb04019.source: One page per machine with the demonstration video and safety notes. Swap the video when equipment changes.
b32d0fb04019.text: 每台器械一个页面，包含示范视频和安全提示。器械更换时，替换视频即可。

9cff74de88b9.source: Fault reports and class feedback, with a separate form per machine or class so you know exactly what is wrong.
9cff74de88b9.text: 用于故障报告和课程反馈，每台器械或每门课程使用单独的表单，让你准确了解问题所在。

c20c4348189f.source: Dynamic link to your class timetable
c20c4348189f.text: 指向课程表的动态链接

0b6e02fa95b4.source: Points at whatever booking system you use this year, so posters survive a software change.
0b6e02fa95b4.text: 无论你今年使用哪种预约系统，它都会指向对应页面，所以更换软件后海报依然有效。

0bce9e6b99f8.source: Put machine stickers where the member's eyes are while using it, not on the base or behind the seat.
0bce9e6b99f8.text: 器械贴纸要贴在会员使用时目光所及的位置，而不是底座上或座椅后面。

285a5a718a17.source: Sweat and cleaning spray wear stickers out. Use a wipe-clean laminate and check them during monthly maintenance.
285a5a718a17.text: 汗水和清洁喷剂会磨损贴纸。请使用可擦拭的覆膜，并在每月维护时检查。

1267ed125084.source: Phones come out between sets, so codes at the water fountain and stretching area get scanned more than ones by the door.
1267ed125084.text: 会员会在两组训练之间拿出手机，所以饮水机旁和拉伸区的二维码比门口的更常被扫描。

4aaa84c748e7.source: Gym lighting is bright but harsh; matte finishes avoid hot spots on the code.
4aaa84c748e7.text: 健身房灯光明亮但刺眼，哑光材质可以避免二维码出现反光亮斑。

74e016a51a94.source: New to this machine? Watch the 40-second demo
74e016a51a94.text: 第一次用这台器械？观看 40 秒示范视频

09852efd3f2f.source: Try us free for a week

c2a3eb88226a.source: Something broken? Tell us in 20 seconds
c2a3eb88226a.text: 器械出故障了？20 秒告诉我们

ca7891c4dd5a.source: Should every gym machine have its own QR code?
ca7891c4dd5a.text: 健身房的每台器械都应该有自己的二维码吗？

46f5d3bbbfb7.source: Yes. A separate code per machine opens the right video and lets fault reports name the machine automatically. Scan counts per code also show which equipment members are unsure about.
46f5d3bbbfb7.text: 是的。每台器械使用单独的二维码，可以打开对应的视频，故障报告也能自动标明是哪台器械。每个二维码的扫描次数还能显示会员对哪些器械不太熟悉。

0392a1b2385c.source: Can I change the video behind a QR code later?
0392a1b2385c.text: 以后可以更换二维码背后的视频吗？

fa73fb0d4962.source: With a dynamic code or a hosted video page, yes. Replace the video or link and the sticker on the machine keeps working.
fa73fb0d4962.text: 使用动态二维码或托管的视频页面就可以。替换视频或链接后，器械上的贴纸依然有效。

16665eef36f5.source: Can members check in with a QR code?
16665eef36f5.text: 会员可以用二维码签到吗？

3fbf8bb19b89.source: Check-in usually runs through your membership software, which generates its own member codes. QRdx is better suited to the codes around the gym: videos, timetables, forms and sign-ups.
3fbf8bb19b89.text: 签到通常通过你的会员管理软件完成，该软件会生成自己的会员码。QRdx 更适合用于健身房里的其他二维码：视频、课程表、表单和报名。

5c6161fc39c6.source: QR codes for car dealerships and garages
5c6161fc39c6.text: 汽车经销商和维修店的二维码

a4baa2536b34.source: QR Codes for Car Dealers and Auto Repair
a4baa2536b34.text: 适用于汽车经销商和汽车维修的二维码

97264f9a574c.source: QR codes for car dealerships and garages: window-sticker specs and walkaround videos, test-drive booking, service reminders and reviews, with sizing tips.
97264f9a574c.text: 汽车经销商和维修店的二维码:车窗标签参数与实拍视频、试驾预约、保养提醒和评价,并附尺寸建议。

8e2a00e96fb3.source: Window-sticker specs, walkaround videos, test drives and service history.
8e2a00e96fb3.text: 车窗标签参数、实拍视频、试驾和保养记录。

2b9c939f5758.source: Car lots are full of people browsing after hours, reading window stickers through the glass. A QR code on each vehicle's window card can open the full spec sheet, a walkaround video and a test-drive booking form, any time of day.
2b9c939f5758.text: 车场里常有人在下班后闲逛,隔着玻璃看车窗标签。每辆车的车窗卡片上放一个二维码,就能随时打开完整的参数表、实拍视频和试驾预约表单。

55e4246f85de.source: Garages and service centers use codes differently: on the key tag, the invoice and the service sticker on the windscreen, to bring the customer back for the next service and leave a review for this one.
55e4246f85de.text: 维修店和服务中心则用在别处:钥匙牌、账单和挡风玻璃上的保养贴纸,既能让客户回来做下一次保养,也能请他们为这一次服务留下评价。

a0145a651ddf.source: Link each window card to the vehicle listing with history, options and finance examples. When the car sells, repoint the code to similar stock.
a0145a651ddf.text: 将每张车窗卡片链接到车辆详情页,包含车史、配置和贷款示例。车辆售出后,把二维码改指向同类库存即可。

27623228d2e2.source: A test-drive request form. Use one per model or vehicle so the sales team knows which car the lead is about.
27623228d2e2.text: 试驾申请表单。每个车型或每辆车使用一个,销售团队就能知道线索对应的是哪辆车。

b1e5076139c1.source: A windscreen sticker or key tag that opens your booking page when the next service is due.
b1e5076139c1.text: 挡风玻璃贴纸或钥匙牌,在下次保养到期时打开您的预约页面。

bc7547f57d8a.source: A review code on the invoice or handover pack catches the customer on delivery day.
bc7547f57d8a.text: 把评价二维码放在账单或交车资料袋上,在提车当天就能触达客户。

91a0ead78e74.source: Each window card opens that car's listing; after the sale, change the destination to related stock and reuse the card.
91a0ead78e74.text: 每张车窗卡片打开对应车辆的详情页;车辆售出后,把目标地址改为相关库存,卡片即可重复使用。

cbf5c7a4c913.source: A walkaround video of the actual car, which sells used cars better than stock photos.
cbf5c7a4c913.text: 实车的实拍视频,比图库照片更能帮助卖出二手车。

fc03b1222cbd.source: Test-drive and service enquiry forms that arrive in your dashboard, with responses exportable as CSV.
fc03b1222cbd.text: 试驾和保养咨询表单,提交内容会进入您的控制台,回复可导出为 CSV。

005c9eb45c4c.source: On the invoice and key tag, sending customers straight to the review box.
005c9eb45c4c.text: 放在账单和钥匙牌上,让客户直接进入评价页面。

598ea4cc4a4f.source: Window cards are read through tinted glass at an angle. Print the code larger than you think, and test through the actual window.
598ea4cc4a4f.text: 车窗卡片通常是斜着透过贴膜玻璃来看的。二维码要比您想象的印得更大,并且要隔着实际的车窗测试。

9b26ac98acbf.source: Sun-facing cards fade in weeks; use UV-resistant inks or swap the cards, since dynamic codes make the card itself reusable.
9b26ac98acbf.text: 朝阳的卡片几周就会褪色;请使用抗紫外线油墨,或定期更换卡片,因为动态二维码让卡片本身可以重复使用。

282b0a1f609a.source: Put the vehicle's stock number as text next to the code for staff and for people who don't scan.
282b0a1f609a.text: 在二维码旁以文字标出车辆的库存编号,方便员工查看,也方便不扫描的人。

49893929f6dc.source: On forecourt signs, keep the code at eye height for people walking the lot rather than on the top banner.
49893929f6dc.text: 在车场标牌上,请把二维码放在方便逛车场的人平视的高度,而不是顶部横幅上。

10d10b9ed21f.source: Scan for full specs and a walkaround video
10d10b9ed21f.text: 扫描查看完整参数和实拍视频

2fedaa673fa6.source: Book a test drive of this car

e34afaf563e3.source: Service due? Book in one minute
e34afaf563e3.text: 该保养了?一分钟即可预约

8a223d6d741e.source: How did we do? Leave a review
8a223d6d741e.text: 我们做得如何?请留下评价

4edee9056be9.source: What happens to a car's QR code after it's sold?
4edee9056be9.text: 车辆售出后，它的二维码会怎样？

168e13186946.source: With a dynamic code, change its destination to similar stock or your inventory page and keep using the card on another vehicle. Static codes would keep pointing at a sold listing.
168e13186946.text: 如果用的是动态二维码，可以把目标地址改成同类库存或您的库存页面，这张卡片就能继续用在另一辆车上。静态二维码则会一直指向已售出的车辆信息。

afc7a543539a.source: Will a QR code scan through a car window?
afc7a543539a.text: 二维码能隔着车窗扫描吗？

d4b1885c64e3.source: Usually, but tint and reflections reduce contrast. Use a larger code with strong contrast, place the card flat against the glass, and test from outside in daylight.
d4b1885c64e3.text: 通常可以，但车窗贴膜和反光会降低对比度。请使用尺寸较大、对比度高的二维码，把卡片平贴在玻璃上，并在白天从车外测试。

142567b8dd45.source: Can I see which cars get the most interest?
142567b8dd45.text: 我能看到哪些车最受关注吗？

dc5f91617688.source: Yes. With one dynamic code per vehicle, QRdx shows scans per code over time, including after-hours scans by people walking the lot.
dc5f91617688.text: 可以。为每辆车使用一个动态二维码，QRdx 会显示每个二维码随时间变化的扫描次数，也包括在营业时间之外、在停车场看车的人的扫描。

708eee9c12ec.source: Guest information, audio guides, schedules, tickets and RSVPs.
708eee9c12ec.text: 宾客信息、语音导览、日程、票务与回执登记。

aa8901fb9c77.source: QR codes for hotels and guesthouses

a5ed839f4a29.source: QR Codes for Hotels: Wi-Fi, Guest Info and Reviews
a5ed839f4a29.text: 酒店二维码：Wi-Fi、宾客信息与评价

64f3ea9b1421.source: How hotels use QR codes for Wi-Fi, digital compendiums, room service menus, local guides, checkout feedback and reviews, with sizes for rooms and lobbies.
64f3ea9b1421.text: 了解酒店如何用二维码提供 Wi-Fi、电子宾客指南、客房送餐菜单、本地指南、退房反馈和评价，并附适用于客房和大堂的尺寸建议。

b95585f0c27f.source: In-room Wi-Fi, a digital guest compendium, room service and reviews.
b95585f0c27f.text: 客房 Wi-Fi、电子宾客指南、客房送餐与评价。

770a865d3232.source: The printed guest compendium in a hotel room goes out of date the week it is printed: the spa hours change, the restaurant gets a new menu, the shuttle schedule moves. A QR code on the desk card that opens a hosted guide lets housekeeping stop replacing binders and lets guests read it in their own time.
770a865d3232.text: 客房里的纸质宾客指南印出来不到一周就过时了：水疗时间变了，餐厅换了新菜单，接驳车时刻表也调整了。书桌卡片上的二维码可以打开托管页面中的指南，客房部不用再换文件夹，客人也可以随时慢慢阅读。

36c21097b268.source: The other codes every hotel needs are simpler: Wi-Fi in every room and at reception, and a review request at checkout. Wi-Fi works as a free static code; reviews and the guide work better as dynamic codes you can measure.
36c21097b268.text: 酒店需要的其他二维码更简单：每个房间和前台的 Wi-Fi，以及退房时的评价邀请。Wi-Fi 用免费的静态二维码即可；评价和指南则更适合用可统计数据的动态二维码。
