3ddbf5427005.text: Google 评价不可以：Google 禁止有奖励的评价。可以改为为注册会员或填写问卷提供折扣，而征求评价时不附带任何奖励。

7e0b11be6f64.source: QR codes on store shelves and shelf talkers
7e0b11be6f64.text: 商店货架和货架标牌上的二维码

c2b796da1fb2.source: QR Codes on Shelf Talkers and Shelf Tags
c2b796da1fb2.text: 货架标牌和货架标签上的二维码

5d138076ae01.source: QR codes on shelf talkers and shelf-edge labels: product details, reviews, recipes and offers in the aisle, with sizes that scan and per-shelf tracking.
5d138076ae01.text: 货架标牌和货架边缘标签上的二维码：在过道里查看产品详情、评价、食谱和优惠，附可扫描的尺寸建议和按货架统计的追踪。

c4c26fb4d1a6.source: Product details, reviews and recipes from the shelf edge.
c4c26fb4d1a6.text: 从货架边缘查看产品详情、评价和食谱。

704513182d0f.source: Shelf talkers and shelf-edge labels catch shoppers at the exact moment of choice. A QR code there can answer the question that makes or breaks the sale: is this vegan, how does it compare, what do I cook with it?
704513182d0f.text: 货架标牌和货架边缘标签能在购物者做选择的那一刻抓住他们。那里的二维码可以回答决定成交与否的问题：这个是纯素的吗，和其他产品相比如何，用它可以做什么菜？

82b0df071e4f.source: Shelf strips are small and seen at an angle, often under bright, flat lighting. Codes need to be compact but generous with contrast.
82b0df071e4f.text: 货架标条很小，而且通常是从斜角看到的，还常处在明亮、平淡的灯光下。二维码需要小巧紧凑，但对比度要充足。

723438d432cd.source: A talker that opens a comparison of the range on that shelf.
723438d432cd.text: 打开该货架上系列产品对比的标牌。

a32fcec54a2f.source: Ratings and reviews from your website or marketplace listing.
a32fcec54a2f.text: 来自你的网站或电商平台商品页的评分和评价。

38c681775272.source: Grocery and wine shelves that open recipes or pairing suggestions.
38c681775272.text: 可打开食谱或搭配建议的食品杂货和葡萄酒货架。

185f307d18c8.source: A coupon page for a multi-buy or a sample offer.
185f307d18c8.text: 多件优惠或试用装优惠的优惠券页面。

b1134f3d45f7.source: Dynamic code per shelf or bay
b1134f3d45f7.text: 每个货架或货位一个动态二维码

794cb4fb6a89.source: Measure which shelves get scanned and repoint them when the planogram changes.
794cb4fb6a89.text: 统计哪些货架被扫描，并在陈列图调整时重新指向新的链接。

d952e8e9a7e1.source: Offers with a scannable barcode for the till, and validity dates.
d952e8e9a7e1.text: 优惠附带可供收银台扫描的条形码，并标明有效期。

15486fdb9627.source: Short demos for products that need explaining.
15486fdb9627.text: 为需要讲解的产品提供简短演示。

b899ddfadb1f.source: Place codes at eye or chest height; bottom-shelf codes rarely get scanned.
b899ddfadb1f.text: 将二维码放在与视线或胸口齐平的位置；最底层货架上的二维码很少有人扫描。

bba444c0ae4f.source: Keep the code on a white panel, separate from the price and the barcode.
bba444c0ae4f.text: 让二维码置于白色底板上，与价格和条形码分开。

2d37d127537a.source: Shelf-edge strips are narrow; a talker that sticks out from the shelf gives more room and catches the eye.
2d37d127537a.text: 货架边缘的价签条很窄；从货架上伸出的展示牌空间更大，也更吸引目光。

2fa047b2f619.source: Check retailer guidelines: many stores control what can be placed on their shelves.
2fa047b2f619.text: 请查阅零售商的规定：许多门店会管控货架上可以放置的内容。

9c1da480bcc9.source: Not sure which one? Compare here
9c1da480bcc9.text: 拿不准选哪个？点此对比

35884777fd05.source: How big should a QR code be on a shelf talker?
35884777fd05.text: 货架展示牌上的二维码应该多大？

837f173d0fdb.source: About 6 cm at arm's length with a short link, more if shoppers read it from the aisle. Leave white space around it.
837f173d0fdb.text: 链接较短、一臂距离查看时约 6 厘米；如果顾客要在通道上扫描，则需要更大。二维码周围请留出空白。

c2f3bcf5aff8.source: Can I track which shelves get scanned?
c2f3bcf5aff8.text: 我可以追踪哪些货架被扫描吗？

a6dc80629dfa.source: Yes, with one dynamic code per shelf or bay. Scans are counted per code with time and device, so you can compare locations and stores.
a6dc80629dfa.text: 可以，为每个货架或货位使用一个动态二维码即可。每个二维码的扫描次数会连同时间和设备一并统计，方便你对比不同位置和门店。

e6ab07a2a977.source: Do retailers allow brand QR codes on shelves?
e6ab07a2a977.text: 零售商允许在货架上放置品牌二维码吗？

ddf2430bbea8.source: It depends on the retailer. Many control shelf materials through their own programmes; agree it with the category manager first.
ddf2430bbea8.text: 视零售商而定。许多零售商通过自己的项目管理货架物料；请先与品类经理确认。

920c52b0a1d9.source: QR Code Window Decals for Shops and Offices
920c52b0a1d9.text: 适用于商店和办公室的二维码橱窗贴

aea31288ce31.source: QR code window decals: sizes that scan from the pavement, inside vs outside mounting, glare and contrast tips, and what to link to after closing time.
aea31288ce31.text: 二维码橱窗贴：人行道上也能扫描的尺寸、贴在内侧还是外侧、眩光与对比度技巧，以及打烊后该链接到哪里。

89cd4b2d7025.source: Pavement-distance sizing, glare control and after-hours links.
89cd4b2d7025.text: 按人行道距离确定尺寸、控制眩光，以及打烊后的链接。

10ada3128aaa.source: Shop windows work around the clock. A QR code decal lets passers-by act when you're closed: browse the shop, book a table, see the menu or the listing in the window.
10ada3128aaa.text: 商店橱窗全天候都在发挥作用。二维码橱窗贴让路人在你打烊时也能行动：浏览商店、预订餐位、查看菜单或橱窗里展示的房源。

cf6b0d0c78db.source: Windows also bring the hardest scanning conditions: reflections, sunlight from behind the viewer, and glass between the camera and the code. Size, mounting and contrast decide whether the decal works.
cf6b0d0c78db.text: 橱窗也是扫描条件最苛刻的地方：反光、背对观看者的阳光，以及摄像头与二维码之间隔着的玻璃。尺寸、粘贴方式和对比度决定橱窗贴能否发挥作用。

74190730d4d3.source: Opens the online shop or the product in the display.
74190730d4d3.text: 打开网店，或橱窗展示的商品页面。

81c25cf6b036.source: A business page with hours, phone and directions for visitors who arrive at a closed door.
81c25cf6b036.text: 提供营业时间、电话和路线的商家页面，方便遇到店门已关的访客。

853d0a8d58a0.source: Restaurants, salons and clinics can take bookings from the window.
853d0a8d58a0.text: 餐厅、美容美发店和诊所可以直接在橱窗前接受预订。

78323499167c.source: Estate agents and car dealers can link each card in the window to its listing.
78323499167c.text: 房产中介和汽车经销商可以让橱窗里的每张展示卡片对应各自的房源或车源页面。

e80eade1f34c.source: Hours, address, contact buttons and amenities, updated for holidays.
e80eade1f34c.text: 营业时间、地址、联系按钮和配套设施，节假日可随时更新。

699702404679.source: Dynamic link for the current window display
699702404679.text: 指向当前橱窗展示内容的动态链接

58d4a6da84b3.source: Repoint the decal when you change the display, without a new decal.
58d4a6da84b3.text: 更换橱窗展示时，直接修改贴纸指向的链接，无需重新制作贴纸。

ea92f7d5af3f.source: Booking, menu and socials on one page behind one decal.
ea92f7d5af3f.text: 预订、菜单和社交账号集中在一个页面，只需一张贴纸。

23f5c57952f3.source: Mount on the inside of the glass with an opaque white backing, so the code doesn't show the shop behind it.
23f5c57952f3.text: 贴在玻璃内侧，并使用不透明的白色底衬，这样二维码不会透出后面的店内景象。

de6aaab6fccb.source: From the pavement, about 2 m, the code needs to be around 23 cm wide.
de6aaab6fccb.text: 在人行道上约 2 米的距离扫描，二维码宽度需要达到约 23 厘米。

b2718b70d28c.source: South-facing windows get glare; matte vinyl and a position out of direct sun help.
b2718b70d28c.text: 朝南的窗户容易反光；选用哑光贴膜，并避开阳光直射的位置，会有帮助。

30fd6aaf4424.source: Put the decal at 1.2 to 1.5 m off the ground and add a line saying what scanning gets you.
30fd6aaf4424.text: 贴纸的位置距地面 1.2 到 1.5 米，并加一句话说明扫描后能看到什么。

d5f741d4a6e2.source: We're closed, but our shop isn't
d5f741d4a6e2.text: 我们关门了，但网店还开着

f4b2e3cf9ad2.source: Should a window QR code go inside or outside the glass?
f4b2e3cf9ad2.text: 橱窗二维码应该贴在玻璃内侧还是外侧？

224ad91b9806.source: Inside, facing out, with a white opaque backing. It's protected from weather and vandalism, and the backing stops the shop interior showing through.
224ad91b9806.text: 贴在内侧，朝向外面，并配上白色不透明底衬。这样可以防风雨和人为破坏，底衬还能挡住店内景象，避免透出来。

53a4c9be54a9.source: How big should a window QR code be?

bca5fda91052.source: About 23 cm for people on the pavement 2 m away; about 7 cm on a door where people stand close. Test in daylight and at night.
bca5fda91052.text: 对于站在 2 米外人行道上的人，约 23 厘米；贴在人们会靠近站立的门上，约 7 厘米。请在白天和夜间分别测试。

064566e30fef.source: Do QR codes scan through glass?
064566e30fef.text: 二维码能隔着玻璃扫描吗？

3467b454875f.source: Yes, if the glass is clean and the code has strong contrast. Tinted or reflective glass reduces contrast; make the code larger and test from outside.
3467b454875f.text: 可以，前提是玻璃干净，且二维码对比度足够高。有色玻璃或反光玻璃会降低对比度；请把二维码做大一些，并在外面测试。

004df4cbc379.source: Invoices, certificates, tickets, badges, envelopes and books.
004df4cbc379.text: 发票、证书、票券、证件、信封和书籍。

34c847f191dc.source: QR Codes on Invoices: Payment Links and UPI
34c847f191dc.text: 发票上的二维码：付款链接与 UPI

c59b4a11ae1f.source: QR codes on invoices: pay-by-scan with UPI or PayPal, links to the online invoice, contact cards and feedback, and where regulated invoice QR standards apply.
c59b4a11ae1f.text: 发票上的二维码：通过 UPI 或 PayPal 扫码付款、在线发票链接、名片和反馈，以及适用法定发票二维码标准的情况。

948e3795700e.source: Pay-by-scan with UPI or PayPal, online invoices and contact details.
948e3795700e.text: 通过 UPI 或 PayPal 扫码付款，查看在线发票和联系方式。

82525497bc65.source: The fastest way to get an invoice paid is to remove typing. A payment QR code lets the customer pay from their phone in seconds instead of copying account numbers or UPI IDs from a PDF.
82525497bc65.text: 让发票尽快收款的最好办法，就是省去手动输入。付款二维码能让客户在几秒内用手机完成支付，不必再从 PDF 中复制账号或 UPI ID。

62354c24b44c.source: Some countries have their own regulated invoice QR formats, such as the Swiss QR-bill or e-invoicing QR codes required by tax authorities, which your accounting software generates. QRdx is for the other codes on an invoice: payment links, the online copy and your contact details.
62354c24b44c.text: 有些国家有自己的法定发票二维码格式，例如瑞士 QR-bill，或税务机关要求的电子发票二维码，这些都由您的会计软件生成。QRdx 适用于发票上的其他二维码：付款链接、在线副本和您的联系方式。

620025d22b32.source: In India, a UPI code with the amount filled in lets customers pay from any UPI app.
620025d22b32.text: 在印度，填好金额的 UPI 二维码可让客户使用任意 UPI 应用付款。

5114090de7ef.source: A code that opens your PayPal.Me or card-payment page with the amount.
5114090de7ef.text: 打开您的 PayPal.Me 或银行卡付款页面，并带有金额的二维码。

f9b576c7869a.source: A code on paper invoices that opens the customer portal with the invoice and statement.
f9b576c7869a.text: 印在纸质发票上的二维码，可打开客户门户，查看发票和对账单。

56a72bc0d629.source: Tradespeople and agencies can add a review or feedback code to the final invoice.
56a72bc0d629.text: 工匠和服务机构可以在最终发票上添加评价或反馈二维码。

4d273e7085ff.source: Encodes your UPI ID, payee name and an optional amount and note. Free, static, and the money never passes through QRdx.
4d273e7085ff.text: 编码您的 UPI ID、收款人姓名，以及可选的金额和备注。免费、静态，资金不会经过 QRdx。

ba3c8b66c271.source: Opens your PayPal.Me link, optionally with the amount.
ba3c8b66c271.text: 打开您的 PayPal.Me 链接，可选择附带金额。

ecc0613db67d.source: Your accounts contact as a Save contact card, for clients who need to reach billing.
ecc0613db67d.text: 将您的财务联系人作为保存联系人名片，方便需要联系账务部门的客户。

7c1ef052d93f.text: 屏幕上的 PDF 发票

3ad6cd3bb13d.source: Put the payment code next to the amount due and the due date, not in the footer.
3ad6cd3bb13d.text: 把付款二维码放在应付金额和到期日旁边，而不是页脚。

c97f6a9f5522.source: If the amount differs per invoice, generate a code per invoice; for a fixed amount, one code works.
c97f6a9f5522.text: 如果每张发票金额不同，请为每张发票生成一个二维码；金额固定的话，一个二维码就够了。

fa94d0562562.source: Tell customers what the code does ('Scan to pay ₹4,500 by UPI') so they trust it.
fa94d0562562.text: 告诉客户二维码的用途（“扫码通过 UPI 支付 ₹4,500”），让他们更放心。

b387787e5da5.source: Use your accounting software for legally required invoice QR formats; don't replace them with a generic code.
b387787e5da5.text: 法律要求的发票二维码格式请使用您的会计软件生成，不要用通用二维码代替。

9e1b66a27753.source: Scan to pay with any UPI app
9e1b66a27753.text: 使用任意 UPI 应用扫码付款

75e2169af47d.source: Can I put a UPI QR code on my invoice?
75e2169af47d.text: 可以在发票上放 UPI 二维码吗？

094f19852d71.source: Yes. Generate a UPI code with your UPI ID, name and the amount, and add it to the invoice. Customers pay from any UPI app, and the payment goes straight to your account.
094f19852d71.text: 可以。使用你的 UPI ID、名称和金额生成 UPI 二维码，再添加到发票上。客户可以用任意 UPI 应用付款，款项会直接进入你的账户。

2274b78d1f37.source: Does QRdx make Swiss QR-bills or e-invoice QR codes?
2274b78d1f37.text: QRdx 能生成瑞士 QR-bill 或电子发票二维码吗？

b402cefe7736.source: No. Those formats are defined by banks or tax authorities and are generated by accounting and e-invoicing software. Use QRdx for payment links, contact cards and online invoice links.
b402cefe7736.text: 不能。这些格式由银行或税务机构规定，需要用会计和电子发票软件生成。QRdx 可用于生成付款链接、名片和在线发票链接。

3703d2d15ead.source: Is a payment QR code on an invoice safe?
3703d2d15ead.text: 发票上的付款二维码安全吗？

306adcd902cd.source: It is as safe as printing your account details, with fewer typos. Customers should check the payee name their app shows before paying, so make sure it matches your business name.
306adcd902cd.text: 它和直接印上账户信息一样安全，而且更不容易出错。客户付款前应核对应用中显示的收款方名称，所以请确保它与你的企业名称一致。

cf7c1001ec19.source: QR Codes on Certificates for Verification
cf7c1001ec19.text: 证书上的二维码：用于验证真伪

d10a33f847bd.source: QR codes on certificates: verification pages that prove a certificate is genuine, revocation, digital copies and course links, with bulk creation tips.
d10a33f847bd.text: 证书上的二维码：可证明证书真实性的验证页面、撤销、电子副本和课程链接，并附批量创建技巧。

8c377a953c35.source: Verification pages, revocation and digital copies for each certificate.
8c377a953c35.text: 为每份证书提供验证页面、撤销和电子副本。

5c6ce2057929.source: A printed certificate is easy to fake. A QR code that opens a verification page on the issuer's own domain lets an employer or customer check, in one scan, that the certificate is real and still valid.
5c6ce2057929.text: 纸质证书很容易伪造。二维码可打开颁发机构自有域名上的验证页面，让雇主或客户扫描一次就能确认证书是真实的，并且仍然有效。

9becd79e8e86.source: That works best with one dynamic code per certificate, created in bulk from your records. If a certificate is revoked, pause or repoint its code; the paper stays in circulation, but the scan tells the truth.
9becd79e8e86.text: 最好为每份证书使用一个动态二维码，并根据你的记录批量创建。如果某份证书被撤销，可以暂停该二维码或将其重新指向其他页面；纸质证书虽然仍在流通，但扫描结果会呈现真实情况。

91b350f60bc3.source: Each certificate's code opens a page on your domain with the holder's name, the qualification and the date.
91b350f60bc3.text: 每份证书的二维码都会打开你域名下的页面，显示持有人姓名、资质和日期。

5f760141f983.source: Pause the code of a revoked certificate, or repoint it to a 'no longer valid' page.
5f760141f983.text: 暂停已撤销证书的二维码，或将其重新指向“已失效”页面。

cf867da5dfee.source: A link to the PDF original so the holder can share it on LinkedIn or with employers.
cf867da5dfee.text: 链接到 PDF 原件，方便持有人在 LinkedIn 上分享或发给雇主。

69f27da4a4f3.source: Training providers can link to the course page or the next level.
69f27da4a4f3.text: 培训机构可以链接到课程页面或下一级课程。

3c03ead2f29e.text: 每份证书一个动态二维码

f3d4660785dc.source: Create codes in bulk through the API, one per certificate, so each verification link can be updated or revoked on its own.
f3d4660785dc.text: 通过 API 批量创建二维码，每份证书一个，这样每个验证链接都可以单独更新或撤销。

3f733a0ea3d0.source: The certificate as a downloadable PDF, replaceable if you reissue it.
3f733a0ea3d0.text: 可下载的 PDF 证书，重新颁发时可以替换。

a5642973f820.source: For training providers: open your company page so holders can tag you.
a5642973f820.text: 适用于培训机构：打开贵公司的主页，方便持有人标记你们。

91c0f52f6658.source: Use your own verification system for the data; the QR code only needs to link to it.
91c0f52f6658.text: 数据请使用你自己的验证系统；二维码只需链接到该系统即可。

2f7bc555d773.source: A custom domain makes a verification link more convincing than a generic short link.
2f7bc555d773.text: 与通用短链接相比，自定义域名能让验证链接更可信。

0a20e8280e61.source: On framed certificates read from a metre away, the code needs to be about 12 cm; for in-hand checks, 4 cm is enough.
0a20e8280e61.text: 装裱的证书如果要在一米外查看，二维码需要约 12 cm；如果是拿在手里核验，4 cm 就够了。

6002528d7346.source: Don't encode personal data in the URL; use an opaque ID.
6002528d7346.text: 不要在网址中编码个人数据，请使用不透明的 ID。

87934d3c3297.source: How do QR codes verify certificates?

26f7e319f29f.source: The code opens a page on the issuer's domain that confirms the certificate's details. A forger can copy the code, but not change what the issuer's page says.
26f7e319f29f.text: 二维码会打开签发方域名下的页面，确认证书的详细信息。伪造者可以复制二维码，却无法更改签发方页面上的内容。

c12a1bad2c2e.source: Can I create QR codes for thousands of certificates?
c12a1bad2c2e.text: 我可以为数千份证书创建二维码吗？

16e42bc540ee.source: Yes. Use the REST API to create dynamic codes in bulk on a paid plan, or the bulk generator for static codes from a CSV.
16e42bc540ee.text: 可以。在付费套餐中使用 REST API 批量创建动态二维码，或者使用批量生成器，通过 CSV 生成静态二维码。

99c1279c162c.source: What happens if a certificate is revoked?

b432befdac79.source: Pause its dynamic code or repoint it. Paused codes open your fallback URL or a neutral 'this campaign has ended' page, never a QRdx advert.
b432befdac79.text: 暂停它的动态二维码，或者改指向其他地址。已暂停的二维码会打开你的备用网址，或一个中性的“此活动已结束”页面，绝不会出现 QRdx 的广告。

ed84645b5711.source: QR Codes on Event Tickets and Passes
ed84645b5711.text: 活动门票和通行证上的二维码

30dbe76e4567.source: QR codes on tickets and passes: venue maps, schedules, parking and travel info alongside the entry code, with what QR codes can and can't do for entry.
30dbe76e4567.text: 门票和通行证上的二维码：在入场码旁提供场馆地图、日程、停车和出行信息，并说明二维码在入场方面能做什么、不能做什么。

98d0d570f529.source: Venue info, schedules and parking beside the entry code.
98d0d570f529.text: 在入场码旁提供场馆信息、日程和停车信息。

0334fa596a4e.source: The QR code on a ticket that gets you through the gate comes from your ticketing system: it's unique per ticket and checked against a database when scanned. QRdx doesn't issue or validate entry codes.
0334fa596a4e.text: 门票上让你通过闸机的二维码来自你的票务系统：每张票都是唯一的，扫描时会与数据库核对。QRdx 不签发也不验证入场码。

c38c8887b3a4.source: What QRdx is good for is the second code on the ticket, poster or wristband: the venue map, the set times, parking and transport, the bag policy. That information changes on the day, so it belongs behind a dynamic code.
c38c8887b3a4.text: QRdx 擅长的是门票、海报或腕带上的第二个二维码：场馆地图、演出时间、停车与交通、包袋规定。这些信息会在当天发生变化，所以适合放在动态二维码后面。

7c0200611c68.source: A code on the ticket or wristband that opens today's schedule and the site map.
7c0200611c68.text: 门票或腕带上的二维码，可打开当天的日程和场地地图。

2a59aa391367.source: Directions, parking and shuttle times for ticket holders.
2a59aa391367.text: 为持票人提供路线指引、停车和接驳车时间。

63a6ac340fec.source: Bag policy, accessible routes and facilities on one page.
63a6ac340fec.text: 包袋规定、无障碍通道和设施，集中在一个页面。

b31a16dc82a6.source: Photos, recordings and next year's pre-sale behind the same code.
b31a16dc82a6.text: 照片、录像和明年的预售，都放在同一个二维码后面。

032b8273fdb7.source: Date, time, venue, map and calendar buttons for the event.
032b8273fdb7.text: 活动的日期、时间、场馆、地图和日历按钮。

dd9889dd81ad.source: Opens the venue or car park in Google Maps.
dd9889dd81ad.text: 在 Google Maps 中打开场馆或停车场。

289ef17dfb95.source: Schedule, map, travel and FAQs on one page, updated during the event.
289ef17dfb95.text: 日程、地图、出行信息和常见问题集中在一个页面，活动期间持续更新。

ba5fa00d8fa4.source: Ticket or wristband in the hand

eb65abe76b91.source: Keep the information code visually distinct from the entry code, and label it, so gate staff scan the right one.
eb65abe76b91.text: 信息二维码在外观上要与入场二维码明显区分，并加上标注，方便检票人员扫描正确的那个。

1255dcd089f5.source: Make the entry code the larger, more prominent one on the ticket.
1255dcd089f5.text: 让入场二维码在票面上更大、更醒目。

352301e59844.source: Point the info code at a page that works on weak venue signal: no autoplaying video.
352301e59844.text: 信息二维码应指向在场馆信号较弱时也能正常打开的页面：不要自动播放视频。

27d87eef5f1a.source: Repoint the info code after the event to recordings or next year's tickets.
27d87eef5f1a.text: 活动结束后，把信息二维码改指向活动回放或明年的门票。

348ec1b70d69.source: Scan for set times and the site map
348ec1b70d69.text: 扫描查看演出时间表和场地地图

b649d12d8203.text: QRdx 可以生成入场票吗？

808f5bf9695e.source: No. Entry codes need a unique code per ticket and a system that validates and marks each one as used. Use your ticketing platform for entry, and QRdx for information codes.
808f5bf9695e.text: 不可以。入场二维码需要每张票对应唯一的码，并由系统验证、将每张票标记为已使用。入场请使用你的票务平台，QRdx 用于信息二维码。

1978476293ac.source: Can a ticket have two QR codes?
1978476293ac.text: 一张票可以有两个二维码吗？

fda0661876c6.source: Yes, if they are clearly separated and labelled. Make the entry code prominent and the information code smaller, marked 'Event info'.
fda0661876c6.text: 可以，只要两者清晰分开并加上标注。让入场二维码醒目，信息二维码小一些，并标注“活动信息”。

dc369ec21878.source: What should the information code link to after the event?
dc369ec21878.text: 活动结束后，信息二维码应该链接到哪里？

4556ca1f511b.source: Repoint it to photos, recordings or next year's pre-sale. With a dynamic code, the printed tickets people keep as souvenirs still lead somewhere useful.
4556ca1f511b.text: 把它改指向照片、回放或明年的预售页面。有了动态二维码，人们留作纪念的纸质门票依然能指向有用的内容。

3339c8ef1995.source: QR Codes on Name Badges and Lanyards
3339c8ef1995.text: 胸牌和挂绳上的二维码

b1898f328577.source: QR codes on conference and staff name badges: contact sharing with vCard Plus, LinkedIn connections, schedules and badge printing sizes that scan.
b1898f328577.text: 会议和员工胸牌上的二维码：使用 vCard Plus 分享联系方式、LinkedIn 好友连接、日程，以及可顺利扫描的胸牌印刷尺寸。

05b18d105c1d.source: Contact sharing, LinkedIn and agendas from conference badges.
05b18d105c1d.text: 通过会议胸牌分享联系方式、LinkedIn 和议程。

4ba3a6ed39d0.source: At a conference, the badge is the business card. A QR code on each attendee's badge that saves their contact or opens their LinkedIn profile replaces the awkward phone-number exchange, and works across the whole event.
4ba3a6ed39d0.text: 在会议上，胸牌就是名片。每位参会者胸牌上的二维码可以保存其联系方式或打开其 LinkedIn 主页，取代尴尬的交换手机号，并且在整个活动期间都适用。

810fd61763cc.source: Badges are printed in bulk from the registration list, so codes should be created in bulk too, one per attendee, with a short link that keeps the code small and easy to scan from across a coffee table.
810fd61763cc.text: 胸牌是根据报名名单批量印刷的，所以二维码也应批量创建，每位参会者一个，并使用短链接，让二维码保持小巧，隔着咖啡桌也容易扫描。

7e11c324ab7f.source: A vCard Plus code per attendee that saves name, company and email with one scan.
7e11c324ab7f.text: 每位参会者一个 vCard Plus 二维码，扫描一次即可保存姓名、公司和电子邮箱。

80296067e70f.source: A profile code for attendees who'd rather connect than share a phone number.
80296067e70f.text: 个人资料二维码，适合更愿意建立联系而不是交换手机号的参会者。

0f0dcf8c7035.source: A shared code on the back of every badge that opens the live agenda.
0f0dcf8c7035.text: 每张胸牌背面共用的一个二维码，可打开实时议程。

f25e03665d38.source: Badges that open a 'how can I help?' page or the event's help desk.
f25e03665d38.text: 打开“有什么可以帮您?”页面或活动服务台页面的胸牌。

ea42f4656261.source: A contact page per attendee with a Save contact button, and a short code that scans easily from across a table.
ea42f4656261.text: 为每位参会者提供带“保存联系人”按钮的联系页面，以及隔着桌子也容易扫描的简短二维码。

dc53fc89416f.source: Opens the attendee's LinkedIn profile, free and static.
dc53fc89416f.text: 打开参会者的 LinkedIn 主页，免费，静态二维码。

781491cf7f8b.source: The shared agenda code on the back of the badge.
781491cf7f8b.text: 胸牌背面的共享日程二维码。

98ee700e4170.source: Badges are read from about 70 cm; the code needs to be roughly 8 cm wide, which fits an A6 badge.
98ee700e4170.text: 胸牌通常在约 70 cm 的距离读取；二维码宽度需约 8 cm，A6 尺寸的胸牌可以容纳。

af7862c84bf8.source: Print the code on both sides, or use a double clip so badges don't flip.
af7862c84bf8.text: 两面都印上二维码，或使用双挂扣，避免胸牌翻转。

0c9824371605.source: Laminated badges glare; matte pouches scan better.
0c9824371605.text: 覆膜胸牌会反光；哑光胸牌套的扫描效果更好。

d244c99164fb.source: Don't encode email addresses or phone numbers in static codes unless attendees agreed to share them.
d244c99164fb.text: 除非参会者同意分享，否则不要把电子邮箱或电话号码编码进静态二维码。

444459013153.source: How big should a QR code be on a name badge?
444459013153.text: 姓名胸牌上的二维码应该多大？

23e9ae34deff.source: About 8 cm for scanning face to face at 70 cm with a short link. On smaller badges, scans happen closer, so 5 to 6 cm can work.
23e9ae34deff.text: 使用短链接时，在 70 cm 距离面对面扫描，二维码约 8 cm。较小的胸牌通常在更近的距离扫描，5 到 6 cm 也可以。

fb34ff4617b0.source: Can I create a QR code for every attendee?
fb34ff4617b0.text: 可以为每位参会者创建二维码吗？

7ea8bc9c12b5.source: Yes. Use the bulk generator for static vCard or LinkedIn codes from your registration CSV, or the REST API to create a dynamic code per attendee on a paid plan.
7ea8bc9c12b5.text: 可以。使用批量生成器，根据报名 CSV 生成静态 vCard 或 LinkedIn 二维码；或在付费方案中使用 REST API，为每位参会者创建动态二维码。

0d0c2193db0b.source: Is it okay to put attendees' details in badge QR codes?
0d0c2193db0b.text: 可以把参会者的个人信息放进胸牌二维码吗？

e7f4f4b97382.source: Only with their consent. Ask during registration whether they want to share contact details, and leave the code off or link to a generic page for those who don't.
e7f4f4b97382.text: 仅限获得其同意。报名时询问对方是否愿意分享联系方式；不愿意的人，可以不印二维码，或链接到通用页面。

67ae1a1955f6.source: QR Codes on Envelopes and Mailers
67ae1a1955f6.text: 信封和邮寄宣传品上的二维码

90bcb135483c.source: QR codes on envelopes: tease the offer, track responses, invite RSVPs and keep postal barcodes clear, with privacy rules for what goes on the outside.
90bcb135483c.text: 信封上的二维码：预告优惠、追踪响应、邀请回复，并避开邮政条码，同时说明外侧内容的隐私规则。

1165ca1f3991.source: Open-rate teasers, RSVPs and response tracking from the outside.
1165ca1f3991.text: 拆封预告、邀请回复和响应追踪，从信封外侧开始。

b89bf048cfd1.source: The envelope decides whether a mailing is opened. A QR code on the outside with a reason to scan (a preview, an offer, an RSVP) can get a response even from people who never open it.
b89bf048cfd1.text: 信封决定了邮件是否会被拆开。外侧的二维码配上扫描的理由（预览、优惠、回复邀请），即使对方从不拆信，也可能得到回应。

d712ddeea61c.source: Anything on the outside of an envelope is public, so the code must never reveal personal information. And it has to stay clear of the address window and the postal service's own barcodes.
d712ddeea61c.text: 信封外侧的任何内容都是公开的，因此二维码绝不能泄露个人信息。同时，它还必须避开地址窗口和邮政部门自己的条码。

8d70c2f37e63.source: A code on the outside that opens the offer inside, for people who won't open the envelope.
8d70c2f37e63.text: 外侧的二维码可打开信封内的优惠，面向不会拆信的人。

c276c19cd939.source: A code on the invitation envelope that opens the RSVP or wedding page.
c276c19cd939.text: 邀请函信封上的二维码，可打开回复页面或婚礼页面。

15d2c0a319f0.source: Charity and survey return envelopes with a code to respond online instead.
15d2c0a319f0.text: 慈善和问卷用的回邮信封，印上二维码，即可改为在线回复。

7ba5ff90c9ad.source: A code that opens the paperless sign-up page.
7ba5ff90c9ad.text: 打开无纸化注册页面的二维码。

9f2ea558205d.text: 每次邮寄一个动态二维码

87725ce4597d.source: Measure responses from the envelope separately from the letter inside.
87725ce4597d.text: 将信封上的响应与信内信件的响应分开统计。

e43370432693.source: Invitation details, map and calendar buttons for invitation envelopes.
e43370432693.text: 邀请函详情、地图和日历按钮，适用于邀请函信封。

f7c6ec2c88a4.source: A response or RSVP form for return envelopes.
f7c6ec2c88a4.text: 回复或 RSVP 表单，适用于回邮信封。

6a2dcf6ca0ad.source: Keep the code away from the address window, stamp area and the bottom strip where postal barcodes are printed.
6a2dcf6ca0ad.text: 二维码要避开地址窗口、邮票区域，以及底部印有邮政条码的区域。

51de5ec217f0.source: Don't link the outside code to anything personal; the envelope can be read by anyone handling it.
51de5ec217f0.text: 信封外侧的二维码不要链接到任何个人内容，因为经手信封的任何人都能看到它。

5e0e941ad61e.source: Kraft and coloured envelopes need extra contrast; print solid black.
5e0e941ad61e.text: 牛皮纸信封和彩色信封需要更高的对比度，请使用纯黑色印刷。

0aacd83612f7.source: About 3 to 3.5 cm is enough for a code read in the hand.
0aacd83612f7.text: 手持扫描的话，大约 3 到 3.5 厘米就足够了。

40aecacfc8d9.source: Open me, or scan for a preview

83ba1694674a.source: Can I put a QR code on the outside of an envelope?
83ba1694674a.text: 可以把二维码印在信封外面吗？

5ae80e66c071.source: Yes, as long as it doesn't interfere with the address, stamp or postal barcode areas. Check your postal service's guidelines for the clear zones.
5ae80e66c071.text: 可以，只要不影响地址、邮票或邮政条码区域即可。请查看当地邮政服务对留白区域的规定。

826b6249cf7e.source: Is it safe to put a QR code on the envelope?
826b6249cf7e.text: 把二维码放在信封上安全吗？

ff091838e415.source: Only if it links to something public. Never encode or link personal information on the outside of mail.
ff091838e415.text: 只有链接到公开内容时才安全。切勿在邮件外侧编码或链接个人信息。

9990c1e9b197.source: Can I measure how many people scan the envelope?
9990c1e9b197.text: 能统计有多少人扫描了信封吗？

c2e7981f4c86.source: Yes. Use a different dynamic code on the envelope and the letter, and compare scans in the dashboard.
c2e7981f4c86.text: 可以。在信封和信件上使用不同的动态二维码，并在控制台中比较扫描次数。

63c1cbb0c7c7.source: QR Codes in Books: Extras, Audio and Updates
63c1cbb0c7c7.text: 图书中的二维码：拓展内容、音频与更新

ed5bc8a74f4a.source: QR codes in printed books: audio and video extras, errata and updates, author pages, reader reviews and resources, with sizing for pages and covers.
ed5bc8a74f4a.text: 印刷图书中的二维码：音频和视频拓展内容、勘误与更新、作者页面、读者评论和资源，并附页面与封面的尺寸建议。

f998daccffda.source: Audio and video extras, errata and author pages from the printed page.
f998daccffda.text: 从纸质页面访问音频和视频拓展内容、勘误和作者页面。

2c5c1a75a0d9.source: Printed books can't be updated, but the pages a QR code opens can. Textbooks link to exercises and corrections, cookbooks to technique videos, travel guides to current opening times, and novels to the author's newsletter.
2c5c1a75a0d9.text: 印刷的图书无法更新，但二维码打开的页面可以。教材可以链接到习题和勘误，食谱可以链接到技巧视频，旅行指南可以链接到最新的营业时间，小说可以链接到作者的邮件通讯。

54b912d3e03e.source: Books also have long lives on shelves and second-hand markets. A dynamic code keeps the link working through publisher website changes, and keeps the book selling the author's next one.
54b912d3e03e.text: 书籍在书架和二手市场上也能留存很久。动态二维码可以在出版社网站变动后让链接继续有效，也能让这本书继续为作者的下一本书带来读者。

f8735ecccfdb.source: Pronunciation in language books, techniques in cookbooks, exercises in fitness books.
f8735ecccfdb.text: 语言书里的发音、烹饪书里的技巧、健身书里的练习。

b777fa114097.source: A code on the copyright page that opens corrections and updates for that edition.
b777fa114097.text: 版权页上的二维码，可打开该版本的更正和更新内容。

bb2d791efea2.source: A code on the back page that opens the newsletter, the series list or the next book.
bb2d791efea2.text: 封底上的二维码，可打开通讯订阅、系列书目或下一本书。

aaf9ccf684df.source: Worksheets, templates and discussion guides for book clubs and classrooms.
aaf9ccf684df.text: 供读书会和课堂使用的练习表、模板和讨论指南。

d690f178ee80.source: Audio extras with a playlist per chapter, for language and music books.
d690f178ee80.text: 每章一个播放列表的音频附加内容，适用于语言和音乐类书籍。

4580d5b62e9e.source: Technique videos for cookbooks and how-to books.
4580d5b62e9e.text: 适用于烹饪书和实用指南类书籍的技巧视频。

d2c73310da67.source: The author page: newsletter, series, socials and reviews.
d2c73310da67.text: 作者主页：通讯订阅、系列书目、社交账号和书评。

f97eee141ce5.source: Keep codes away from the gutter, where the page curves into the binding.
f97eee141ce5.text: 二维码要避开书脊处，也就是页面向装订处弯曲的位置。

2a05fd0f6886.source: About 4 cm on a page is comfortable at reading distance; the back cover has room for a larger one.
2a05fd0f6886.text: 在阅读距离下，页面上约 4 cm 的二维码比较合适；封底空间更大，可以放更大的二维码。

f09d9530b84b.source: Don't place the code near the ISBN barcode on the back cover.
f09d9530b84b.text: 不要把二维码放在封底 ISBN 条形码附近。

277cea30033a.source: Print the short URL under the code for readers of the paper edition who don't scan.
277cea30033a.text: 在二维码下方印上短网址，方便阅读纸质版但不扫描的读者。

1c78f18fd9bb.source: Will the QR codes in my book still work in ten years?
1c78f18fd9bb.text: 我书里的二维码十年后还能用吗？

e1e6d3fe0499.source: Static codes always work, but the URL they hold may not. Dynamic codes let you change the destination if your site moves, and QRdx keeps them redirecting on every plan.
e1e6d3fe0499.text: 静态二维码始终可以使用，但其中的网址未必还有效。动态二维码可以在网站迁移时更改目标地址，而且在所有方案中，QRdx 都会保持它们的跳转。

8dcfe66114be.source: Can I see which chapters readers scan?
8dcfe66114be.text: 我能看到读者扫描了哪些章节吗？

91ca585d6121.source: Yes, with one dynamic code per chapter or extra. Scans are counted per code, which shows which material readers use.
91ca585d6121.text: 可以，为每个章节或附加内容各使用一个动态二维码即可。扫描次数按每个二维码分别统计，能看出读者在使用哪些内容。

fabcb5271701.source: Do QR codes in books work in black and white printing?
fabcb5271701.text: 书里的二维码能用黑白印刷吗？

f0ab4582ad77.source: Yes. Black codes on white paper are ideal. Avoid grey tints and halftone screens behind the code.
f0ab4582ad77.text: 可以。白纸黑码是最理想的。二维码背后要避免灰色底纹和半色调网点。

9a7ce70c0470.source: Billboards, vehicles and signs read from metres away, in all weather.
9a7ce70c0470.text: 广告牌、车身和标牌，隔着几米远也能读取，不惧各种天气。

27aa87856aed.source: QR codes on billboards and out-of-home ads
27aa87856aed.text: 广告牌和户外广告上的二维码

af6dd570f1a2.source: QR Codes on Billboards: When They Work and How Big
af6dd570f1a2.text: 广告牌上的二维码：何时有效，该印多大

b99133bff215.source: QR codes on billboards and out-of-home ads: when they work (walk-by and waiting sites), how big to print for the distance, and how to measure each site.
b99133bff215.text: 广告牌和户外广告上的二维码：何时有效（行人经过和等候场所）、按距离该印多大，以及如何分别衡量每个点位的效果。

c6633f58295a.source: Which OOH sites suit QR codes, how big to go and per-site tracking.
c6633f58295a.text: 哪些户外点位适合放二维码、该做多大，以及如何按点位追踪。

c78b047161fa.source: A QR code on a motorway billboard is a waste of ink: drivers can't and shouldn't scan. Codes on out-of-home ads work where people are on foot and standing still: bus shelters, station platforms, shopping centers, escalator panels and waiting areas.
c78b047161fa.text: 高速公路广告牌上的二维码纯属浪费油墨：司机无法扫描，也不应该扫描。户外广告上的二维码适用于行人步行或驻足的场所：公交候车亭、车站站台、购物中心、扶梯广告牌和等候区。

a791b98aa92d.source: Out-of-home is also hard to measure, which is where dynamic codes earn their keep. One code per site, each counted separately, tells you which sites drove action.
a791b98aa92d.text: 户外广告也很难衡量效果，而这正是动态二维码的价值所在。每个点位使用一个二维码、分别计数，就能知道哪些点位带来了行动。

8c06d11e3135.source: People waiting for a train or bus have time and a phone in hand. A clear offer behind a code converts well here.
8c06d11e3135.text: 等火车或公交的人有时间，手里也拿着手机。二维码背后一个清晰的优惠，在这里转化效果很好。

aa5c5639b1ba.source: One code that opens the right app store for each phone.
aa5c5639b1ba.text: 一个二维码，为每部手机打开对应的应用商店。

ef5f4434f8a3.source: A teaser poster that opens a countdown or waitlist, repointed to the product on launch day.
ef5f4434f8a3.text: 预热海报上的二维码打开倒计时或候补名单页面，发布当天改为指向产品。

374ece7b5759.source: Shopping-center and street-level panels that open directions and the current offer.
374ece7b5759.text: 购物中心和街边广告牌上的二维码，可打开路线指引和当前优惠。

bd8fa1fb64ce.text: 每个点位一个动态二维码

30f9c1b48f88.source: Measure every site separately, add UTM parameters on Pro, and repoint the code when the campaign changes.
30f9c1b48f88.text: 分别衡量每个点位的效果，在 Pro 上添加 UTM 参数，活动变化时重新指向新的目标。

f7645b76514b.source: App campaigns with one code for App Store and Google Play.
f7645b76514b.text: 应用推广活动，一个二维码同时适用于 App Store 和 Google Play。

8a8141350f06.source: A redeemable offer for nearby stores, counted per code.
8a8141350f06.text: 面向附近门店的可兑换优惠，按二维码分别计数。

0c09ddf964ad.source: Only add codes to sites where people stop or walk slowly; skip roadside sites aimed at drivers.
0c09ddf964ad.text: 只在人们会停下或慢慢行走的点位添加二维码，不要用在面向司机的路边点位。

a49269d15fbe.source: Size for the real distance: from 6 m, about 70 cm; from 15 m, well over 1.5 m. If that's not possible, choose a closer site.
a49269d15fbe.text: 按实际距离确定尺寸：6 m 外约 70 cm；15 m 外则要远大于 1.5 m。如果做不到，就选更近的点位。

d35c30911d5b.source: Lower is better: put the code in the bottom third of the panel, where the people closest to it can see it.
d35c30911d5b.text: 位置越低越好：把二维码放在广告板的下三分之一处，离它最近的人最容易看到。

0ff502760cb9.source: Test on site at different times of day; backlit panels and reflections behave differently at night.
0ff502760cb9.text: 在不同时段到现场测试；背光灯箱和反光在夜间的表现会不一样。

11c8b4d52701.source: Scan to get 20% off your first order
11c8b4d52701.text: 扫描二维码，首单立享 20% 优惠

91471edfa22f.source: How big should a QR code be on a billboard?
91471edfa22f.text: 广告牌上的二维码应该多大？

92927840a227.source: Roughly a tenth of the scanning distance, a little more for a short link: about 70 cm from 6 m, and over 1.7 m from 15 m. Most billboards aren't scanned from further than that.
92927840a227.text: 大约是扫描距离的十分之一，链接较短时可以稍大一些：6 m 距离约 70 cm，15 m 距离则需要 1.7 m 以上。大多数广告牌的扫描距离不会超过这个范围。

b8640978f92e.source: Do QR codes on billboards work?
b8640978f92e.text: 广告牌上的二维码有用吗？

923ac15d7424.source: On walk-by and waiting sites, they can. On roadside billboards seen from a moving car, they don't, and you shouldn't encourage drivers to scan.
923ac15d7424.text: 在行人经过和等候的场所，是有用的。在行驶车辆中看到的路边广告牌上则没有用，也不应该鼓励驾驶员扫描。

34577bdd2199.source: How do I measure billboard QR code scans?
34577bdd2199.text: 如何统计广告牌二维码的扫描量？

f8e9eeb1b7fa.source: Use one dynamic code per site. QRdx counts scans per code with time and city, so you can compare sites and times of day.
f8e9eeb1b7fa.text: 每个点位使用一个动态二维码。QRdx 会按二维码统计扫描次数，并记录时间和城市，方便你比较不同点位和不同时段。

a95601decc62.source: QR codes on vehicles and van wraps
a95601decc62.text: 车辆和货车车身贴上的二维码

c8757209860a.source: QR Codes on Vans, Trucks and Vehicle Wraps
c8757209860a.text: 货车、卡车和车身贴上的二维码

7908f3281366.source: QR codes on vans, trucks and vehicle wraps: where to place them so people can scan safely, how big to print, durable vinyl and what to link to.
7908f3281366.text: 货车、卡车和车身贴上的二维码：放在哪里便于安全扫描、打印多大、如何选择耐用的乙烯基贴膜，以及链接到哪里。

5a52561c7b84.source: Rear and side placement, vinyl sizing and safe scanning.
5a52561c7b84.text: 车尾和车侧的位置、贴膜尺寸与安全扫描。

84dbe10ea3bc.source: A van is a billboard that parks outside the customer's neighbour's house. A QR code on the side or the back doors, scanned while the van is parked, can open your booking page, reviews or a quote form.
84dbe10ea3bc.text: 一辆货车就像一块会停在客户邻居家门口的广告牌。车身侧面或后门上的二维码，在车辆停靠时被扫描，可以打开你的预约页面、评价或报价表单。

241c01cb9ba2.source: Codes on vehicles should be scanned from the pavement, never from another moving car. Size them for someone standing a few metres away, and choose a vinyl that survives car washes.
241c01cb9ba2.text: 车辆上的二维码应该在人行道上扫描，绝不能在另一辆行驶的车里扫描。尺寸要照顾站在几米外的人，并选择经得起洗车的乙烯基贴膜。

e88f12a6e8fb.source: Plumbers, electricians and cleaners can link the van to a booking or quote page.
e88f12a6e8fb.text: 水管工、电工和保洁人员可以把货车链接到预约或报价页面。

6d2217835f2a.source: A code that opens your reviews, which convinces neighbours watching the work.
6d2217835f2a.text: 打开你的评价页面的二维码，能说服围观施工的邻居。

4d272cc9614b.source: This week's locations and the menu, from the side of the truck.
4d272cc9614b.text: 在车身侧面就能看到本周的位置和菜单。

de5ae1f8d404.source: A code on fleet vehicles that opens the 'how's my driving?' feedback form.
de5ae1f8d404.text: 车队车辆上的二维码，可打开“我的驾驶如何？”反馈表单。

1d50a6e82371.source: Services, area covered, phone and email, with a contact button.
1d50a6e82371.text: 服务项目、服务区域、电话和邮箱，并带有联系按钮。

3bb393c47509.source: Quote requests or driver feedback, one form per vehicle if you want to tell them apart.
3bb393c47509.text: 报价申请或驾驶员反馈；如果想区分车辆，可以每辆车使用一个表单。

d6c0fffa6ea5.text: 每辆车一个动态二维码

cc443e00bd2f.source: Compare which vans bring in enquiries, and repoint all of them when your website changes.
cc443e00bd2f.text: 比较哪些货车带来了咨询，网站变更时还能一次性重新指向所有二维码。

bb0d27b3dbd1.source: Put codes on the rear doors and the kerb side, where people on foot can scan safely.
bb0d27b3dbd1.text: 请把二维码放在后门和靠路边的一侧，方便行人安全扫描。

e513029bfdb1.source: From 2 m the code needs to be about 23 cm; from across the street, about 60 cm.
e513029bfdb1.text: 2 米距离扫描时，二维码约需 23 厘米；隔街扫描时，约需 60 厘米。

217ba15f9ffe.source: Keep the code on a flat panel, away from door handles, seams and wheel arches.
217ba15f9ffe.text: 二维码应放在平整的面板上，避开门把手、接缝和轮拱。

c17d50f37947.source: Use cast vinyl with a laminate so the code stays black through car washes and sunlight.
c17d50f37947.text: 请使用流延膜并覆上保护膜，这样二维码经洗车和日晒后仍能保持黑色。

5fead329e732.source: Need a plumber? Scan to book

9df62e6bd1ac.source: Where should a QR code go on a van?
9df62e6bd1ac.text: 厢式货车上的二维码应该放在哪里？

5e9dc72ae2b3.source: On the rear doors and the kerb-side panel, at about chest height. Those are the places people stand near a parked van.
5e9dc72ae2b3.text: 放在后门和靠路边一侧的面板上，高度约与胸口齐平。人们走近停放的货车时，通常就站在这些位置。

c4196a651a53.source: Is it safe to put QR codes on vehicles?
c4196a651a53.text: 在车辆上放置二维码安全吗？

859e29e78b5d.source: Yes, if they are meant to be scanned from the pavement while parked. Don't encourage scanning from other vehicles; the call to action can say 'when parked'.
859e29e78b5d.text: 安全，前提是二维码供人在车辆停放时从人行道上扫描。不要鼓励其他车辆上的人扫描；行动号召语可以写上“停车时”。

6026e315086b.source: How big should a QR code be on a van?
6026e315086b.text: 厢式货车上的二维码应该多大？

87933339268a.source: About 23 cm for people standing 2 m away, up to about 60 cm for people across the street. Bigger is better as long as it stays on a flat surface.
87933339268a.text: 站在 2 米外的人扫描，约需 23 厘米；隔街扫描，最大约需 60 厘米。只要二维码贴在平整的表面上，越大越好。

41f951709410.source: QR Codes on Signs: Outdoor and Indoor Signage
41f951709410.text: 标牌上的二维码：室外与室内标识

90242bdfef4e.source: QR codes on indoor and outdoor signs: wayfinding, information boards, opening hours and safety notices, with mounting heights, sizes and durable materials.
90242bdfef4e.text: 室内外标牌上的二维码：导览、信息牌、营业时间和安全告示，附安装高度、尺寸和耐用材料建议。

755d29dc50a3.source: Wayfinding, information boards and safety notices that last.
755d29dc50a3.text: 持久耐用的导览牌、信息牌和安全告示。

0b8772277e7b.source: Signs are permanent and information isn't. A QR code on a sign can carry the part that changes (hours, routes, detailed instructions, translations) while the sign itself stays put for years.
0b8772277e7b.text: 标牌是长久的，信息却不是。标牌上的二维码可以承载会变化的内容（营业时间、路线、详细说明、多语言翻译），而标牌本身可以多年保持不变。

c77952c94640.source: Signage is also where tampering happens. For signs in public places, print the link next to the code and inspect the codes regularly, so nobody can cover them with a look-alike sticker.
c77952c94640.text: 标牌也是容易被人动手脚的地方。公共场所的标牌，请把链接印在二维码旁边，并定期检查二维码，避免有人用相似的贴纸将其覆盖。

60fd57549620.source: Directional signs that open a map with the route to each destination.
60fd57549620.text: 指示牌可打开地图，显示前往各个目的地的路线。

67659d860907.source: Parks, heritage sites and campuses that link to detail, audio and translations.
67659d860907.text: 公园、文物古迹和校园的标牌可链接到详细介绍、语音讲解和多语言翻译。

bf551b031577.source: Door signs that open current hours, holiday closures and contact options.
bf551b031577.text: 门口的标牌可打开最新的营业时间、节假日休息安排和联系方式。

76ff75b089b0.source: Safety signs that open the full procedure or an emergency contact page.
76ff75b089b0.text: 安全标识可打开完整操作流程或紧急联系页面。

44b83c979338.source: Current hours, closures, contact buttons and the address for door signs.
44b83c979338.text: 门牌标识可显示当前营业时间、临时关闭信息、联系按钮和地址。

e9333ca76915.source: Opens the destination in Google Maps from a wayfinding sign.
e9333ca76915.text: 在导向标识上扫描后，可在 Google Maps 中打开目的地。

0e7f3dfdaffc.source: Audio guides for information boards, playable in the browser.
0e7f3dfdaffc.text: 信息展板的语音导览，可直接在浏览器中播放。

19e812aa42c4.source: Full procedures behind safety signs, replaced when they're revised.
19e812aa42c4.text: 安全标识背后的完整操作流程，修订后即可替换。

516e6da2b3c4.source: Mount codes between 1.2 and 1.5 m, so they're reachable for wheelchair users and children.
516e6da2b3c4.text: 二维码的安装高度请保持在 1.2 至 1.5 米之间，方便轮椅使用者和儿童扫描。

bd9f783bbeb7.source: Outdoors, use UV-resistant inks, aluminium composite or engraved panels, and an anti-graffiti laminate.
bd9f783bbeb7.text: 户外使用时，请选用耐紫外线油墨、铝塑复合板或雕刻面板，并加贴防涂鸦覆膜。

2d502bb80455.source: Inspect public signs for stickers placed over the real code; the printed link next to it helps people spot fakes.
2d502bb80455.text: 请定期检查公共标识上是否被人在真实二维码上贴了贴纸；旁边印出的链接可以帮助人们识别假码。

619fc9ce49ef.source: Use error correction H on signs likely to get scratched or dirty.
619fc9ce49ef.text: 容易被刮花或弄脏的标识，请使用纠错等级 H。

d9e8e2ab05b4.text: 营业时间与节假日休息安排

7c8e307e62a8.source: What height should a QR code on a sign be?
7c8e307e62a8.text: 标识上的二维码应该安装在多高的位置？

e21f6cfb2349.source: Around 1.2 to 1.5 m to the center of the code. That works for most adults, children and wheelchair users without bending or stretching.
e21f6cfb2349.text: 二维码中心距地面约 1.2 至 1.5 米。这样大多数成年人、儿童和轮椅使用者都不用弯腰或伸手就能扫描。

54c92da943df.source: How long does an outdoor QR code sign last?
54c92da943df.text: 户外二维码标识能使用多久？

b77c4279f0e4.source: With UV-stable inks and a protective laminate, years. The code itself never expires; dynamic QRdx codes keep redirecting on every plan.
b77c4279f0e4.text: 使用耐紫外线油墨并加保护覆膜，可以用上好几年。二维码本身不会过期；在所有套餐中，QRdx 动态二维码都会持续跳转。

c083d4d2e825.source: How do I stop people tampering with QR codes on signs?
c083d4d2e825.text: 如何防止标识上的二维码被人篡改？

7107de57428e.source: Use tamper-evident materials, print your short-link domain next to the code, and check signs regularly.
7107de57428e.text: 请使用防拆封材料，把你的短链接域名印在二维码旁边，并定期检查标识。

cba09c3d81f2.source: Emails, slide decks, TV and video, where the code moves people to their phone.
cba09c3d81f2.text: 邮件、演示文稿、电视和视频，二维码能让人们转到手机上继续操作。

94d85c66f38d.source: QR Codes in Emails and Newsletters
94d85c66f38d.text: 邮件与新闻通讯中的二维码

430efd8c4241.source: When QR codes in emails make sense: desktop-to-phone handoffs, app downloads, event check-in and Wi-Fi, plus image sizing, alt text and email client tips.
430efd8c4241.text: 邮件中的二维码何时适用：从电脑转到手机、应用下载、活动签到和 Wi-Fi，另附图片尺寸、替代文字和邮件客户端使用提示。

1e402a305c22.source: Desktop-to-phone handoffs, app installs and event check-in.
1e402a305c22.text: 从电脑转到手机、安装应用和活动签到。

fefb93d75557.source: In an email, a link is usually better than a QR code: the reader can just tap it. QR codes earn their place when the reader is on a desktop and the action happens on the phone, such as installing an app, adding a pass, joining Wi-Fi or showing a code at an event.
fefb93d75557.text: 在邮件中，链接通常比二维码更合适：读者直接点击即可。但如果读者在电脑上阅读、而操作要在手机上完成，二维码就有了用武之地，例如安装应用、添加通行证、连接 Wi-Fi，或在活动现场出示二维码。

970c9b727020.source: Email clients block images by default, scale them unpredictably and strip some formats, so treat the code as a convenience next to a normal link, never as the only way in.
970c9b727020.text: 邮件客户端默认会屏蔽图片，缩放效果难以预料，还会过滤部分格式，因此请把二维码当作普通链接旁的辅助方式，而不要作为唯一入口。

0cb0a17cdfde.source: A desktop reader scans the code with their phone to open the right app store.
0cb0a17cdfde.text: 在电脑上阅读的读者用手机扫描二维码，即可打开对应的应用商店。

09dfa48dbbc7.source: A code that opens the event page or venue map on the phone people bring to the event. Entry tickets still come from your ticketing system.
09dfa48dbbc7.text: 在参会者随身携带的手机上，打开活动页面或场地地图的二维码。入场票仍由你的票务系统提供。

7905d16d4de7.source: Hotel or co-working welcome emails with a Wi-Fi code to scan from the laptop screen.
7905d16d4de7.text: 酒店或共享办公空间的欢迎邮件中附上 Wi-Fi 二维码，可直接扫描笔记本电脑屏幕。

dfb8d341d464.source: Hand off a sign-up or verification step that works better on a phone.
dfb8d341d464.text: 把更适合在手机上完成的注册或验证步骤转到手机上。

d50e5cb9f222.source: Opens the App Store or Google Play depending on the phone that scans it.
d50e5cb9f222.text: 根据扫描的手机，自动打开 App Store 或 Google Play。

30c4a8c3b42f.source: Lets guests join the network by scanning the email on their laptop.
30c4a8c3b42f.text: 访客扫描笔记本电脑上的邮件即可加入网络。

4f90f6461d74.source: The event details, map and calendar buttons on the phone they'll carry.
4f90f6461d74.text: 活动详情、地图和日历按钮，都在他们随身携带的手机上。

a241635a12f0.source: Embed the code as a PNG at 2× its display size (for example 400 px displayed at 200 px) so it stays sharp on high-density screens.
a241635a12f0.text: 以 PNG 格式嵌入二维码，尺寸为显示尺寸的 2 倍（例如以 200 px 显示 400 px 的图片），这样在高密度屏幕上也能保持清晰。

0456a6437659.source: Always add alt text and a normal link next to the code, for blocked images and mobile readers.
0456a6437659.text: 务必在二维码旁添加替代文字和普通链接，以应对图片被屏蔽的情况和手机端读者。

4d21a820c46a.source: Avoid SVG in email: many clients don't render it.
4d21a820c46a.text: 邮件中请避免使用 SVG：许多客户端无法显示。

7e9dacd67b1d.source: On a screen, a code about 6 to 8 cm wide on screen scans comfortably from a laptop.
7e9dacd67b1d.text: 在屏幕上，宽度约 6 到 8 cm 的二维码，用笔记本电脑扫描很轻松。

808da0a8c9f3.source: On your computer? Scan to get the app
808da0a8c9f3.text: 正在用电脑？扫描即可获取应用

ffee1ab94899.source: Your event details on your phone

b9030fe88290.source: Should I put a QR code in a marketing email?
b9030fe88290.text: 营销邮件中应该放二维码吗？

e095ba35c0d3.source: Only when the action belongs on the phone and many readers are on desktop. Otherwise a button converts better, because mobile readers can't scan their own screen.
e095ba35c0d3.text: 只有当操作适合在手机上完成，而且很多读者使用桌面端时才值得放。否则按钮的转化效果更好，因为手机端的读者无法扫描自己的屏幕。

e951d1cfe540.source: What format should an email QR code be?
e951d1cfe540.text: 邮件中的二维码应该用什么格式？

2d69e44848ad.source: PNG, at twice the display size, with alt text. SVG and some CSS tricks don't render in many email clients.
2d69e44848ad.text: 使用 PNG，尺寸为显示尺寸的两倍，并添加替代文字。许多邮件客户端不支持显示 SVG 和部分 CSS 技巧。

ec057080a6ef.source: Can I track scans from an email QR code?
ec057080a6ef.text: 可以追踪邮件二维码的扫描情况吗？

441af827cc80.source: Yes, with a dynamic code. Use a separate code from your print campaigns so the email's scans are counted on their own.
441af827cc80.text: 可以，使用动态二维码即可。请与印刷物料活动使用不同的二维码，这样邮件的扫描次数就能单独统计。

a2bd98e0730e.source: QR Codes on Slides: Size, Timing and Placement
a2bd98e0730e.text: 幻灯片上的二维码：尺寸、时长与位置

05e5652294b2.source: QR codes in presentations and slide decks: how big on screen for the back row, how long to show them, and what to link to, from slides to feedback forms.
05e5652294b2.text: 演示文稿和幻灯片中的二维码：后排观众需要多大的显示尺寸、展示多长时间，以及可以链接到什么内容，从幻灯片到反馈表单。

d74c6cee8448.source: Back-row sizing, how long to show it and what to link to.
d74c6cee8448.text: 适合后排观看的尺寸、展示时长与链接内容。

ff0bf83d01f2.source: The QR code on the last slide is the most common call to action at conferences and in classrooms, and the most commonly too small. A code that looks fine on your laptop can be unscannable from row 20.
ff0bf83d01f2.text: 最后一页幻灯片上的二维码，是会议和课堂上最常见的行动号召，也是最常见的尺寸偏小的情况。在笔记本电脑上看起来没问题的二维码，从第 20 排可能就无法扫描。

e31c78c97c5b.source: Size the code for the back of the room, leave it up long enough, and point it at something worth scanning: the slides, the resources or a two-question feedback form.
e31c78c97c5b.text: 按会场后排的距离来确定二维码尺寸，让它停留足够长的时间，并链接到值得扫描的内容：幻灯片、参考资料，或者一份只有两个问题的反馈表单。

96f63f528225.source: A code that opens your slides or resources, so the audience stops photographing every slide.
96f63f528225.text: 扫描后可打开你的幻灯片或资料，观众就不用再逐页拍照了。

c39b96c38584.source: A two-question form on the last slide while the audience is still seated.
c39b96c38584.text: 趁观众还在座位上，在最后一页放一份只有两个问题的表单。

a68f456dfc74.source: A vCard Plus or LinkedIn code for networking after the talk.
a68f456dfc74.text: 用 vCard Plus 或领英二维码，方便演讲结束后互相交流。

7bc69dc522be.source: A code that opens your polling or Q&A tool for the session.
7bc69dc522be.text: 扫描后可打开本场使用的投票或问答工具。

41c0f8b25f57.source: A short session feedback form with star ratings and a comment.
41c0f8b25f57.text: 简短的场次反馈表单，包含星级评分和留言。

7cc67f7808de.source: Your contact card with photo and socials, for networking after the talk.
7cc67f7808de.text: 你的名片，带有照片和社交账号，方便演讲后交流。

6c43d05b6735.source: The slide deck as a PDF, replaceable with the corrected version after the talk.
6c43d05b6735.text: 以 PDF 形式提供的幻灯片，演讲结束后可替换为修订后的版本。

6054e5bed6d3.source: Make the code fill much of the slide height: from 10 m it needs to be over a metre wide on screen.
6054e5bed6d3.text: 让二维码占满幻灯片的大部分高度：在 10 米外观看时，它在屏幕上的宽度需要超过 1 米。

f72462d158bf.source: Leave it up for at least 30 seconds, and put it on the first and the last slide.
f72462d158bf.text: 至少展示 30 秒，并且在第一页和最后一页都放上。

d34ca6b48410.source: Keep a white quiet zone around the code; dark slide templates need a white box behind it.
d34ca6b48410.text: 在二维码周围保留白色静区；深色幻灯片模板需要在二维码后面加一个白色底框。

b82a509e392d.source: Use a short link so the code has fewer, larger modules on projectors with low resolution.
b82a509e392d.text: 使用短链接，这样二维码的模块更少、更大，在低分辨率投影仪上也更容易扫描。

167323ab3c15.source: Scan for the slides and resources
167323ab3c15.text: 扫描获取幻灯片和资料

6d731ad2bdd6.source: How big should a QR code be on a slide?
6d731ad2bdd6.text: 幻灯片上的二维码应该多大？

79ab4e6e957c.source: Big enough for the back row: about a tenth of the distance, a bit more for a short link. From 10 m, over a metre on screen; in a small room, 40 to 50 cm.
79ab4e6e957c.text: 要让最后一排也能扫到：大约是观看距离的十分之一，短链接可以再大一点。距离 10 米时，屏幕上要超过 1 米；在小房间里，40 到 50 厘米即可。

e580e83fd7a6.source: How long should I show a QR code in a presentation?
e580e83fd7a6.text: 演示时二维码应该展示多久？

03184d465f71.source: At least 30 seconds, and repeat it at the end. People need time to unlock their phone and open the camera.
03184d465f71.text: 至少 30 秒，并在结尾再展示一次。人们需要时间解锁手机并打开相机。

ea04aedb081a.source: Can I update the link after the talk?
ea04aedb081a.text: 演讲结束后可以更新链接吗？

e110d8ec15bf.source: Yes, with a dynamic code. Point it at the recording once it's online; people who scanned during the talk can come back later.
e110d8ec15bf.text: 可以，使用动态二维码即可。录像上线后，把它指向录像地址；演讲期间扫描过的人之后还可以再回来查看。

662a463f27ff.source: QR codes on TV and in video
662a463f27ff.text: 电视和视频中的二维码

edd9b03882ea.source: QR Codes on TV Ads, Streams and Video
edd9b03882ea.text: 电视广告、直播和视频中的二维码

4d1fdc196d0f.source: QR codes on TV ads, live streams and YouTube videos: on-screen size, how long to show them, where to place them and how to measure response per channel.
4d1fdc196d0f.text: 电视广告、直播和 YouTube 视频中的二维码：屏幕上的尺寸、展示时长、摆放位置，以及如何按渠道统计响应。

108038a69567.source: On-screen size, timing and per-channel tracking for TV and video.
108038a69567.text: 电视和视频中二维码的屏幕尺寸、展示时机与分渠道追踪。

babefcc2bbf3.source: TV is watched from the sofa with a phone in hand, which makes it one of the easiest places to scan from. A code in a TV ad, a live stream or a YouTube video turns a viewer into a visitor without them typing a URL they'll forget.
babefcc2bbf3.text: 人们坐在沙发上看电视，手里往往拿着手机，所以这是最容易扫描的场景之一。电视广告、直播或 YouTube 视频中的二维码，能让观众直接变成访客，不必输入一个转眼就会忘记的网址。

5e91cf057a95.source: Response comes in a spike while the code is on screen, so timing and size matter more than anywhere else. And because the same ad runs on several channels or streams, separate dynamic codes tell you which one worked.
5e91cf057a95.text: 二维码在屏幕上出现时，响应会集中爆发，因此展示时机和尺寸比其他任何场景都更重要。同一条广告往往会在多个渠道或直播中播出，为每个渠道使用单独的动态二维码，就能知道哪一个效果更好。

5031cb86ff97.source: An offer or app download with a code that stays on screen long enough to scan.
5031cb86ff97.text: 优惠或应用下载，二维码在屏幕上停留足够长的时间，方便扫描。

8ae8e9743eac.source: A corner code that opens the product, donation page or merch store during the stream.
8ae8e9743eac.text: 画面角落的二维码，在直播期间打开产品页、捐赠页或周边商店。

5b491c1c8416.source: An on-screen code for viewers watching on a TV, where clickable links don't work.
5b491c1c8416.text: 为在电视上观看的观众准备的屏幕二维码，因为在电视上无法点击链接。

5fb972171e30.source: Polls, recipes and competitions from a programme, linked to a page for that episode.
5fb972171e30.text: 节目中的投票、食谱和竞赛活动，链接到对应那一期的页面。

4c3e0a98c0d2.source: Dynamic code per channel or stream
4c3e0a98c0d2.text: 每个渠道或直播使用一个动态二维码

022bd06b952e.source: Compare response across channels and air times, and change the destination after the campaign.
022bd06b952e.text: 对比不同渠道和播出时段的响应，活动结束后还可以更改目标地址。

7a85feff1fef.source: App install ads with one code for both stores.
7a85feff1fef.text: 应用安装广告，一个二维码同时适用于两大应用商店。

e1c8d748d6ef.source: A viewer offer with a code and validity dates.
e1c8d748d6ef.text: 面向观众的优惠，附带优惠码和有效期。

366cd2dfa966.source: Keep the code on screen for at least 10 to 15 seconds in an ad, longer in programmes.
366cd2dfa966.text: 广告中，二维码至少要在屏幕上停留 10 到 15 秒，节目中则应更久。

8c8fceff5dca.source: The 10:1 rule gives about 35 cm on screen for a sofa 3 m away, about half the height of a 55-inch TV. Phones often read smaller codes in good conditions, so test on a real TV before going smaller.
8c8fceff5dca.text: 按 10:1 的规则，距离沙发 3 m 时，二维码在屏幕上约需 35 cm，大约是 55 英寸电视高度的一半。在良好条件下，手机通常能识别更小的二维码，所以缩小之前请先在真实电视上测试。

3dbed49d1c05.source: Place it away from the edges: TV overscan and streaming overlays can crop the corners.
3dbed49d1c05.text: 请远离屏幕边缘放置：电视过扫描和流媒体浮层可能会裁掉二维码的边角。

0639409efce4.source: Avoid motion or transitions over the code while it's on screen; a still frame scans best.
0639409efce4.text: 二维码显示期间，避免在其上方出现动态画面或转场；静止画面最容易扫描。

4af1fbe6493f.source: How long should a QR code be on screen in a TV ad?
4af1fbe6493f.text: 电视广告中的二维码应该在屏幕上停留多久？

1865f0b683b9.source: Long enough to unlock a phone and open the camera: aim for at least 10 to 15 seconds, and show it early as well as at the end.
1865f0b683b9.text: 时间要足够用户解锁手机并打开相机：建议至少 10 到 15 秒，而且不仅在结尾，开头也要尽早出现。

bf1268a55ef8.source: How big should a QR code be on TV?
bf1268a55ef8.text: 电视上的二维码应该多大？

6a6185b81d79.source: From a sofa 3 m away, about 35 cm on screen with a short link. On smaller screens or with longer links, bigger.
6a6185b81d79.text: 在距离沙发 3 m 的位置，使用短链接时，屏幕上约需 35 cm。屏幕更小或链接更长时，二维码需要更大。

aa2312ec87b2.source: How do I measure TV ad response with QR codes?
aa2312ec87b2.text: 如何用二维码衡量电视广告的效果？

4939226d1e60.source: Use a separate dynamic code per channel, station or stream. Every scan is timestamped per code, so you can match spikes to air times.
4939226d1e60.text: 为每个频道、电视台或直播流使用单独的动态二维码。每个二维码的每次扫描都有时间记录，因此你可以把访问高峰和播出时间对应起来。

27984c7c1fd5.source: A mobile page of buttons: website, socials, booking, reviews and more.
27984c7c1fd5.text: 由按钮组成的移动页面：网站、社交账号、预约、评价等。

45883f81a7b6.source: Opening hours, address with a map link, contact buttons and amenities.
45883f81a7b6.text: 营业时间、带地图链接的地址、联系按钮和设施服务。

08d9076fa4d1.source: A digital business card with photo, contact buttons and a Save contact button.
08d9076fa4d1.text: 数字名片，含照片、联系按钮和“保存联系人”按钮。

e363111d81a7.source: Sections and items with prices, photos, allergen and diet tags, and sold-out flags.
e363111d81a7.text: 分区和菜品，含价格、照片、过敏原和饮食标签，以及售罄标记。

8f103db50f8e.source: An offer with a code or barcode, validity dates, terms and a copy button.
8f103db50f8e.text: 带优惠码或条形码的优惠，含有效期、条款和复制按钮。

baab2bbf19b2.source: Date, time, venue, organiser and add-to-calendar links, plus an .ics file for any calendar app.
baab2bbf19b2.text: 日期、时间、场地、主办方和添加到日历的链接，另附适用于任何日历应用的 .ics 文件。

6dc31778efcc.source: Shows the App Store button on iPhones and the Google Play button on Android.
6dc31778efcc.text: 在 iPhone 上显示 App Store 按钮，在 Android 上显示 Google Play 按钮。

a3a18b9bd30e.source: Star ratings, NPS and questions, with responses collected in your dashboard.
a3a18b9bd30e.text: 星级评分、NPS 和问题，回复会收集在你的控制台中。

89c0ba42430a.source: An uploaded PDF people can read in the browser or download.
89c0ba42430a.text: 上传的 PDF，用户可在浏览器中阅读或下载。

2fd05903f9e2.source: A grid of photos with a full-screen viewer.
2fd05903f9e2.text: 网格排列的照片，支持全屏查看。

dbed2e4fc2cc.source: A YouTube or Vimeo embed, or an uploaded MP4.
dbed2e4fc2cc.text: 嵌入 YouTube 或 Vimeo 视频，或上传的 MP4。

d0587708747c.source: An audio player with cover art and a playlist.
d0587708747c.text: 带封面图和播放列表的音频播放器。

e1417b438f5b.source: Every social profile on one page, each with its handle and a tap to follow.
e1417b438f5b.text: 所有社交主页集中在一页，每个都显示账号名，轻点即可关注。

e234e8be1af4.source: Ingredients, allergens, nutrition, certifications and care, with GS1 Digital Link on your own domain.
e234e8be1af4.text: 配料、过敏原、营养成分、认证和保养说明，并支持在你自己的域名上使用 GS1 Digital Link。

dcc69760beec.source: Services and prices with a booking request form or a link to your booking tool.
dcc69760beec.text: 服务和价格，附预约申请表单或你的预约工具链接。

b145e677bc27.source: PayPal, Venmo, bank details and more, each opening the payment app or copying the details.
b145e677bc27.text: PayPal、Venmo、银行账户信息等，每一项都可打开对应的支付应用或复制账户信息。

52529eb3bfc6.source: Price, key facts, photos, the agent's contact and a viewing request form.
52529eb3bfc6.text: 价格、关键信息、照片、经纪人联系方式和看房预约表单。

8bc244d14c14.source: A call button, the pet's details and medical needs, and a form for whoever finds them.
8bc244d14c14.text: 包含拨号按钮、宠物资料和医疗需求，以及供拾到宠物的人填写的表单。

9084b10c8f7a.source: Emergency contacts, conditions, allergies and medication for a tag or wristband.
9084b10c8f7a.text: 适用于标签或腕带，包含紧急联系人、病情、过敏史和用药信息。

69f83b7d766b.source: Several tracks in a row: a mix, the stops of an audio tour or a book's chapters.
69f83b7d766b.text: 依次排列多个曲目：一组混音、语音导览的各个站点或一本书的各个章节。

7101919238dc.text: 全球通用的零售商品条码

255be5afffd8.source: 12 digits, and the check digit is added, or all 13 to have it checked.
255be5afffd8.text: 输入 12 位数字，系统会自动添加校验位；也可输入全部 13 位，由系统校验。

66c277f85732.source: 7 digits, and the check digit is added, or all 8 to have it checked.
66c277f85732.text: 输入 7 位数字，系统会自动添加校验位；也可输入全部 8 位，由系统校验。

26a3cb3d14af.source: Retail products in the US and Canada
26a3cb3d14af.text: 美国和加拿大的零售商品

c210128de9b9.source: 11 digits, and the check digit is added, or all 12 to have it checked.
c210128de9b9.text: 输入 11 位数字，系统会自动添加校验位；也可输入全部 12 位，由系统校验。

b799105eade0.source: A UPC-A number shortened for small packs
b799105eade0.text: 为小包装缩短的 UPC-A 号码

a8245ab197d1.source: 6 to 8 digits (number system 0 or 1, six digits, check digit), or a 12-digit UPC-A that can be shortened.
a8245ab197d1.text: 6 至 8 位数字（编号系统 0 或 1、六位数字、校验位），或可缩短的 12 位 UPC-A。

5c54d6671a2a.source: Letters, digits and symbols: labels, tickets, inventory
5c54d6671a2a.text: 字母、数字和符号：标签、票券、库存

f48c1877c1cb.source: Up to 80 letters, digits, spaces and keyboard symbols (plain ASCII, no accents or emoji).
f48c1877c1cb.text: 最多 80 个字母、数字、空格和键盘符号（仅限纯 ASCII，不含重音字符或表情符号）。

16b09bef4840.source: Capital letters and digits for older scanners
16b09bef4840.text: 大写字母和数字，适用于较旧的扫描器

d02106f9e6cc.source: Up to 40 capital letters, digits, spaces and - . $ / + %.
d02106f9e6cc.text: 最多 40 个大写字母、数字、空格以及 - . $ / + %。

589227c3ced5.text: 装有零售商品的运输纸箱

0b11c8d4e730.source: 13 digits, and the check digit is added, or all 14 to have it checked.
0b11c8d4e730.text: 输入 13 位数字，系统会自动添加校验位；也可输入全部 14 位，由系统校验。

0273a3d0cbcf.source: Supply chain data: GTIN, batch, dates, weights
0273a3d0cbcf.text: 供应链数据：GTIN、批号、日期、重量

e364d1c67fae.source: Application Identifiers in brackets, each followed by its value, e.g. (01)09501101530003(10)AB-123.
e364d1c67fae.text: 应用标识符（Application Identifiers）用括号括起，后面跟各自的值，例如 (01)09501101530003(10)AB-123。

5ef6d5c2b7db.source: Small square 2D code for parts and labels
5ef6d5c2b7db.text: 用于零件和标签的小型方形 2D 码

5379979c6f98.text: 最多 1,000 个字符的任意文本。

0cf39cc0b403.source: Stacked 2D code for IDs, boarding passes and documents
0cf39cc0b403.text: 用于证件、登机牌和文档的堆叠式 2D 码

65465fc47d4b.source: 2D code that needs no margin: tickets and transport
65465fc47d4b.text: 无需留白的 2D 码：用于票券和交通

9c5a364b0228.text: 适用于屏幕、文档和网店

979e54dc833d.text: 不接受 PNG 时使用

2ddf98960adc.source: The smallest files for modern browsers
2ddf98960adc.text: 适合现代浏览器的最小文件

2f6bec725ba6.source: Vector for print and design tools
2f6bec725ba6.text: 矢量格式，适用于印刷和设计工具

ba9248bc3f10.text: 矢量格式，可在任何设备上打开，适合印刷

2159ba6f43f8.text: 矢量格式，适用于较旧的印刷流程

6e61eb4deb7f.source: The barcode on retail products almost everywhere outside North America. It holds a 13-digit GTIN: a company prefix from GS1, an item number and a check digit. Books use it too, for an ISBN starting 978 or 979.
6e61eb4deb7f.text: 北美以外几乎所有地区零售商品上使用的条码。它包含 13 位 GTIN：GS1 分配的公司前缀、商品编号和校验位。图书也使用它，ISBN 以 978 或 979 开头。

cf698112f456.source: For packs too small for an EAN-13, such as a lipstick or a pack of gum. EAN-8 numbers are issued separately by GS1; you can't shorten an EAN-13 into one.
cf698112f456.text: 适用于小到无法使用 EAN-13 的包装，例如口红或口香糖。EAN-8 号码由 GS1 单独分配，不能把 EAN-13 缩短成 EAN-8。

06accea70295.source: The 12-digit retail barcode of the US and Canada. Its number is the same as an EAN-13 that starts with 0, and checkout scanners read both.
06accea70295.text: 美国和加拿大使用的 12 位零售条码。其号码与以 0 开头的 EAN-13 相同，收银台的扫描器两种都能读取。

962612c2fa1a.source: A UPC-A squeezed to six digits for small packs. Only UPC-A numbers with zeros in the right places can be shortened; enter a 12-digit UPC-A and the generator tells you whether yours can.
962612c2fa1a.text: 将 UPC-A 压缩为六位数字，适用于小包装。只有零位置合适的 UPC-A 号码才能缩短；输入 12 位 UPC-A，生成器会告诉你能否缩短。

e9e5bace9a1c.source: The general-purpose barcode: letters, digits and symbols for asset tags, stock labels, tickets and shipping labels. It's compact and needs no registration, so use it whenever no retail standard applies.
e9e5bace9a1c.text: 通用条形码：可编码字母、数字和符号，适用于资产标签、库存标签、票券和物流面单。它体积紧凑，无需注册，没有零售标准要求时都可以使用。

1d5ae38b11a4.source: Older and wider than Code 128, with capital letters, digits and a few symbols. Some industries and older systems still require it, and nearly every scanner reads it.
1d5ae38b11a4.text: 比 Code 128 更早出现，也更宽，可编码大写字母、数字和少数符号。一些行业和旧系统仍然要求使用它，而且几乎所有扫描器都能读取。

78b5bd23193b.source: Printed on corrugated cartons that hold retail products. It carries the 14-digit GTIN of the case, and its thick frame (bearer bars) evens out printing pressure and stops scanners reading only part of it.
78b5bd23193b.text: 印在装零售商品的瓦楞纸箱上。它承载整箱的 14 位 GTIN，粗边框（保护条）能均衡印刷压力，避免扫描器只读到一部分。

2c931f760a26.source: Several pieces of supply chain data in one barcode, each marked by an Application Identifier: (01) GTIN, (10) batch, (17) expiry date, (00) SSCC for a pallet. Used on cases, pallets and logistics labels.
2c931f760a26.text: 在一个条形码中包含多项供应链数据，每项由一个应用标识符标明：(01) GTIN、(10) 批次、(17) 有效期、(00) 托盘的 SSCC。用于箱、托盘和物流标签。

ef6b004da7c3.source: A small square 2D code that holds a lot in little space, used to mark parts, electronics and labels. This is plain Data Matrix; the GS1 version required on some regulated packaging isn't offered here.
ef6b004da7c3.text: 一种小巧的方形 2D 码，能在很小的空间里存放大量信息，常用于标记零部件、电子产品和标签。这里提供的是普通 Data Matrix；部分受监管包装所要求的 GS1 版本不在此提供。

4fd08e441afb.source: A stacked 2D code that holds up to about a kilobyte of text. You'll find it on driver's licenses, ID cards and boarding passes.
4fd08e441afb.text: 一种堆叠式 2D 码，最多可存放约一千字节的文本。驾驶证、身份证件和登机牌上都能见到它。

02d11c04eeef.source: A square 2D code found from its center, so it needs no blank margin. Transport operators use it for tickets shown on phone screens and printed at home.
02d11c04eeef.text: 一种方形 2D 码，从中心开始定位，因此无需留白边距。交通运营商把它用于在手机屏幕上展示以及在家打印的票券。

dd1e133f56a5.source: Dark bars on a light background. Black on white is safest; dark blue and dark green work. Many scanners read with red light, which makes red, orange and yellow bars disappear.
dd1e133f56a5.text: 浅色背景上使用深色条。黑底白色最稳妥，深蓝和深绿也可以。许多扫描器用红光读取，红色、橙色和黄色的条会因此消失。

cbec4cce9a0d.source: Keep the quiet zone clear: no text, borders or artwork in the blank margin either side.
cbec4cce9a0d.text: 保持空白区畅通：两侧的空白边距内不要放文字、边框或图案。

db2ac329e98e.source: Retail EAN and UPC barcodes may be printed from 80% to 200% of their nominal size (an EAN-13 at 100% is 37.29 mm wide). The SVG, PDF and EPS downloads use a 0.35 mm module, about 107%. Scale them within that range, and don't cut the bar height.
db2ac329e98e.text: 零售 EAN 和 UPC 条形码可按标称尺寸的 80% 到 200% 印刷（100% 时 EAN-13 宽 37.29 mm）。SVG、PDF 和 EPS 下载文件使用 0.35 mm 的模块，约为 107%。请在此范围内缩放，并且不要裁短条的高度。

847586b0394e.source: Print the barcode, then scan it with the scanners that will read it before a large run.
847586b0394e.text: 先打印条形码，再用实际会读取它的扫描器扫描，确认无误后再大批量印刷。

9809a72e2e2d.text: 这个条形码生成器免费吗？

feb93d368c6f.source: Yes. There's no account, no watermark and no limit on downloads. Barcodes are drawn and checked in your browser, so nothing you type is sent to QRdx, except when you pick WebP or AVIF (QRdx's server encodes those and keeps nothing) or save a barcode to your dashboard.
feb93d368c6f.text: 免费。无需账号，没有水印，下载次数不限。条形码在你的浏览器中绘制和检查，所以你输入的内容不会发送给 QRdx，除非你选择 WebP 或 AVIF（由 QRdx 的服务器编码，不会保留任何内容），或将条形码保存到控制台。

657cf791b6f3.source: Do I need to register my barcode number?
657cf791b6f3.text: 我需要注册条形码号码吗？

354487504d93.source: For products sold in shops, yes. EAN, UPC, ITF-14 and GS1-128 carry a GTIN, and GTINs are licensed to your company by GS1 (or GS1's organization in your country); retailers' systems won't recognize a made-up number. This generator draws any valid number, but it doesn't issue or register numbers. For your own stock, assets or tickets, Code 128 and Code 39 need no registration.
354487504d93.text: 在商店销售的商品需要注册。EAN、UPC、ITF-14 和 GS1-128 承载的是 GTIN，而 GTIN 由 GS1（或你所在国家的 GS1 组织）授权给你的公司；零售商的系统不会识别自编的号码。本生成器可以绘制任何有效号码，但不会发放或注册号码。用于自己的库存、资产或票券时，Code 128 和 Code 39 无需注册。

d5f00dae8786.source: Does it add the check digit?

5d74e7a11946.source: Yes, for EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF-14 and the GTIN and SSCC fields of GS1-128: leave the last digit off and it's worked out. Enter the full number and the check digit is verified; a wrong one shows an error instead of a barcode.
5d74e7a11946.text: 会，适用于 EAN-13、EAN-8、UPC-A、UPC-E、ITF-14，以及 GS1-128 的 GTIN 和 SSCC 字段：省略最后一位，系统会自动算出。输入完整号码时会验证校验位；校验位错误时会显示错误提示，而不是条形码。

6a1ebedc3144.source: As you edit, the generator decodes the PNG it would download with ZXing, an open-source barcode reader, and tells you whether it reads back the value you entered. It also warns about low contrast, light bars on a dark background, red bars and a quiet zone below the minimum. It can't see your printer, label stock or lighting, so print a test and scan it with the scanners that will read it.
6a1ebedc3144.text: 编辑时，生成器会用开源条形码读取器 ZXing 解码即将下载的 PNG，并告诉你读出的内容是否与你输入的值一致。对于对比度过低、深色背景上的浅色条、红色条以及空白区小于最小值的情况，它也会给出警告。它无法了解你的打印机、标签纸或光照条件，所以请打印一份样张，用实际会读取它的扫描器扫描测试。

49270f92cd6f.source: Which file format should I download?
49270f92cd6f.text: 应该下载哪种文件格式？

a3d783fa6e0e.source: SVG, PDF or EPS for print: they're vectors, so the bars stay sharp at any size. SVG and EPS open in design tools such as Illustrator, InDesign and Affinity, and PDF opens anywhere. PNG is for screens, documents and online shops, and JPG for places that don't take PNG; WebP and AVIF make smaller files for websites. Raise the image size for bigger pictures.
a3d783fa6e0e.text: 印刷请选 SVG、PDF 或 EPS：它们是矢量格式，无论放大到多大，条都保持清晰。SVG 和 EPS 可在 Illustrator、InDesign 和 Affinity 等设计工具中打开，PDF 则几乎可以在任何地方打开。PNG 适用于屏幕、文档和网店，不支持 PNG 的地方可用 JPG；WebP 和 AVIF 的文件更小，适合网站。如需更大的图片，请调高图片尺寸。

f7713ffe7766.text: 可以保存我的条形码吗？

f82b55c71510.source: Yes, with a free QRdx account. Signed in, press Save to dashboard and the barcode goes to Barcodes in your workspace, where you can find it again, edit it, put it in a folder and download it in any format. Every plan saves barcodes: 1,000 on Free.
f82b55c71510.text: 可以，注册免费的 QRdx 账号即可。登录后点击“保存到控制台”，条形码就会进入工作区的“条形码”，你可以再次找到它、编辑、放入文件夹，并以任意格式下载。所有方案都可以保存条形码：免费版可保存 1,000 个。

4e5a8e3a8249.source: Yes. https://api.qrdx.dev/v1/barcode?format=ean13&data=590123412345 returns that EAN-13 as an SVG, with no key; add type=png, type=pdf or another file type. It checks values the same way this page does. With an API key you can also save barcodes to your workspace. Every option is in the docs at qrdx.dev/docs/developers/barcode-api.
4e5a8e3a8249.text: 有。https://api.qrdx.dev/v1/barcode?format=ean13&data=590123412345 会以 SVG 返回该 EAN-13，无需密钥；加上 type=png、type=pdf 或其他文件类型即可。它校验数值的方式与本页相同。使用 API 密钥还可以将条形码保存到你的工作区。所有选项见文档 qrdx.dev/docs/developers/barcode-api。

98cd715d964e.source: Can I track scans of a barcode?
98cd715d964e.text: 可以追踪条形码的扫描情况吗？

8739f8661645.source: No. Barcodes are static: the data is in the bars, and scanners read it without going online, so there's nothing to count. They don't expire either. If you need scan statistics, use a dynamic QR code, which points to a short link you can edit and track.
8739f8661645.text: 不可以。条形码是静态的：数据就在条中，扫描器无需联网即可读取，所以没有可统计的内容。它们也不会过期。如果需要扫描统计，请使用动态二维码，它指向一个可编辑、可追踪的短链接。

bca98641326b.source: The blank margin on each side of the bars. Scanners use it to find where the barcode starts and ends: EAN-13 needs 11 modules (narrow bar widths), Code 128 needs 10. The generator starts at the minimum and warns if you go below it; if you trim it, leave the space in your layout.
bca98641326b.text: 条两侧的空白边距。扫描器靠它判断条形码从哪里开始、到哪里结束：EAN-13 需要 11 个模块（窄条宽度），Code 128 需要 10 个。生成器默认从最小值开始，低于该值时会发出警告；如果你要裁切，请在版面中保留这部分空白。

4b180b6cd33d.source: What's the difference between a barcode and a QR code?
4b180b6cd33d.text: 条形码和二维码有什么区别？

e0d4bd443366.source: A linear barcode holds a short number or text in a row of bars, read by the laser and camera scanners at checkouts and in warehouses. A QR code is a 2D code that holds much more, such as a web address, and phone cameras read it on their own. For links, use a QR code.
e0d4bd443366.text: 线性条形码用一排条纹存储较短的数字或文本，收银台和仓库里的激光扫描枪与摄像头扫描器都能扫描。二维码是一种 2D 码，能存储多得多的内容，例如网址，手机摄像头本身就能扫描。如果要放链接，请使用二维码。

37ea21c3b2a6.source: Black and white, three columns, contact links
37ea21c3b2a6.text: 黑白风格，三列排版，附联系方式链接

82b1f4de4d38.source: Share the night's photos at full size
82b1f4de4d38.text: 以原图尺寸分享当晚的照片

dae238c2fcaa.source: Music, a podcast or a voice message with a player
dae238c2fcaa.text: 带播放器的音乐、播客或语音留言

f10cf3d63108.source: Cover art, a playlist and your profiles
f10cf3d63108.text: 封面图、播放列表和你的主页

20dfa0d38b9c.text: 最新几期节目及节目说明

5b7e4faca666.source: One recording for a card, a gift or a tour stop
5b7e4faca666.text: 一段录音，用于贺卡、礼物或导览站点

0ca386de0b3f.source: A YouTube, Vimeo or Loom video, or a video file you upload
0ca386de0b3f.text: YouTube、Vimeo 或 Loom 视频，或你上传的视频文件

af8d2308e9f2.source: A YouTube or Vimeo video with specs and a buy button
af8d2308e9f2.text: YouTube 或 Vimeo 视频，附规格参数和购买按钮

a249e98f77c7.source: Play your own MP4, no YouTube needed
a249e98f77c7.text: 播放你自己的 MP4，无需 YouTube

9b3a06cc1857.source: A short silent clip that plays on its own, like a GIF
9b3a06cc1857.text: 自动播放的无声短片，类似 GIF

3dbbbac8c43d.source: Tracks that play in a row: a mix, an audio tour or chapters
3dbbbac8c43d.text: 连续播放的音轨：混音合辑、语音导览或章节

fae3b174bf21.source: Cover art, the tracklist and where else to listen
fae3b174bf21.text: 封面图、曲目列表和其他收听渠道

724e6c0779f1.source: Numbered stops for a museum, a walk or a building
724e6c0779f1.text: 为博物馆、步行路线或建筑设置编号站点

b157f464b24d.source: Chapters to listen to in order or download
b157f464b24d.text: 章节可按顺序收听或下载

33280921ce6a.source: Start from scratch and build any page from blocks
33280921ce6a.text: 从零开始，用区块搭建任意页面

3a678cd77585.source: Headline, details and one call to action
3a678cd77585.text: 标题、详情和一个行动号召

c9770435fe2e.source: A teaser with an email sign-up for opening day
c9770435fe2e.text: 预告页，附开业当天的邮箱订阅

b7175bfc6624.source: Part of QRdx. Set it up in your dashboard or settings.
b7175bfc6624.text: QRdx 自带功能，可在控制台或设置中配置。

a4e050ac551f.source: Connect your account with a secure sign-in or your own API key.
a4e050ac551f.text: 通过安全登录或您自己的 API 密钥连接账户。

f56d91e17abf.source: Works through the other tool, with step-by-step setup.
f56d91e17abf.text: 通过其他工具使用，附分步设置说明。

2aa053ce8e59.source: Add QRdx to a Slack channel for scan milestones, form submissions and code changes.
2aa053ce8e59.text: 将 QRdx 添加到 Slack 频道，接收扫描里程碑、表单提交和二维码变更提醒。

a656d0561b95.source: Click Add to Slack, pick a channel, and QRdx posts the alerts you choose there: a code's first scan and milestones, new form responses and code changes. Each alert is a short message with a link back to the code or the responses.
a656d0561b95.text: 点击“添加到 Slack”，选择一个频道，QRdx 就会把你选定的提醒发送到该频道：二维码的首次扫描和扫描里程碑、新的表单回复以及二维码变更。每条提醒都是一条简短消息，并附有返回二维码或回复页面的链接。

3fbcc78b9617.source: Targets are per person and per workspace, so every teammate can send their own alerts to their own channels. Already pasted an incoming webhook URL? It keeps working, and you can still paste one instead of connecting.
3fbcc78b9617.text: 提醒目标按个人和工作区分别设置，因此每位团队成员都可以把自己的提醒发送到自己的频道。已经粘贴过传入 webhook URL？它会继续有效，你也仍然可以粘贴 URL 来代替连接。

3d1b3e9d5415.source: Add the QRdx bot to your Slack workspace and anyone there can make a QR code without leaving Slack: type /qr with a link or any text, mention @QRdx, send the bot a direct message, or pick Make a QR code from a message's menu. The code comes back as an image, with buttons to download it as PNG or SVG or open it in the editor.
3d1b3e9d5415.text: 将 QRdx 机器人添加到你的 Slack 工作区后，工作区里的任何人都无需离开 Slack 就能生成二维码：输入 /qr 加链接或任意文字，提及 @QRdx，给机器人发私信，或在消息菜单中选择“生成二维码”。二维码会以图片形式返回，并附有按钮，可下载为 PNG 或 SVG，也可在编辑器中打开。

8906b7287c80.source: Menus under the code change its look, color, frame and logo, and options after the link do the same (/qr qrdx.dev --look modern). Every styled code is checked so phones can scan it, and Open in editor opens the same design.
8906b7287c80.text: 二维码下方的菜单可更改其外观、颜色、边框和 Logo，链接后面的选项也能做到同样的事（/qr qrdx.dev --look modern）。每个带样式的二维码都经过检查，确保手机可以扫描，而“在编辑器中打开”会打开同一个设计。

86a8cb0c0a47.source: Link your QRdx account with /qr link, and /qr track with a link makes a dynamic code in the QRdx workspace you picked, with scan analytics and a destination you can change later. It follows your role and plan, the same as making a code in the dashboard.
86a8cb0c0a47.text: 用 /qr link 关联你的 QRdx 账号后，/qr track 加链接就会在你选定的 QRdx 工作区中生成动态二维码，附带扫描分析，目标地址之后还可以修改。它遵循你的角色和套餐，与在控制台中生成二维码时一致。

23739fca87b1.source: Make QR codes in Slack with /qr, and get scan milestones, form submissions and code changes in a channel.
23739fca87b1.text: 在 Slack 中用 /qr 生成二维码，并在频道中接收扫描里程碑、表单提交和二维码变更提醒。

ef558052af89.source: In Settings → Integrations → Slack, click Add the bot to Slack and pick your Slack workspace. Everyone in it can then make QR codes there.
ef558052af89.text: 在“设置 → 集成 → Slack”中，点击“将机器人添加到 Slack”，然后选择你的 Slack 工作区。之后工作区里的每个人都可以在那里生成二维码。

cc74782ae864.text: 在 Slack 中生成二维码

76392e0a3c29.source: Type /qr with a link or any text, mention @QRdx in a channel, message the bot, or pick Make a QR code from a message's menu.
76392e0a3c29.text: 输入 /qr 加链接或任意文字，在频道中提及 @QRdx，给机器人发消息，或在消息菜单中选择“生成二维码”。

f743210b25fc.source: Link your account for tracked codes
f743210b25fc.text: 关联账号以生成可追踪的二维码

a4124df30ca6.source: Run /qr link, pick the QRdx workspace and confirm. After that, /qr track with a link makes a dynamic code there.
a4124df30ca6.text: 运行 /qr link，选择 QRdx 工作区并确认。之后，/qr track 加链接就会在该工作区中生成动态二维码。

a959c1de9481.source: On the same settings page, click Add to Slack, pick the workspace in QRdx, then the Slack channel. Alerts are part of the Business plan; choose them in Settings → Notifications.
a959c1de9481.text: 在同一设置页面中，点击“添加到 Slack”，先在 QRdx 中选择工作区，再选择 Slack 频道。提醒属于 Business 套餐，可在“设置 → 通知”中选择。

1819e13814c2.source: /qr, mentions, direct messages and a message shortcut reply with a QR code image and links to the PNG, the SVG and the editor.
1819e13814c2.text: /qr、提及、私信和消息快捷操作都会回复二维码图片，以及 PNG、SVG 和编辑器的链接。

cf545214e165.source: Looks, colors, frames and logo icons from the menus under a code or typed options, checked so every code still scans.
cf545214e165.text: 通过二维码下方的菜单或输入的选项设置外观、颜色、边框和 Logo 图标，并经过检查，确保每个二维码依然可以扫描。

fd7b88c12f9e.text: 从 Slack 生成追踪二维码

ae74f52c9d25.source: Linked accounts make dynamic codes with /qr track, under their own role and plan limits.
ae74f52c9d25.text: 已关联的账号可用 /qr track 生成动态二维码，并遵循各自的角色和套餐限制。

fd054f2a06de.source: In Settings → Integrations → Slack (or Settings → Notifications), pick the workspace in QRdx, then the Slack channel. QRdx asks only for permission to post to that channel (incoming-webhook).
fd054f2a06de.text: 在“设置 → 集成 → Slack”（或“设置 → 通知”）中，先在 QRdx 中选择工作区，再选择 Slack 频道。QRdx 只请求向该频道发帖的权限（incoming-webhook）。

da46610f711a.source: The channel appears under Settings → Notifications with milestones and form responses on. Change the events there, or send a test.
da46610f711a.text: 该频道会出现在“设置 → 通知”中，里程碑和表单回复提醒默认开启。你可以在那里更改事件，或发送一条测试消息。

783ed27843d5.source: Prefer your own Slack app? Click + Slack in Settings → Notifications and paste its incoming webhook URL.
783ed27843d5.text: 想用自己的 Slack 应用？在“设置 → 通知”中点击“+ Slack”，然后粘贴其传入 webhook URL。

2a1f4782a074.source: A code's first scan, with when, where and on which device, then 10, 100, 1,000 scans and beyond.
2a1f4782a074.text: 二维码的首次扫描（包括时间、地点和设备），以及之后的 10 次、100 次、1,000 次扫描及更多。

fd93a09d4b56.source: The answers from a form on one of your hosted pages, with a link to all responses.
fd93a09d4b56.text: 您托管页面上某个表单收到的答复，并附有查看全部回复的链接。

bad636cdb3d7.source: Who created a code, or changed its destination, title, design or domain.
bad636cdb3d7.text: 谁创建了二维码，或者修改了它的目标地址、标题、设计或域名。

a7bf2072a0f4.source: At most 30 alerts of one kind per hour, and never @everyone, @here or role mentions.
a7bf2072a0f4.text: 同类提醒每小时最多 30 条，并且绝不会 @everyone、@here 或提及任何角色。

8cd045a9f80a.source: Post scan milestones, form submissions and code changes to a Discord channel.
8cd045a9f80a.text: 将扫描里程碑、表单提交和二维码变更发送到 Discord 频道。

c4aa3b1fba8b.source: Paste a Discord channel webhook into QRdx and choose the events. Alerts arrive as short messages with a link back to QRdx.
c4aa3b1fba8b.text: 将 Discord 频道的 webhook 粘贴到 QRdx 并选择事件。提醒会以简短消息的形式送达，并附有返回 QRdx 的链接。

0ebfcf6ef506.source: Messages never mention @everyone, @here or roles, whatever visitors type into a form.
0ebfcf6ef506.text: 无论访客在表单中输入什么，消息都不会提及 @everyone、@here 或任何角色。

1a90a4e98269.source: To make QR codes in Discord, add the QRdx bot too: /qr turns a link or text into a code, and Apps → Make QR code turns any message into one.
1a90a4e98269.text: 若要在 Discord 中生成二维码，请同时添加 QRdx 机器人：/qr 可将链接或文本变成二维码，Apps → Make QR code 可将任意消息变成二维码。

343cd5e67296.source: Create a channel webhook in Discord
343cd5e67296.text: 在 Discord 中创建频道 webhook

82fbe492b25b.source: Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL.
82fbe492b25b.text: 频道设置 → 集成 → Webhooks → 新建 Webhook → 复制 Webhook URL。

587c054aa54f.source: In Settings → Notifications, click + Discord in the workspace, paste the URL and choose the events.
587c054aa54f.text: 在“设置 → 通知”中，点击工作区里的 + Discord，粘贴该 URL 并选择事件。

76680a4720a7.source: Use the send button next to the target to post a test message.
76680a4720a7.text: 点击目标旁边的发送按钮，即可发送一条测试消息。

8a956f97121d.source: A Monday digest of last week's scans, plus emails for milestones, form responses and code changes.
8a956f97121d.text: 每周一发送上周扫描汇总，并在达成里程碑、收到表单回复或二维码变更时发送邮件。

2f8a6b78f067.source: Turn on the weekly digest to get last week's scans compared with the week before, unique visitors, your top 5 codes, top countries, new codes and form responses, every Monday.
2f8a6b78f067.text: 开启每周摘要后，每周一都会收到上周的扫描次数（与前一周对比）、独立访客、前 5 个二维码、热门国家和地区、新建二维码以及表单回复。

8fa0ebbf7e5d.source: Alert emails cover scan milestones, form submissions, new codes and code changes. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe link.
8fa0ebbf7e5d.text: 提醒邮件涵盖扫描里程碑、表单提交、新建二维码和二维码变更。每封邮件都带有一键退订链接。

374cae4737ef.source: Your own workspace and every other workspace you belong to have their own switches.
374cae4737ef.text: 你自己的工作区以及你加入的每个其他工作区都有各自的开关。

7a4f98bb8eae.source: Turn on the emails you want

5c95c3e0fde8.source: Weekly digest, scan milestones, form submissions, new codes or code changes. Everything is off until you turn it on.
5c95c3e0fde8.text: 每周摘要、扫描里程碑、表单提交、新建二维码或二维码变更。所有邮件在你开启之前都是关闭的。
