941af00b5405.source: Scans vs the week before, unique visitors, top codes and countries, every Monday.
941af00b5405.text: 每周一发送扫描次数（与前一周对比）、独立访客、热门二维码和热门国家和地区。

fc796e67c5e1.source: Milestones, form responses, new codes and changes, sent to your account email.
fc796e67c5e1.text: 里程碑、表单回复、新建二维码和变更，都会发送到你的账户邮箱。

662d718d5ebf.source: Every email can turn off its own kind without signing in.
662d718d5ebf.text: 无需登录，即可在每封邮件中关闭对应类型的邮件。

5e6694e3e922.source: Make QR codes in Discord with /qr, or from any message, in servers and DMs.
5e6694e3e922.text: 用 /qr 或任意消息，在服务器和私信中生成二维码。

82d434ac50eb.source: Type /qr with a link or some text and the bot replies with the QR code, plus buttons to download it as a PNG or SVG or open it in the QRdx editor. Set private to True and only you see it.
82d434ac50eb.text: 输入 /qr 加上链接或文字，机器人就会回复二维码，并附上按钮，可下载 PNG 或 SVG，也可在 QRdx 编辑器中打开。将 private 设为 True，则只有你能看到。

610fd0c03886.source: Pick a look, color or frame in /qr, or restyle the code afterwards from the Look, Color, Frame and Logo menus under it. Every styled code is checked so phones can scan it, and Open in editor opens the same design.
610fd0c03886.text: 在 /qr 中选择样式、颜色或边框，也可以之后通过二维码下方的“样式”“颜色”“边框”和“Logo”菜单重新调整。每个设计过的二维码都经过检查，确保手机可以扫描，“在编辑器中打开”会打开同一个设计。

4494ac9874c0.source: To make a code from a message someone posted, open the message's menu and choose Apps → Make QR code. The code holds the first web address in the message, or its text when there's no link.
4494ac9874c0.text: 要为别人发的消息生成二维码，打开该消息的菜单，选择“应用 → 生成二维码”。二维码包含消息中的第一个网址；如果没有链接，则包含消息文字。

17c96f1b247a.source: Add the bot to a server, or to your own account to use it in DMs, group DMs and other servers too. It needs no QRdx account, and nothing you make is saved: the content travels in the image link, and QRdx draws the image when Discord asks for it.
17c96f1b247a.text: 可以把机器人添加到服务器，或添加到你自己的账号，这样在私信、群组私信和其他服务器中也能使用。无需 QRdx 账号，你生成的内容也不会被保存：内容包含在图片链接中，Discord 请求图片时由 QRdx 绘制。

b7099a32b7a9.source: Discord asks whether to add QRdx to your account or to a server. On your account, you can use it in DMs, group DMs and servers. On a server, everyone there can use it; adding it there needs the Manage Server permission.
b7099a32b7a9.text: Discord 会询问是将 QRdx 添加到你的账号还是某个服务器。添加到账号后，可在私信、群组私信和服务器中使用。添加到服务器后，服务器里的所有人都能使用；添加时需要“管理服务器”权限。

a62e9c42f9b8.source: Type /qr, then the link or text. The reply shows the code with Download PNG, Download SVG and Open in editor.
a62e9c42f9b8.text: 输入 /qr，再输入链接或文字。回复中会显示二维码，以及“下载 PNG”“下载 SVG”和“在编辑器中打开”。

198eecf2392b.text: 在任意 Discord 聊天中

0baeac7aaf77.source: Or make one from a message

88fa50e30864.source: Right-click a message (long-press on mobile), then Apps → Make QR code.
88fa50e30864.text: 右键点击消息（手机上长按），然后选择“应用 → 生成二维码”。

589bfc4712d6.source: A QR code for any link or text, with PNG and SVG downloads.
589bfc4712d6.text: 为任意链接或文字生成二维码，支持下载 PNG 和 SVG。

f103d78f7d82.source: Turns a message into a code: its first web address, or its text.
f103d78f7d82.text: 把消息变成二维码：内容为其中第一个网址，或消息文字。

e4a974b81176.source: Add it to a server, or to your own account for DMs and group DMs.
e4a974b81176.text: 可添加到服务器，也可添加到你自己的账号，用于私信和群组私信。

7f2c80e6e1a5.source: Looks, colors, frames and logo icons, checked so every code still scans.
7f2c80e6e1a5.text: 样式、颜色、边框和 Logo 图标，均经过检查，确保每个二维码依然可以扫描。

0139fe7a29d4.source: No QRdx account, and replies never ping anyone.
0139fe7a29d4.text: 无需 QRdx 账号，回复也不会 @ 任何人。

9f65a51d131d.source: Make QR codes in any Telegram chat: message the QRdx bot, call it inline, or use /qr in a group.
9f65a51d131d.text: 在任意 Telegram 聊天中生成二维码：给 QRdx 机器人发消息、以内联方式调用，或在群组中使用 /qr。

2d1e1ac603cc.source: Send the QRdx bot a link or some text and it replies with the QR code, with buttons to download it as PNG or SVG or open it in the editor. Tap Style to pick a look, color, frame or logo, or type options after the link. Every styled code is checked so phones can scan it.
2d1e1ac603cc.text: 向 QRdx 机器人发送链接或文字，它会回复对应的二维码，并附带按钮，可下载 PNG 或 SVG，也可在编辑器中打开。点按“样式”可选择外观、颜色、边框或 Logo，也可以在链接后直接输入选项。每个设置了样式的二维码都经过检查，确保手机可以扫描。

eaabb36a8160.source: In any other chat, type the bot's username followed by a link, then tap the code to send it there. In a group, add the bot and send /qr with a link or text. No QRdx account needed.
eaabb36a8160.text: 在其他任意聊天中，输入机器人的用户名，再加上链接，然后点按二维码即可发送到该聊天。在群组中，先添加机器人，再发送 /qr 加链接或文字。无需 QRdx 账号。

27b027c9b74f.source: QRdx doesn't save the codes you make. The content goes into the image link, and like any link it can end up in logs and caches, so don't make codes of passwords or other secrets.
27b027c9b74f.text: QRdx 不会保存你生成的二维码。内容包含在图片链接中，与任何链接一样，可能会留存在日志和缓存里，因此请不要用密码或其他机密信息生成二维码。

d3968e569083.source: Click Open in Telegram and tap Start. The bot's chat opens in the Telegram app or on the web.
d3968e569083.text: 点击“在 Telegram 中打开”，然后点按 Start。机器人的聊天会在 Telegram 应用或网页中打开。

ce53c3578600.source: The bot answers with the QR code and buttons to download a PNG or SVG, restyle it with Style, or open it in the editor.
ce53c3578600.text: 机器人会回复二维码，并附带按钮，可下载 PNG 或 SVG、通过“样式”重新设置样式，或在编辑器中打开。

87a6619118d8.source: In any chat, type @ and the bot's username, a space and a link, then tap the code to send it. In a group, add the bot and send /qr followed by a link or text.
87a6619118d8.text: 在任意聊天中，输入 @ 和机器人的用户名，加一个空格和链接，然后点按二维码发送。在群组中，先添加机器人，再发送 /qr 加链接或文字。

918802866b93.source: Send a link or text and get the QR code back, ready to download.
918802866b93.text: 发送链接或文字，即可收到二维码，随时可下载。

061055243836.source: Type the bot's username and a link, then send the code without leaving the conversation.
061055243836.text: 输入机器人的用户名和链接，无需离开当前对话即可发送二维码。

b68bd097b501.source: /qr with a link or text. With privacy mode on, the bot only sees commands meant for it.
b68bd097b501.text: 使用 /qr 加链接或文字。开启隐私模式后，机器人只会看到发给它的命令。

1b77e09a154b.source: Looks, colors, frames and logo icons from the Style button or typed options, checked so every code still scans.
1b77e09a154b.text: 通过“样式”按钮或输入的选项设置外观、颜色、边框和 Logo 图标，并经过检查，确保每个二维码仍可扫描。

44396e51737e.source: Nothing to sign up for. QRdx doesn't save your codes, and each image comes from a link that carries its content.
44396e51737e.text: 无需注册。QRdx 不会保存你的二维码，每张图片都来自一个包含其内容的链接。

d59ebd3b321d.source: Get a signed HTTPS request when codes are scanned, created or changed, or a form is submitted.
d59ebd3b321d.text: 二维码被扫描、创建或更改，或有表单提交时，您会收到一条已签名的 HTTPS 请求。

da0656aa0c54.source: Webhooks send events from a workspace to a URL you control as they happen: update a CRM when someone fills in a form, post to an internal tool when a code passes 1,000 scans, or keep your own copy of scan data.
da0656aa0c54.text: Webhook 会在事件发生时，把工作区中的事件发送到您指定的 URL：有人填写表单时更新 CRM，二维码扫描次数超过 1,000 次时向内部工具发送通知，或者自行保存一份扫描数据。

b0ec018f6eaf.source: They are also how Zapier, Make, n8n and any other automation tool receive QRdx events.
b0ec018f6eaf.text: Zapier、Make、n8n 以及其他自动化工具也是通过它接收 QRdx 事件的。

65da371a4f39.source: Open Settings → Webhooks, click Add endpoint, enter a public https:// URL and pick the events.
65da371a4f39.text: 打开“设置 → Webhooks”，点击“添加端点”，输入公开的 https:// URL 并选择事件。

5b49c1574a3b.source: It is shown after saving. Owners and admins can reveal or rotate it later.
5b49c1574a3b.text: 保存后会显示该密钥。所有者和管理员之后可以查看或轮换它。

3c5e795b8303.source: Compute an HMAC-SHA256 of `<timestamp>.<raw body>` and compare it with v1 in X-QRdx-Signature.
3c5e795b8303.text: 对 `<timestamp>.<raw body>` 计算 HMAC-SHA256，并与 X-QRdx-Signature 中的 v1 比较。

91e587bc8264.source: Click Send test. QRdx sends a signed ping event and shows the response status.
91e587bc8264.text: 点击“发送测试”。QRdx 会发送一个已签名的 ping 事件，并显示响应状态。

b416a3833ca1.source: Scans (batched per minute), scan milestones, new and changed codes, and form submissions.
b416a3833ca1.text: 扫描（每分钟批量发送）、扫描里程碑、新建和更改的二维码，以及表单提交。

74329f96be83.source: Failed deliveries are retried 8 times, and every delivery shows in the endpoint's log.
74329f96be83.text: 投递失败后会重试 8 次，每次投递都会显示在端点的日志中。

1b541b5939d0.source: Each request carries an HMAC-SHA256 signature you can verify with your signing secret.
1b541b5939d0.text: 每个请求都带有 HMAC-SHA256 签名，您可以用签名密钥进行验证。

025d48c0cdae.source: Tools can subscribe and unsubscribe on their own through /api/v1/hooks.
025d48c0cdae.text: 工具可以通过 /api/v1/hooks 自行订阅和取消订阅。

d72924916a4d.source: Start Zaps from QRdx scans, milestones and form responses with Webhooks by Zapier.
d72924916a4d.text: 通过 Webhooks by Zapier，由 QRdx 的扫描、里程碑和表单回复触发 Zap。

2736f9cd6520.source: Use a Webhooks by Zapier “Catch Hook” trigger as a QRdx webhook endpoint and every event you pick starts your Zap: add form responses to a CRM, email your team at 1,000 scans, or log each scan.
2736f9cd6520.text: 将 Webhooks by Zapier 的“Catch Hook”触发器用作 QRdx 的 webhook 端点，你选择的每个事件都会启动 Zap：把表单回复添加到 CRM，在扫描达到 1,000 次时给团队发邮件，或记录每一次扫描。

1d3d5c6bb241.source: A scan.created delivery is one batch of up to 100 scans per minute, so use the data.scans line items to act on each scan.
1d3d5c6bb241.text: 一次 scan.created 推送是每分钟最多 100 次扫描的一个批次，因此请使用 data.scans 行项目来处理每一次扫描。

cd34f6a8bd88.source: Webhooks by Zapier is a premium Zapier app.
cd34f6a8bd88.text: Webhooks by Zapier 是 Zapier 的高级应用。

0db4b184954b.source: Create a Zap with a Catch Hook trigger
0db4b184954b.text: 创建带有 Catch Hook 触发器的 Zap

8aac417a07aa.source: In Zapier, pick Webhooks by Zapier as the trigger app and Catch Hook as the event, then copy the webhook URL it gives you.
8aac417a07aa.text: 在 Zapier 中，选择 Webhooks by Zapier 作为触发应用，选择 Catch Hook 作为事件，然后复制它提供的 webhook URL。

2c4734a0b500.text: 将 URL 添加到 QRdx

816753f0312e.source: Open Settings → Webhooks, click Add endpoint, paste the Zapier URL and pick the events, for example form.submitted or scan.milestone.
816753f0312e.text: 打开“设置 → Webhooks”，点击“添加端点”，粘贴 Zapier 的 URL 并选择事件，例如 form.submitted 或 scan.milestone。

7ec4f996a961.source: Send a sample and test the trigger
7ec4f996a961.text: 发送示例并测试触发器

c264d97b3cbc.source: Submit your form or create a code so a real event arrives, then click Test trigger in Zapier and map the fields in your actions.
c264d97b3cbc.text: 提交表单或创建二维码，让一个真实事件到达，然后在 Zapier 中点击“Test trigger”，并在后续操作中映射字段。

6bc2ac4c8053.source: Run Make scenarios on QRdx scans, milestones and form responses with a custom webhook.
6bc2ac4c8053.text: 通过自定义 webhook，由 QRdx 的扫描、里程碑和表单回复运行 Make 场景。

ef05d56b158c.source: Start a scenario with Make's Webhooks → Custom webhook module and add its address as a QRdx endpoint. Every event you pick runs the scenario, ready to route into thousands of apps.
ef05d56b158c.text: 用 Make 的 Webhooks → Custom webhook 模块启动一个场景，并把它的地址添加为 QRdx 端点。你选择的每个事件都会运行该场景，可以轻松接入数千款应用。

34301a4297af.source: Payloads are JSON envelopes with an id, type, created_at and data, so Make can learn the structure from the first request.
34301a4297af.text: 载荷是包含 id、type、created_at 和 data 的 JSON 信封，因此 Make 可以从第一个请求中识别其结构。

7918ebcb772c.source: Add a Custom webhook trigger in Make
7918ebcb772c.text: 在 Make 中添加 Custom webhook 触发器

98fb6820fcba.source: Create a scenario, add Webhooks → Custom webhook, click Add and copy the webhook address.
98fb6820fcba.text: 创建一个场景，添加 Webhooks → Custom webhook，点击 Add 并复制 webhook 地址。

195d2355b033.source: Open Settings → Webhooks, click Add endpoint, paste the Make URL and pick the events, for example form.submitted or scan.milestone.
195d2355b033.text: 打开“设置 → Webhooks”，点击“添加端点”，粘贴 Make 的 URL 并选择事件，例如 form.submitted 或 scan.milestone。

4c4e76b9c24c.source: Let Make learn the data structure
4c4e76b9c24c.text: 让 Make 识别数据结构

c1aef398b5be.source: Click Run once in Make, then trigger a real event in QRdx (submit your form or create a code). Make reads the fields so you can map them.
c1aef398b5be.text: 在 Make 中点击 Run once，然后在 QRdx 中触发一个真实事件（提交表单或创建二维码）。Make 会读取这些字段，方便你进行映射。

47618aa4c935.source: Make QR codes, manage dynamic codes and start n8n workflows from QRdx events with the QRdx nodes, or with a Webhook node.
47618aa4c935.text: 通过 QRdx 节点或 Webhook 节点，生成二维码、管理动态二维码，并由 QRdx 事件启动 n8n 工作流。

ce1e3f5518a5.source: The QRdx nodes for n8n make QR code images with no API key, create, update, archive and delete dynamic codes, and read their scans and your saved themes. An n8n AI Agent can use the QRdx node as a tool. The QRdx Trigger node subscribes to the events you pick when you activate the workflow, and checks the signature of every delivery.
ce1e3f5518a5.text: n8n 的 QRdx 节点无需 API 密钥即可生成二维码图片，可创建、更新、归档和删除动态二维码，并读取它们的扫描数据和你保存的主题。n8n AI Agent 可以把 QRdx 节点当作工具使用。QRdx Trigger 节点会在你激活工作流时订阅所选事件，并校验每次推送的签名。

a35b03cc8aa4.source: Without installing anything, a Webhook node set to POST can be a QRdx webhook endpoint instead, on n8n Cloud or self-hosted. QRdx only delivers to public https:// addresses, so a self-hosted n8n needs a public domain with HTTPS either way.
a35b03cc8aa4.text: 无需安装任何东西，设为 POST 的 Webhook 节点也可以作为 QRdx 的 webhook 端点，n8n Cloud 和自托管均可。QRdx 只会推送到公开的 https:// 地址，因此无论哪种方式，自托管的 n8n 都需要一个支持 HTTPS 的公开域名。

58caf6033ed9.source: On npm as @qrdx/n8n-nodes-qrdx, for self-hosted n8n. n8n Cloud runs only nodes n8n has verified, and this one isn't yet.
58caf6033ed9.text: 已发布在 npm，名称为 @qrdx/n8n-nodes-qrdx，适用于自托管的 n8n。n8n Cloud 只运行 n8n 已验证的节点，而这个节点尚未通过验证。

15ae08137d1d.source: In n8n, open Settings → Community Nodes, click Install and enter @qrdx/n8n-nodes-qrdx. Or install it from a terminal in the nodes folder of your n8n user folder, then restart n8n.
15ae08137d1d.text: 在 n8n 中打开“设置 → Community Nodes”，点击“安装”并输入 @qrdx/n8n-nodes-qrdx。也可以在 n8n 用户文件夹下的 nodes 文件夹中，通过终端安装，然后重启 n8n。

187f010b089f.source: Create an API key in Settings → API keys & apps and save it in a new QRdx API credential in n8n.
187f010b089f.text: 在“设置 → API keys & apps”中创建 API 密钥，并将其保存到 n8n 中新建的 QRdx API 凭据里。

bb835f8e0a2d.source: No install needed: add a Webhook node set to POST, activate the workflow, and add its production URL in Settings → Webhooks.
bb835f8e0a2d.text: 无需安装：添加一个设为 POST 的 Webhook 节点，激活工作流，然后在“设置 → Webhooks”中添加它的生产环境 URL。

1dfda0f6350b.source: PNG, SVG or EPS with your colors, shapes, frame and logo icon, without an API key.
1dfda0f6350b.text: 支持 PNG、SVG 或 EPS，可使用你的颜色、形状、边框和 Logo 图标，无需 API 密钥。

ab125fac8e23.source: Create, get, list, update, archive and delete codes from a workflow.
ab125fac8e23.text: 在工作流中创建、获取、列出、更新、归档和删除二维码。

363a7c14e129.source: Individual scans, or totals with top countries, devices and referrers.
363a7c14e129.text: 可获取单次扫描，或总量以及排名靠前的国家、设备和来源。

cf507e9860d8.source: Scans, milestones, new and changed codes, and form submissions, with signed deliveries. Needs Business.
cf507e9860d8.text: 支持扫描、里程碑、新建和变更的二维码以及表单提交事件，推送均带签名。需要 Business。

dd0af966bbf8.source: Export scans and form responses to a new Google Sheet, and keep scans in sync.
dd0af966bbf8.text: 将扫描记录和表单回复导出到新的 Google Sheet，并保持扫描记录同步。

78bc13a28f31.source: Connect Google Sheets and export the scans of one code or every code to a new spreadsheet: time, code, country, city, device, OS, browser, referrer and language. Turn on Keep in sync and new scans are appended in batches, at most one request every five minutes, never one per scan.
78bc13a28f31.text: 连接 Google Sheets，即可将单个二维码或所有二维码的扫描记录导出到新的电子表格：时间、二维码、国家或地区、城市、设备、操作系统、浏览器、来源页面和语言。开启“保持同步”后，新的扫描记录会分批追加，最多每五分钟发送一次请求，不会每次扫描都发送一次。

181ce693c9af.source: Form responses from a hosted page export the same way, one column per question. QRdx only reaches spreadsheets it creates (drive.file), and rows are written as plain text, so visitor input never runs as a formula.
181ce693c9af.text: 托管页面上的表单回复也可以用同样的方式导出，每个问题对应一列。QRdx 只会访问由它创建的电子表格（drive.file），并且各行内容以纯文本写入，因此访客输入的内容不会作为公式运行。

f9cb1db17113.source: Click Enable and choose your Google account
f9cb1db17113.text: 点击“启用”并选择你的 Google 账号

e824368c4aea.source: Settings → Integrations → Google Sheets. This is a separate sign-in from Google Drive.
e824368c4aea.text: 设置 → 集成 → Google Sheets。此登录与 Google Drive 的登录相互独立。

d0c6b9ce3e04.source: Pick one code or all codes and click Export. The new sheet opens in Google Sheets.
d0c6b9ce3e04.text: 选择一个二维码或全部二维码，然后点击“导出”。新的表格会在 Google Sheets 中打开。

188d6737c8d9.source: Turn on Keep in sync and new scans are appended in batches. The last sync and any error show in settings.
188d6737c8d9.text: 开启“保持同步”后，新的扫描记录会分批追加。上次同步时间和任何错误都会显示在设置中。

9578b30377dc.source: On a page's Responses screen, click Export to Google Sheets.
9578b30377dc.text: 在页面的“回复”界面中，点击“导出到 Google Sheets”。

b92a527b00db.source: Time, code, country, city, device, OS, browser, referrer and language.
b92a527b00db.text: 时间、二维码、国家或地区、城市、设备、操作系统、浏览器、来源页面和语言。

e881c6f374fe.source: New scans appended in batches, retried with backoff, never duplicated.
e881c6f374fe.text: 新的扫描记录分批追加，失败后按退避策略重试，不会重复写入。

93847a43e3c7.source: One row per response, one column per question.
93847a43e3c7.text: 每条回复一行，每个问题一列。

ba8022ee1559.source: Every form response on your hosted pages creates or updates a HubSpot contact.
ba8022ee1559.text: 托管页面上的每一条表单回复，都会创建或更新一个 HubSpot 联系人。

f5b2ea269b06.source: Connect HubSpot, choose the pages, and map each form's questions to contact properties. Email, name and phone are suggested for you. New responses then upsert a contact by email, so the same person never becomes two contacts.
f5b2ea269b06.text: 连接 HubSpot，选择页面，并将每个表单的问题映射到联系人属性。系统会为你推荐电子邮件、姓名和电话。之后的新回复会按电子邮件更新或创建联系人，因此同一个人不会变成两个联系人。

1840a2012243.source: QRdx asks only to write contacts (crm.objects.contacts.write), and only questions you map are sent.
1840a2012243.text: QRdx 只请求写入联系人的权限（crm.objects.contacts.write），并且只会发送你已映射的问题。

597e877817c9.source: Click Enable and pick your HubSpot account
597e877817c9.text: 点击“启用”并选择你的 HubSpot 账户

43bb77f28138.source: Settings → Integrations → HubSpot. Approve contacts write access.
43bb77f28138.text: 设置 → 集成 → HubSpot。批准联系人写入权限。

71a18687a466.source: Pick the hosted pages whose forms should reach HubSpot, check the suggested mapping, and turn the sync on.
71a18687a466.text: 选择表单需要同步到 HubSpot 的托管页面，检查推荐的映射，然后开启同步。

ec9f0e276cac.source: Responses after you turn it on are sent within minutes. Responses without an email are skipped.
ec9f0e276cac.text: 开启之后收到的回复会在几分钟内发送。没有电子邮件的回复会被跳过。

11d481717d2a.text: 按电子邮件更新或创建

7750e4a9a551.source: One contact per person, updated by later responses.
7750e4a9a551.text: 每个人只对应一个联系人，后续回复会更新该联系人。

e0cd8c9b155c.source: Email, name, phone, company and more, with suggested defaults.
e0cd8c9b155c.text: 电子邮件、姓名、电话、公司等，并提供推荐的默认设置。

66754d9a5e54.source: Batched, retried with backoff for about two days, never sent twice, with the last sync shown in settings.
66754d9a5e54.text: 批量发送，失败后按退避策略重试约两天，绝不重复发送，最近一次同步会显示在设置中。

2a2e3ef2623f.source: Add people who fill in your forms to a Mailchimp audience, with tags, respecting consent.
2a2e3ef2623f.text: 将填写表单的人添加到 Mailchimp 受众，附带标签，并尊重用户的同意选择。

8c86322edf6b.source: Connect Mailchimp, pick an audience and tags, and map each form's questions to merge fields. Each new response adds or updates a member.
8c86322edf6b.text: 连接 Mailchimp，选择受众和标签，并将每个表单的问题映射到合并字段。每条新回复都会添加或更新一位成员。

70e685881118.source: Consent comes first: with a consent checkbox on the form, only people who tick it are subscribed. Without one, people get Mailchimp's confirmation email (double opt-in) or are skipped, as you choose. Nobody who unsubscribed is ever re-subscribed, and only questions the form asked are sent.
70e685881118.text: 同意优先：如果表单中有同意复选框，只有勾选的人才会被订阅。如果没有，则按你的选择，向对方发送 Mailchimp 的确认邮件（双重确认订阅），或者跳过。已退订的人绝不会被重新订阅，并且只会发送表单中提出的问题。

43e709c24e32.source: Click Enable and log in to Mailchimp

a0c0e2f889bf.source: Pick the audience, tags and pages

2c7d425e0653.source: Then check the field mapping and the consent checkbox QRdx found on each form.
2c7d425e0653.text: 然后检查字段映射，以及 QRdx 在每个表单中找到的同意复选框。

e0308dde373b.source: Responses after that are added within minutes.
e0308dde373b.text: 之后收到的回复会在几分钟内添加。

12c1cad2f25d.source: Members are added or updated with the tags you pick.
12c1cad2f25d.text: 成员会被添加或更新，并附带你选择的标签。

af932201fc49.source: Subscribed only with a ticked consent box; otherwise double opt-in.
af932201fc49.text: 仅在勾选同意框时订阅，否则采用双重确认订阅。

0755c3ecf151.source: generate_qr_code returns a PNG plus SVG and PNG image links, with colors and gradients, module shapes, corner styles, frames and logo icons.
0755c3ecf151.text: generate_qr_code 会返回一张 PNG 图片，以及 SVG 和 PNG 图片链接，支持颜色与渐变、模块形状、角点样式、边框和 Logo 图标。

fab8ad740bff.source: Wi-Fi, contact cards (vCard), email, SMS and map locations, formatted and escaped correctly.
fab8ad740bff.text: Wi-Fi、名片（vCard）、电子邮件、短信和地图位置，均已正确格式化并完成转义。

4f8252ce64db.source: The server is public and stateless, up to 120 requests a minute. Without an API key it never reads or changes QRdx account data.
4f8252ce64db.text: 该服务器公开且无状态，每分钟最多 120 次请求。不使用 API 密钥时，它不会读取或更改 QRdx 账号数据。

4c08847325a2.source: In apps that support MCP Apps, the code also shows as a card with what it encodes and buttons for the image and the editor.
4c08847325a2.text: 在支持 MCP Apps 的应用中，二维码还会以卡片形式显示，列出其编码内容，并提供图片和编辑器的按钮。

4d278e54d767.source: Add QRdx as a custom connector and ask Claude for styled QR codes and Wi-Fi or contact payloads.
4d278e54d767.text: 将 QRdx 添加为自定义连接器，即可让 Claude 生成个性化样式的二维码以及 Wi-Fi 或名片内容。

33d0467e33f9.source: QRdx runs a public MCP server. Add it to Claude as a custom connector and Claude can render QR codes in your brand colors, build Wi-Fi and contact payloads, and hand you SVG and PNG links for docs and emails.
33d0467e33f9.text: QRdx 提供公开的 MCP 服务器。将它作为自定义连接器添加到 Claude 后，Claude 就能用你的品牌色生成二维码、构建 Wi-Fi 和名片内容，并为文档和邮件提供 SVG 与 PNG 链接。

0497b1fa6fc4.source: Where Claude shows MCP Apps, each code also comes back as a card in the chat with buttons for the image and the editor.
0497b1fa6fc4.text: 在 Claude 显示 MCP Apps 的地方，每个二维码也会以卡片形式出现在对话中，并附有图片和编辑器的按钮。

8359d2fbaf54.source: Connectors you add on claude.ai also work in the Claude desktop app.
8359d2fbaf54.text: 在 claude.ai 上添加的连接器同样适用于 Claude 桌面应用。

c2355ecd9d18.source: URL copied — paste it in Claude
c2355ecd9d18.text: URL 已复制，请粘贴到 Claude 中

b6b1a7cceea4.source: The server URL is copied and Claude's “Add custom connector” screen opens in a new tab.
b6b1a7cceea4.text: 服务器 URL 会被复制，Claude 的“添加自定义连接器”页面将在新标签页中打开。

a902bd6e9d90.source: Paste the URL and add the connector
a902bd6e9d90.text: 粘贴 URL 并添加连接器

720dcf0a13f2.source: Name it QRdx, paste the URL as the remote MCP server URL and click Add. No sign-in is needed.
720dcf0a13f2.text: 将其命名为 QRdx，把 URL 粘贴为远程 MCP 服务器 URL，然后点击“添加”。无需登录。

6a3886dc04d5.source: In a new chat, turn on QRdx in the tools menu. Try “Make a QR code for https://example.com in #155dfc with rounded modules.”
6a3886dc04d5.text: 在新对话中，从工具菜单里打开 QRdx。可以试试：“为 https://example.com 生成一个 #155dfc 颜色、圆角模块的二维码。”

1ee9dff7599f.source: Add the QRdx MCP server as an app in ChatGPT developer mode and generate QR codes in chat.
1ee9dff7599f.text: 在 ChatGPT 开发者模式中将 QRdx MCP 服务器添加为应用，即可在对话中生成二维码。

33184540c9a3.source: ChatGPT's developer mode can use remote MCP servers. Add QRdx with no authentication and ChatGPT can render styled QR codes and build Wi-Fi, contact, email, SMS and location payloads.
33184540c9a3.text: ChatGPT 的开发者模式支持使用远程 MCP 服务器。无需身份验证即可添加 QRdx，ChatGPT 随后可以生成带样式的二维码，并构建 Wi-Fi、联系人、电子邮件、短信和位置的内容。

76e18ed2a7b4.source: Where ChatGPT shows MCP Apps, each code also comes back as a card in the chat with buttons for the image and the editor.
76e18ed2a7b4.text: 在 ChatGPT 显示 MCP Apps 的地方，每个二维码还会以卡片形式返回到对话中，卡片上有图片和编辑器的按钮。

9c5bd945e45a.source: Developer mode is available on the web for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Education accounts.
9c5bd945e45a.text: 开发者模式可在网页版中用于 Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 和 Education 账户。

e18d76e610ff.source: URL copied — paste it in ChatGPT
e18d76e610ff.text: URL 已复制——请粘贴到 ChatGPT 中

6361cdd518f8.source: In ChatGPT, open Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced settings and switch on Developer mode.
6361cdd518f8.text: 在 ChatGPT 中打开 Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced settings，然后开启 Developer mode。

504746eb6895.source: Click Connect QRdx, then create the app
504746eb6895.text: 点击“连接 QRdx”，然后创建应用

23bf0469e8ad.source: The URL is copied and ChatGPT's settings open. Click Create, name it QRdx, paste the URL, choose No authentication and create it.
23bf0469e8ad.text: URL 已复制，ChatGPT 的设置页面随即打开。点击 Create，命名为 QRdx，粘贴 URL，选择 No authentication 后创建。

ae5fdad6b953.source: In a chat, open + → Developer mode and select QRdx. Try “Make a QR code for https://example.com in #155dfc with rounded modules.”
ae5fdad6b953.text: 在对话中点击 + → Developer mode 并选择 QRdx。可以试试：“为 https://example.com 生成一个 #155dfc 颜色、圆角模块的二维码。”

1502e7c4b5a0.source: One command adds the QRdx MCP server, so Claude Code can drop QR codes into your README or app.
1502e7c4b5a0.text: 一条命令即可添加 QRdx MCP 服务器，让 Claude Code 把二维码放进你的 README 或应用。

40e8e53cee7d.source: Add the QRdx server to Claude Code and ask it to generate a QR code while it works: it gets SVG and PNG image links to put in Markdown or HTML, or the SVG markup to save as a file.
40e8e53cee7d.text: 将 QRdx 服务器添加到 Claude Code，在工作时让它生成二维码：它会得到 SVG 和 PNG 图片链接，可用于 Markdown 或 HTML，也可得到 SVG 标记并保存为文件。

65556a7adb62.source: Command copied — run it in your terminal
65556a7adb62.text: 命令已复制——请在终端中运行

ddec6cf01017.source: Run this once in your terminal.
ddec6cf01017.text: 在终端中运行一次即可。

77e2e1376cb9.source: Run /mcp inside Claude Code; qrdx should be listed as connected.
77e2e1376cb9.text: 在 Claude Code 中运行 /mcp，qrdx 应显示为已连接。

bf765bfe6534.source: Ask in any session. Try “Make a QR code for https://example.com in #155dfc with rounded modules.”
bf765bfe6534.text: 在任意会话中提问。可以试试：“为 https://example.com 生成一个 #155dfc 颜色、圆角模块的二维码。”

b52ed49a3072.source: Install the QRdx MCP server in Cursor with one click and generate QR codes from the agent.
b52ed49a3072.text: 一键在 Cursor 中安装 QRdx MCP 服务器，通过智能体生成二维码。

5a2355de6da7.source: With QRdx installed, Cursor's agent can render QR codes for your app, docs or README and write the SVG to a file, without leaving the editor.
5a2355de6da7.text: 安装 QRdx 后，Cursor 的智能体可以为你的应用、文档或 README 生成二维码，并将 SVG 写入文件，无需离开编辑器。

aef14a46766f.source: Cursor opens and asks to install the qrdx server. Confirm with Install.
aef14a46766f.text: Cursor 会打开并询问是否安装 qrdx 服务器，点击 Install 确认。

12dfe1623884.source: Put this in ~/.cursor/mcp.json (all projects) or .cursor/mcp.json (one project).
12dfe1623884.text: 将以下内容放入 ~/.cursor/mcp.json（所有项目）或 .cursor/mcp.json（单个项目）。

1b3aad13aa47.source: Ask in Agent chat. Try “Make a QR code for https://example.com in #155dfc with rounded modules.”
1b3aad13aa47.text: 在 Agent 聊天中提问。可以试试：“为 https://example.com 生成一个 #155dfc 颜色、圆角模块的二维码。”

f197bb6a9357.source: Install the QRdx MCP server in VS Code and use it from Copilot agent mode.
f197bb6a9357.text: 在 VS Code 中安装 QRdx MCP 服务器，并在 Copilot 的智能体模式中使用。

5cc540823273.source: VS Code can install MCP servers from a link. Add QRdx and Copilot's agent mode can generate QR codes and payloads while it edits your project.
5cc540823273.text: VS Code 可以通过链接安装 MCP 服务器。添加 QRdx 后，Copilot 的智能体模式可以在编辑项目的同时生成二维码和载荷。

217ce7cc8985.text: 在 VS Code 中安装

a4fc9ca1e353.text: 点击“在 VS Code 中安装”

6f5f0bc17959.source: VS Code opens and asks to install the qrdx server.
6f5f0bc17959.text: VS Code 会打开，并询问是否安装 qrdx 服务器。

dc1b3373f20c.source: Or add it from the terminal or mcp.json
dc1b3373f20c.text: 或者通过终端或 mcp.json 添加

42d7293c98d5.source: Run the command, or put the server in .vscode/mcp.json.
42d7293c98d5.text: 运行该命令，或将服务器写入 .vscode/mcp.json。

f43c400b8669.source: Ask in Copilot Chat in agent mode. Try “Make a QR code for https://example.com in #155dfc with rounded modules.”
f43c400b8669.text: 在智能体模式下的 Copilot Chat 中提问。试试“为 https://example.com 生成一个二维码，颜色为 #155dfc，模块为圆角。”

ccc531fc006b.source: Add the QRdx MCP server to Windsurf's Cascade with a three-line config.
ccc531fc006b.text: 只需三行配置，即可将 QRdx MCP 服务器添加到 Windsurf 的 Cascade。

9f295bf33545.source: Add QRdx to Windsurf's MCP config and Cascade can render QR codes and payloads for your project.
9f295bf33545.text: 将 QRdx 添加到 Windsurf 的 MCP 配置后，Cascade 就能为你的项目生成二维码和载荷。

0a49b54c1fae.source: Config copied — paste it into mcp_config.json
0a49b54c1fae.text: 配置已复制，请粘贴到 mcp_config.json 中

6eaca3d545aa.text: 打开 Windsurf 的 MCP 配置

9f8183ca62ba.text: 编辑 ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json 并添加该服务器。

60ca251358fe.source: Refresh MCP servers in Cascade, or restart Windsurf.
60ca251358fe.text: 在 Cascade 中刷新 MCP 服务器，或重启 Windsurf。

38a8514fb39e.source: Ask Cascade. Try “Make a QR code for https://example.com in #155dfc with rounded modules.”
38a8514fb39e.text: 向 Cascade 提问。试试“为 https://example.com 生成一个二维码，颜色为 #155dfc，模块为圆角。”

76b1dde709d4.source: Add the QRdx MCP server to Gemini CLI with one command and make QR codes from the terminal.
76b1dde709d4.text: 一条命令即可将 QRdx MCP 服务器添加到 Gemini CLI，在终端中生成二维码。

0e612ef25b59.source: Gemini CLI connects to remote MCP servers over HTTP. Add QRdx and ask Gemini for QR codes, Wi-Fi cards or contact payloads in any session.
0e612ef25b59.text: Gemini CLI 通过 HTTP 连接远程 MCP 服务器。添加 QRdx 后，你可以在任意会话中让 Gemini 生成二维码、Wi-Fi 卡片或联系人载荷。

81ae5ebbca6e.source: Run the command (add -s user to make it available in every project).
81ae5ebbca6e.text: 运行该命令（加上 -s user 可使其在所有项目中可用）。

c928ffdce1d8.source: Use httpUrl for the Streamable HTTP transport.
c928ffdce1d8.text: 使用 httpUrl 来配置 Streamable HTTP 传输。

c9190601419d.source: Run /mcp to check it, then ask. Try “Make a QR code for https://example.com in #155dfc with rounded modules.”
c9190601419d.text: 运行 /mcp 检查是否生效，然后提问。试试“为 https://example.com 生成一个二维码，颜色为 #155dfc，模块为圆角。”

7ab06ac7e8ec.source: Add the QRdx MCP server to OpenAI's Codex with one command and generate QR codes while it codes.
7ab06ac7e8ec.text: 一条命令即可将 QRdx MCP 服务器添加到 OpenAI 的 Codex，让它在编写代码时生成二维码。

0695a9c2f7a1.source: Codex reads MCP servers from ~/.codex/config.toml. Add QRdx and Codex can render QR codes and payloads while it works on your code.
0695a9c2f7a1.text: Codex 从 ~/.codex/config.toml 读取 MCP 服务器。添加 QRdx 后，Codex 在处理你的代码时就能生成二维码及其数据内容。

415fe4fd5a27.source: The url key makes it a Streamable HTTP server.
415fe4fd5a27.text: url 键会将其设为 Streamable HTTP 服务器。

da2a7408fd3b.source: Ask in Codex. Try “Make a QR code for https://example.com in #155dfc with rounded modules.”
da2a7408fd3b.text: 在 Codex 中提问。试试“为 https://example.com 生成一个颜色为 #155dfc、模块为圆角的二维码。”

d88b6ee72cfa.source: Load your Google Analytics 4 on the hosted pages your QR codes open.
d88b6ee72cfa.text: 在你的二维码所打开的托管页面上加载 Google Analytics 4。

d716aa3f4b09.source: See visits from your QR codes' hosted pages in your own Google Analytics property, next to the rest of your site.
d716aa3f4b09.text: 在你自己的 Google Analytics 媒体资源中查看二维码托管页面的访问情况，与网站其他数据放在一起。

8f598e349020.source: Paste your measurement ID (G-XXXXXXXXXX) on a dynamic code that opens a hosted page. The tag only loads after the visitor agrees where consent is required.
8f598e349020.text: 在打开托管页面的动态二维码上粘贴你的衡量 ID（G-XXXXXXXXXX）。在需要获得同意的地区，只有访客同意后才会加载该代码。

24c2994c829b.source: Open a code that has a hosted page
24c2994c829b.text: 打开带有托管页面的二维码

d00a2bf73a28.source: In the dashboard, open a dynamic code that opens a landing page, form or other hosted page, and go to its Settings.
d00a2bf73a28.text: 在控制台中，打开一个指向落地页、表单或其他托管页面的动态二维码，然后进入其“设置”。

3abfd8392629.source: In the Tracking pixels panel, enter it in the Google Analytics 4 field.
3abfd8392629.text: 在“跟踪像素”面板中，将其填入 Google Analytics 4 字段。

b9973847038d.source: Choose when to ask for consent and save
b9973847038d.text: 选择何时征求同意并保存

259b7b9e20c7.source: “Where required” (the default) asks visitors in the EU/EEA, the UK, Switzerland and unknown locations first; “For every visitor” asks everyone.
259b7b9e20c7.text: “按需征求”（默认）会先向欧盟/欧洲经济区、英国、瑞士及位置未知的访客征求同意；“向所有访客征求”则会询问每一位访客。

d2381de76022.source: Visitors in the EU/EEA, the UK and Switzerland, or with an unknown location, choose Accept or Decline before anything loads.
d2381de76022.text: 位于欧盟/欧洲经济区、英国和瑞士，或位置未知的访客，会在任何内容加载之前选择接受或拒绝。

40422be5c08c.source: Each hosted page loads only the pixels you set on that code, alongside QRdx's cookieless scan analytics.
40422be5c08c.text: 每个托管页面只加载你在该二维码上设置的像素，同时配有 QRdx 不使用 Cookie 的扫描分析。

22c30a01d342.source: QRdx adds no third-party scripts of its own to hosted pages.
22c30a01d342.text: QRdx 不会在托管页面中自行添加任何第三方脚本。

e0ca9bedbe66.source: Load your Google Tag Manager on the hosted pages your QR codes open.
e0ca9bedbe66.text: 在你的二维码所打开的托管页面上加载 Google Tag Manager。

22040d2761ec.source: Load your Tag Manager container on hosted pages and manage every tag from Google Tag Manager.
22040d2761ec.text: 在托管页面上加载你的 Tag Manager 容器，并通过 Google Tag Manager 管理所有标签。

e6274c46791e.source: Paste your container ID (GTM-XXXXXXX) on a dynamic code that opens a hosted page. The tag only loads after the visitor agrees where consent is required.
e6274c46791e.text: 在打开托管页面的动态二维码上粘贴你的容器 ID（GTM-XXXXXXX）。在需要获得同意的地区，只有访客同意后才会加载该代码。

35d713007719.source: In the Tracking pixels panel, enter it in the Google Tag Manager field.
35d713007719.text: 在“跟踪像素”面板中，将其填入 Google Tag Manager 字段。

507e8ed379a2.source: Load your Meta Pixel on the hosted pages your QR codes open.
507e8ed379a2.text: 在您的二维码打开的托管页面上加载 Meta Pixel。

6e9eca7d53da.source: Build Facebook and Instagram retargeting audiences from the people who scan your codes.
6e9eca7d53da.text: 根据扫描您二维码的人群，建立 Facebook 和 Instagram 再营销受众。

5107a53bf201.source: Paste your pixel ID (6–20 digits) on a dynamic code that opens a hosted page. The tag only loads after the visitor agrees where consent is required.
5107a53bf201.text: 在打开托管页面的动态二维码上粘贴您的像素 ID（6–20 位数字）。在需要征得同意的地区，只有访客同意后才会加载该标签。

239887088a2d.source: In the Tracking pixels panel, enter it in the Meta Pixel field.
239887088a2d.text: 在“跟踪像素”面板的 Meta Pixel 字段中填入。

e1c83232a051.source: Load your TikTok Pixel on the hosted pages your QR codes open.
e1c83232a051.text: 在您的二维码打开的托管页面上加载 TikTok Pixel。

58e851ec589e.source: Retarget the people who scan your codes with TikTok ads.
58e851ec589e.text: 通过 TikTok 广告对扫描您二维码的人群进行再营销。

4a78c97a67e8.source: Paste your pixel ID (10–30 letters and digits) on a dynamic code that opens a hosted page. The tag only loads after the visitor agrees where consent is required.
4a78c97a67e8.text: 在打开托管页面的动态二维码上粘贴您的像素 ID（10–30 位字母和数字）。在需要征得同意的地区，只有访客同意后才会加载该标签。

e90c3d22437b.source: In the Tracking pixels panel, enter it in the TikTok Pixel field.
e90c3d22437b.text: 在“跟踪像素”面板的 TikTok Pixel 字段中填入。

97cd9aa0ebf6.text: 像素 ID（10–30 位字母和数字）

587860f07e96.source: Load your LinkedIn Insight Tag on the hosted pages your QR codes open.
587860f07e96.text: 在您的二维码打开的托管页面上加载 LinkedIn Insight Tag。

ab107773edda.source: Measure and retarget B2B audiences from event booths, brochures and other print.
ab107773edda.text: 针对展会展台、宣传册及其他印刷品带来的 B2B 受众，进行效果衡量和再营销。

143ed1ee13eb.source: Paste your partner ID (3–12 digits) on a dynamic code that opens a hosted page. The tag only loads after the visitor agrees where consent is required.
143ed1ee13eb.text: 在打开托管页面的动态二维码上粘贴您的合作伙伴 ID（3–12 位数字）。在需要征得同意的地区，只有访客同意后才会加载该标签。

f6b7f5b122cf.text: 粘贴您的合作伙伴 ID

3452eaa56933.source: In the Tracking pixels panel, enter it in the LinkedIn Insight Tag field.
3452eaa56933.text: 在“跟踪像素”面板的 LinkedIn Insight Tag 字段中填入。

4b448c06d707.text: 合作伙伴 ID（3–12 位数字）

3301f8a1c96b.source: Create a Dub short link, or pick one you already have, as the content of a QR code.
3301f8a1c96b.text: 创建 Dub 短链接，或选择已有的短链接，作为二维码的内容。

a262d672f225.source: Connect your Dub workspace and the QR editor can create a new Dub short link or pick an existing one, so the printed code points at a link you track and change in Dub.
a262d672f225.text: 连接你的 Dub 工作区后，二维码编辑器可以创建新的 Dub 短链接，也可以选择已有的短链接，这样印刷出来的二维码指向的就是你可以在 Dub 中追踪和修改的链接。

e1ed6c677db4.source: Once connected, Settings → Integrations → Dub lists your links with their clicks by day, country, device, browser and OS. You can also paste any Dub short link into the Dub content type without connecting.
e1ed6c677db4.text: 连接后，在“设置 → 集成 → Dub”中可以查看你的链接，以及按日期、国家/地区、设备、浏览器和操作系统统计的点击数据。你也可以不连接账号，直接将任意 Dub 短链接粘贴到 Dub 内容类型中。

f636fed39909.source: Open the Dub integration in QRdx
f636fed39909.text: 在 QRdx 中打开 Dub 集成

dae2777449f6.source: Sign in, then go to Settings → Integrations → Dub.
dae2777449f6.text: 登录后，前往“设置 → 集成 → Dub”。

9d9317dd114d.source: Click Enable and approve QRdx in Dub
9d9317dd114d.text: 点击“启用”，并在 Dub 中授权 QRdx

d7d4f8870070.source: QRdx asks to read and write your workspaces and links. Tokens are stored encrypted, and you can disconnect at any time.
d7d4f8870070.text: QRdx 会请求读取和写入你的工作区与链接的权限。令牌经加密存储，你可以随时断开连接。

0b4855d4c267.source: Pick Dub as the QR content type
0b4855d4c267.text: 选择 Dub 作为二维码内容类型

a300193b96b1.source: In the editor, choose Dub, then create a new short link or select an existing one. The QR code encodes that link.
a300193b96b1.text: 在编辑器中选择 Dub，然后创建新的短链接，或选择已有的短链接。二维码会编码该链接。

2dc20901135c.source: Make a new Dub link from the editor or reuse one from your workspace.
2dc20901135c.text: 在编辑器中创建新的 Dub 链接，或复用工作区中已有的链接。

69405f831c21.source: See each link's clicks over time and by country, device, browser and OS in settings.
69405f831c21.text: 在设置中查看每个链接随时间变化的点击量，以及按国家/地区、设备、浏览器和操作系统统计的点击数据。

bd9fa56544f0.source: Paste any Dub short link into the Dub content type without connecting an account.
bd9fa56544f0.text: 无需连接账号，即可将任意 Dub 短链接粘贴到 Dub 内容类型中。

1dfe8c7c38db.source: Turn Drive files and folders into QR codes, and import Drive images into your designs.
1dfe8c7c38db.text: 将 Drive 文件和文件夹变成二维码，并把 Drive 中的图片导入你的设计。

b0bf8ab462b9.source: Connect Google Drive to browse your files from the QR editor. Pick a document, sheet, slide deck, PDF or folder and QRdx encodes its share link, so a scan opens the file.
b0bf8ab462b9.text: 连接 Google Drive，即可在二维码编辑器中浏览你的文件。选择文档、表格、幻灯片、PDF 或文件夹，QRdx 会对其分享链接进行编码，扫描后即可打开该文件。

7981f9a0a918.source: Drive images can also be used as QR code assets. Without connecting, you can paste any Drive or Docs link into the Google Drive content type.
7981f9a0a918.text: Drive 中的图片也可以用作二维码素材。无需连接账号，你也可以在 Google Drive 内容类型中粘贴任意 Drive 或 Docs 链接。

954f6fc6b733.source: Open the Google Drive integration in QRdx
954f6fc6b733.text: 在 QRdx 中打开 Google Drive 集成

4befc6bb855e.source: Sign in, then go to Settings → Integrations → Google Drive.
4befc6bb855e.text: 登录后，前往“设置 → 集成 → Google Drive”。

4f6f14d28447.source: QRdx asks to view your Drive files. Tokens are stored encrypted, and you can disconnect at any time.
4f6f14d28447.text: QRdx 会请求查看你的 Drive 文件的权限。令牌经加密存储，你可以随时断开连接。

6426ba21cec3.source: Pick Google Drive as the QR content type
6426ba21cec3.text: 选择 Google Drive 作为二维码内容类型

e5ecc57944fd.source: Select a file or folder. People who scan need access to it, so set its sharing to “Anyone with the link” in Drive if the code is public.
e5ecc57944fd.text: 选择一个文件或文件夹。扫描的人需要有权访问它，因此如果二维码要公开使用，请在 Drive 中将其共享设置为“知道链接的任何人”。

82f8dc7c0fa9.source: Select Drive files or folders and turn their share links into QR codes.
82f8dc7c0fa9.text: 选择 Drive 文件或文件夹，将其分享链接变成二维码。

3b06eb2f0689.source: Browse images in your Drive for QR code assets.
3b06eb2f0689.text: 浏览 Drive 中的图片，用作二维码素材。

0e3009e878bc.text: 手动输入 Drive 链接

8980bf453705.source: Paste a Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides link without connecting an account.
8980bf453705.text: 无需连接账号，直接粘贴 Drive、Docs、Sheets 或 Slides 链接。

ce908470caf8.source: Serve your dynamic QR codes' short links from a domain you own, like go.yourbrand.com.
ce908470caf8.text: 用你自己的域名（如 go.yourbrand.com）为动态二维码提供短链接。

1961ee26ecc7.source: Dynamic QR codes encode a short link such as qrdx.dev/q/aB3dE5f. Add a domain and new codes can encode go.yourbrand.com/aB3dE5f instead, so people see your brand before they scan. Redirects, editing and scan analytics work the same way.
1961ee26ecc7.text: 动态二维码会编码一个类似 qrdx.dev/q/aB3dE5f 的短链接。添加域名后，新的二维码可以改为编码 go.yourbrand.com/aB3dE5f，这样人们在扫描之前就能看到你的品牌。跳转、编辑和扫描分析的使用方式保持不变。

5fcdc6fb3918.source: Every code keeps working at its default qrdx.dev link too, so codes you already printed never break.
5fcdc6fb3918.text: 每个二维码同样可以通过默认的 qrdx.dev 链接继续使用，所以你已经印刷的二维码不会失效。

64638f8a4cb0.source: Open Settings → Domains and enter it. A subdomain such as go.yourbrand.com works best, because your website stays where it is.
64638f8a4cb0.text: 打开“设置 → 域名”并输入域名。建议使用 go.yourbrand.com 这样的子域名，因为你的网站可以保持原样。

46dba6accad0.source: Create the DNS records at your DNS provider
46dba6accad0.text: 在你的 DNS 服务商处创建 DNS 记录

418b0c99e0bd.source: A subdomain gets a CNAME record and a root domain an A record. Copy the exact values from the dashboard.
418b0c99e0bd.text: 子域名使用 CNAME 记录，根域名使用 A 记录。请从控制台复制准确的值。

aeafe2748336.source: Click Verify. Once verified, pick the domain under Short link domain when you create or edit a dynamic code.
aeafe2748336.text: 点击“验证”。验证通过后，在创建或编辑动态二维码时，于“短链接域名”下选择该域名。

b14a8ab8dd76.source: Codes encode your domain, with the same redirects and analytics.
b14a8ab8dd76.text: 二维码会编码你的域名，跳转和分析功能保持不变。

40590b7839c1.source: Every code also keeps its default qrdx.dev link, before and after a move.
40590b7839c1.text: 每个二维码同时保留默认的 qrdx.dev 链接，无论迁移前后。

a2cfb44c48a6.source: Owners and admins add domains; every member can use them for codes.
a2cfb44c48a6.text: 所有者和管理员可以添加域名，每位成员都可以在二维码中使用这些域名。

6100c090c913.source: Set domainId when you create or update codes with the REST API.
6100c090c913.text: 使用 REST API 创建或更新二维码时，设置 domainId。

02eb7edfef5d.source: Importing from Bitly, Rebrandly or Short.io can keep your links' back-halves, so they work on QRdx after the DNS switch.
02eb7edfef5d.text: 从 Bitly、Rebrandly 或 Short.io 导入时，可以保留链接的后半部分，这样在 DNS 切换后，它们就能在 QRdx 上继续使用。

c9255f5be5c2.source: Shorten a QR code's link with your own Bitly account, on bit.ly or your branded domain.
c9255f5be5c2.text: 用你自己的 Bitly 账号缩短二维码的链接，可使用 bit.ly 或你的自有品牌域名。

98f5f09d793e.source: Connect Bitly and it shows up in the QR editor's URL type, under Use a link from… beside the Website address field. QRdx creates the link in your Bitly account (in your default group, on the domain you pick) or lets you pick one you already have, and the QR code encodes that short link.
98f5f09d793e.text: 连接 Bitly 后，它会出现在二维码编辑器的网址类型中，位于“网站地址”字段旁的“使用链接自…”下。QRdx 会在你的 Bitly 账号中创建链接（在默认分组下，使用你选择的域名），或让你选择已有的链接，二维码编码的就是这个短链接。

8708566a09e4.source: Because the code holds the Bitly link, you can change where it points later in Bitly and see its clicks there; the printed code stays the same. Settings → Integrations → Bitly shows your groups, domains and recent links.
8708566a09e4.text: 由于二维码中保存的是 Bitly 链接，你之后可以在 Bitly 中更改它的指向并查看点击数据，而已印刷的二维码保持不变。在“设置 → 集成 → Bitly”中可以查看你的分组、域名和最近的链接。

b28da9d82fa8.source: Open the Bitly integration in QRdx
b28da9d82fa8.text: 在 QRdx 中打开 Bitly 集成

b0b3d2c3afb0.source: Sign in, then go to Settings → Integrations → Bitly.
b0b3d2c3afb0.text: 登录后，前往“设置 → 集成 → Bitly”。

b953671696a2.source: Sign in with Bitly, or paste an access token
b953671696a2.text: 使用 Bitly 登录，或粘贴访问令牌

030ac472017f.source: Click Enable to approve QRdx in Bitly. Or create a generic access token in Bitly (Settings → Developer settings → API) and paste it. Either way the token is checked with Bitly and stored encrypted.
030ac472017f.text: 点击“启用”，在 Bitly 中授权 QRdx。或者在 Bitly 中创建通用访问令牌（设置 → 开发者设置 → API）并粘贴。无论哪种方式，令牌都会通过 Bitly 验证，并加密存储。

c74b0647c722.source: Choose the URL type and enter the address. Open Use a link from…, choose Bitly, then create a link under Create new or pick one under Use existing. Bitly chooses the back-half; changing a link's destination later needs a paid Bitly plan.
c74b0647c722.text: 选择网址类型并输入地址。打开“使用链接自…”，选择 Bitly，然后在“新建”下创建链接，或在“使用已有”下选择一个。后缀由 Bitly 决定；之后若要更改链接的目标地址，需要 Bitly 付费套餐。

87dc009b57b6.source: On bit.ly or any branded domain in your account, with an optional title.
87dc009b57b6.text: 可使用 bit.ly 或你账号中的任意品牌域名，并可选填标题。

aa7e4f06dfb8.source: Search your Bitly links and encode one in a QR code.
aa7e4f06dfb8.text: 搜索你的 Bitly 链接，并将其编码到二维码中。

bc82a1eacd9f.source: See your groups and branded domains, and pick the default domain for new links.
bc82a1eacd9f.text: 查看你的分组和品牌域名，并为新链接选择默认域名。

c7ea9365f593.source: Shorten a QR code's link on your Rebrandly branded domain, with your own slashtag.
c7ea9365f593.text: 在你的 Rebrandly 品牌域名上缩短二维码的链接，并使用你自己的 slashtag。

87a895ad62a3.source: Connect Rebrandly with an API key and it shows up in the QR editor's URL type, under Use a link from… beside the Website address field. Create a branded link with the slashtag you want, or pick one of your existing links; the QR code encodes the Rebrandly link.
87a895ad62a3.text: 使用 API 密钥连接 Rebrandly 后，它会出现在二维码编辑器的 URL 类型中，位于“网站地址”字段旁的“使用来自……的链接”下。你可以用想要的 slashtag 创建品牌链接，也可以选择现有的链接；二维码编码的是 Rebrandly 链接。

25245833e9cf.source: Change the destination in Rebrandly whenever you need to and the printed code follows it. Settings → Integrations → Rebrandly lets you pick the domain new links use.
25245833e9cf.text: 需要时可随时在 Rebrandly 中更改目标地址，已印刷的二维码会随之指向新地址。在“设置 → 集成 → Rebrandly”中，你可以选择新链接使用的域名。

c2c7c3168ba8.source: Create an API key in Rebrandly
c2c7c3168ba8.text: 在 Rebrandly 中创建 API 密钥

c9c03d8d8697.source: In Rebrandly, open Account → API keys and click New API key.
c9c03d8d8697.text: 在 Rebrandly 中打开“账户 → API 密钥”，然后点击“新建 API 密钥”。

50f6316a3541.source: Go to Settings → Integrations → Rebrandly and paste the key. QRdx checks it with Rebrandly and stores it encrypted.
50f6316a3541.text: 前往“设置 → 集成 → Rebrandly”并粘贴密钥。QRdx 会通过 Rebrandly 验证该密钥，并加密存储。

f593d88c4cfc.source: Choose the URL type, open Use a link from… and choose Rebrandly. Under Create new, pick the domain and type the slashtag in Back-half, or pick a link under Use existing.
f593d88c4cfc.text: 选择 URL 类型，打开“使用来自……的链接”并选择 Rebrandly。在“新建”下选择域名，并在“后半部分”中输入 slashtag；或者在“使用现有链接”下选择一个链接。

bde4be4cd0fa.source: Create links on your own Rebrandly domains, with a custom slashtag.
bde4be4cd0fa.text: 在你自己的 Rebrandly 域名上创建链接，并使用自定义 slashtag。

cf247c073171.source: Pick one of your recent Rebrandly links for a QR code.
cf247c073171.text: 为二维码选择你最近的某个 Rebrandly 链接。

ab1e52c13853.source: Choose which domain new links use in settings.
ab1e52c13853.text: 在设置中选择新链接使用的域名。

dec93c64e752.source: Connects with an API key from your Rebrandly account.
dec93c64e752.text: 使用你 Rebrandly 账户中的 API 密钥进行连接。

b152aa87a0a4.source: Shorten a QR code's link on your own Short.io domain, with the path you choose.
b152aa87a0a4.text: 在你自己的 Short.io 域名上缩短二维码的链接，路径由你决定。

bbdbabf02454.source: Connect Short.io with a secret API key, pick which of your domains to use, and it shows up in the QR editor's URL type, under Use a link from… beside the Website address field. Create a link with your own path or pick an existing one; the QR code encodes the Short.io link.
bbdbabf02454.text: 使用私密 API 密钥连接 Short.io，选择要使用的域名，它就会出现在二维码编辑器的 URL 类型中，位于“网站地址”字段旁的“使用链接来自…”下。你可以用自己的路径创建链接，也可以选择已有链接；二维码编码的是 Short.io 链接。

18609549c471.source: Short.io keeps redirecting and counting clicks, and you can change the destination there later.
18609549c471.text: Short.io 会继续负责跳转并统计点击次数，之后你也可以在那里更改目标地址。

2e2846da0ff5.source: Create a secret API key in Short.io
2e2846da0ff5.text: 在 Short.io 中创建私密 API 密钥

58b01aacbae6.source: In Short.io, open Integrations & API → API and create a key. Keep it a secret (private) key.
58b01aacbae6.text: 在 Short.io 中打开“Integrations & API → API”并创建密钥。请将其保持为私密（private）密钥。

40e685f7bff3.source: Paste it and pick a domain

c55bbea05d5d.source: Go to Settings → Integrations → Short.io, paste the key, then choose the domain new links use.
c55bbea05d5d.text: 前往“设置 → 集成 → Short.io”，粘贴密钥，然后选择新链接使用的域名。

4c8cc51d110d.source: Choose the URL type, open Use a link from… and choose Short.io. Create a link under Create new, or pick one under Use existing.
4c8cc51d110d.text: 选择 URL 类型，打开“使用链接来自…”并选择 Short.io。在“新建”下创建链接，或在“使用已有”下选择一个链接。

d39d0a46debf.text: 使用你自己域名的链接

06c79b91911e.source: Create links on any domain in your Short.io account.
06c79b91911e.text: 可在你的 Short.io 账户中的任意域名上创建链接。

e798a62023f6.source: Type the path after the domain, or let Short.io pick one.
e798a62023f6.text: 在域名后输入路径，或让 Short.io 自动生成。

ac191d9b2c3f.source: Choose the default domain in settings; existing links are listed per domain.
ac191d9b2c3f.text: 在设置中选择默认域名；已有链接按域名分别列出。

92bad93fe5ca.source: Connects with a secret API key from your Short.io account.
92bad93fe5ca.text: 使用你 Short.io 账户中的私密 API 密钥进行连接。

dd117b997310.source: Pick a Dropbox file or folder and turn its shared link into a QR code.
dd117b997310.text: 选择 Dropbox 中的文件或文件夹，把它的共享链接变成二维码。

31ee262e5053.source: Connect Dropbox and it shows up in the QR editor's URL type, under Use a link from… beside the Website address field. Browse or search your Dropbox, pick a file or folder, and QRdx creates its shared link (or reuses the one it already has). The QR code opens it.
31ee262e5053.text: 连接 Dropbox 后，它会出现在二维码编辑器的网址类型中，位于“网站地址”字段旁的“使用来自…的链接”下。浏览或搜索你的 Dropbox，选择文件或文件夹，QRdx 就会创建它的共享链接（若已有共享链接则直接沿用）。扫描二维码即可打开该链接。

33d7dc30e714.source: Hosted pages can use Dropbox files too: PDF, audio, video and download blocks get From Dropbox and link straight to the file. If your team only allows team links, QRdx tells you so you can change the link in Dropbox.
33d7dc30e714.text: 托管页面也可以使用 Dropbox 文件：PDF、音频、视频和下载模块都有“来自 Dropbox”选项，并直接链接到文件。如果你的团队只允许使用团队链接，QRdx 会提示你，方便你在 Dropbox 中更改链接。

92d6a3fef062.source: Open the Dropbox integration in QRdx
92d6a3fef062.text: 在 QRdx 中打开 Dropbox 集成

95fc6e95673f.source: Sign in, then go to Settings → Integrations → Dropbox.
95fc6e95673f.text: 登录后，前往“设置 → 集成 → Dropbox”。

68b030f9f31f.source: QRdx asks to see your files' names and to create shared links, nothing else. Tokens are stored encrypted, and disconnecting revokes them in Dropbox.
68b030f9f31f.text: QRdx 只会请求查看你的文件名称和创建共享链接的权限，不会请求其他权限。令牌经加密存储，断开连接时会在 Dropbox 中撤销这些令牌。

7e2bbe41ce43.source: Pick a file in the editor

36d31453065a.source: In the editor, choose the URL type, open Use a link from…, choose Dropbox and pick a file or folder.
36d31453065a.text: 在编辑器中选择网址类型，打开“使用来自…的链接”，选择 Dropbox，然后选取文件或文件夹。

e397733aa2fa.source: Creates a link anyone can open, or reuses the file's existing link.
e397733aa2fa.text: 创建任何人都能打开的链接，或沿用文件已有的链接。

739dad0cd8d7.source: PDF, audio, video and download blocks link straight to the file.
739dad0cd8d7.text: PDF、音频、视频和下载模块直接链接到文件。

d8ff1ecc382c.source: Folders, search, and paging through large folders.
d8ff1ecc382c.text: 支持文件夹、搜索，以及翻页浏览大型文件夹。

65e418c66773.source: Pick a OneDrive or SharePoint file and encode a view-only sharing link.
65e418c66773.text: 选取 OneDrive 或 SharePoint 文件，并将其仅可查看的分享链接编码为二维码。

02d720cac065.source: Connect your Microsoft account and OneDrive shows up in the QR editor's URL type, under Use a link from… beside the Website address field. Browse or search your OneDrive (personal, or OneDrive for Business in SharePoint), pick a file or folder, and QRdx creates a view-only “Anyone with the link” link for the QR code.
02d720cac065.text: 连接你的 Microsoft 账户后，OneDrive 会出现在二维码编辑器的网址类型中，位于网站地址字段旁的“使用来自…的链接”下。你可以浏览或搜索自己的 OneDrive（个人版，或 SharePoint 中的 OneDrive for Business），选择文件或文件夹，QRdx 会为二维码创建一个仅可查看的“知道链接的任何人”链接。

e5dd8bd73358.source: If your organization turned off “Anyone” links, QRdx creates an organization-only link instead and tells you that only signed-in colleagues can open it.
e5dd8bd73358.text: 如果你所在的组织关闭了“任何人”链接，QRdx 会改为创建仅限组织内部的链接，并提示你只有已登录的同事才能打开。

a0afb0b0ac4b.source: Open the OneDrive integration in QRdx
a0afb0b0ac4b.text: 在 QRdx 中打开 OneDrive 集成

2caad7b1385e.source: Sign in, then go to Settings → Integrations → OneDrive.
2caad7b1385e.text: 登录后，前往“设置 → 集成 → OneDrive”。

b375a8444638.source: Click Enable and choose your Microsoft account
b375a8444638.text: 点击“启用”并选择你的 Microsoft 账户

ac47863c9147.source: QRdx asks for access to your files so it can create sharing links (Microsoft requires Files.ReadWrite for that). Tokens are stored encrypted.
ac47863c9147.text: QRdx 会请求访问你的文件权限，以便创建分享链接（Microsoft 要求为此授予 Files.ReadWrite）。令牌会加密存储。

ebb93178bfc0.source: In the editor, choose the URL type, open Use a link from…, choose OneDrive and pick a file or folder.
ebb93178bfc0.text: 在编辑器中选择网址类型，打开“使用来自…的链接”，选择 OneDrive，然后选取文件或文件夹。

a427226ad718.source: Anyone with the link can view the file; nobody can edit it.
a427226ad718.text: 知道链接的任何人都可以查看该文件，但无法编辑。

e9c6b3697a4f.source: Personal OneDrive and OneDrive for Business, with organization links where required.
e9c6b3697a4f.text: 支持个人版 OneDrive 和 OneDrive for Business，需要时会使用组织内部链接。

b2d5205795d9.source: Your folders and search across your OneDrive.
b2d5205795d9.text: 你的文件夹，以及对整个 OneDrive 的搜索。

f298d51a3d0d.source: SharePoint team sites aren't listed; files in your own OneDrive are.
f298d51a3d0d.text: 不会列出 SharePoint 团队网站，但会列出你自己 OneDrive 中的文件。

8b44cb3f8388.source: Pick a Box file or folder and turn its shared link into a QR code.
8b44cb3f8388.text: 选取 Box 文件或文件夹，将其共享链接转换为二维码。

4322d3c20a79.source: Connect Box and it shows up in the QR editor's URL type, under Use a link from… beside the Website address field. Browse or search your Box, pick a file or folder, and QRdx turns on its shared link for people with the link. The QR code opens it.
4322d3c20a79.text: 连接 Box 后，它会出现在二维码编辑器的网址类型中，位于网站地址字段旁的“使用来自…的链接”下。你可以浏览或搜索自己的 Box，选择文件或文件夹，QRdx 会为知道链接的人开启其共享链接，二维码即可打开该链接。

20f0c09ebc41.source: Where your Box admin only allows company links, QRdx creates one and tells you that only people signed in to your company's Box can open it. Download blocks on hosted pages use the direct download link when Box provides one.
20f0c09ebc41.text: 如果你的 Box 管理员只允许使用公司链接，QRdx 会创建一个公司链接，并提示你只有登录了贵公司 Box 的人才能打开。托管页面上的下载区块会在 Box 提供直接下载链接时使用该链接。

a2c23ac44305.source: Open the Box integration in QRdx
a2c23ac44305.text: 在 QRdx 中打开 Box 集成

235843a7f1a9.source: Sign in, then go to Settings → Integrations → Box.
235843a7f1a9.text: 登录后，前往“设置 → 集成 → Box”。

49748a9b96fb.source: Turning on a shared link changes the file's settings, so Box asks for read and write access. Tokens are stored encrypted, and disconnecting revokes them in Box.
49748a9b96fb.text: 开启共享链接会更改文件的设置，因此 Box 会请求读取和写入权限。令牌会加密存储，断开连接时会在 Box 中撤销这些令牌。

71387b022f1f.source: In the editor, choose the URL type, open Use a link from…, choose Box and pick a file or folder.
71387b022f1f.text: 在编辑器中选择网址类型，打开“使用来自…的链接”，选择 Box，然后选取文件或文件夹。

2f50b623f0ed.source: “People with the link” access, or a company link when your admin requires it.
2f50b623f0ed.text: “知道链接的人”均可访问；如果管理员要求，则使用公司链接。

cf0ee136ab5f.source: Download blocks use Box's direct download link when there is one.
cf0ee136ab5f.text: 下载区块会在有直接下载链接时使用 Box 的直接下载链接。

79576c8da47f.source: Folders and search across your Box.
79576c8da47f.text: 你的文件夹，以及对整个 Box 的搜索。

83dd94b9dbba.source: Pick a Notion page and encode its public link, with a hint when it isn't published yet.
83dd94b9dbba.text: 选择一个 Notion 页面并编码其公开链接；若页面尚未发布，会给出提示。

e772e01e3f07.source: Connect Notion, choose which pages QRdx can see, and Notion shows up in the QR editor's URL type, under Use a link from… beside the Website address field. Search those pages and pick one; QRdx encodes its “Publish to web” link so anyone can open it.
e772e01e3f07.text: 连接 Notion，选择 QRdx 可以访问的页面后，Notion 就会出现在二维码编辑器的网址类型中，位于“网站地址”字段旁的“使用来自…的链接”下。搜索这些页面并选择其一，QRdx 会编码它的“发布到网络”链接，这样任何人都能打开。

924a1a8cd04f.source: Notion's API can't publish a page for you. If the page isn't published, QRdx still uses its Notion link but tells you that only people in your workspace can open it, and how to publish it.
924a1a8cd04f.text: Notion 的 API 无法替你发布页面。如果页面尚未发布，QRdx 仍会使用它的 Notion 链接，但会提示你只有工作区内的成员才能打开，并告诉你如何发布。

5b8c93e77497.source: Open the Notion integration in QRdx
5b8c93e77497.text: 在 QRdx 中打开 Notion 集成

f31c01cdb1fd.source: Sign in, then go to Settings → Integrations → Notion.
f31c01cdb1fd.text: 登录后，前往“设置”→“集成”→ Notion。

868a9a6a85db.source: Click Enable and pick the pages to share
868a9a6a85db.text: 点击“启用”并选择要共享的页面

8d617fcc8fb8.source: Notion asks which pages QRdx can see; only those appear in QRdx. Add more later from a page's ••• → Connections.
8d617fcc8fb8.text: Notion 会询问 QRdx 可以访问哪些页面，只有这些页面会显示在 QRdx 中。之后可以在页面的 ••• → “连接”中添加更多页面。

15bd4d181b39.source: Publish the page, then pick it

66f9d444922a.source: In Notion, click Share → Publish → Publish to web. Then in the editor choose the URL type, open Use a link from…, choose Notion and pick the page.
66f9d444922a.text: 在 Notion 中点击“分享”→“发布”→“发布到网络”。然后在编辑器中选择网址类型，打开“使用来自…的链接”，选择 Notion 并选中该页面。

8ea1c42ce5f7.source: Encodes the page's published notion.site link.
8ea1c42ce5f7.text: 编码页面已发布的 notion.site 链接。

5e400d6b1444.source: Says when a page isn't published yet, so scans don't hit a sign-in wall.
5e400d6b1444.text: 页面尚未发布时会提示你，避免扫描后遇到登录页面。

bb601f633523.source: QRdx sees just the pages you shared with it.
bb601f633523.text: QRdx 只能看到你与它共享的页面。

05a851f5712d.source: Pick one of your Stripe Payment Links and print a QR code that opens checkout.
05a851f5712d.text: 选择一个 Stripe 支付链接，打印可打开结账页面的二维码。

b4767991be32.source: Connect Stripe with a restricted key that can only read Payment Links. The URL content type then lists your active links with their name, price and currency, and one click encodes the link.
b4767991be32.text: 使用仅能读取支付链接的受限密钥连接 Stripe。之后在网址内容类型中，会列出你所有有效的链接及其名称、价格和币种，一键即可将链接编码为二维码。

597afc591887.source: QRdx never sees payments, customers or balances: the key has Payment Links: Read and nothing else, and test-mode keys are labeled.
597afc591887.text: QRdx 不会接触付款、客户或余额信息：该密钥只有 Payment Links: Read 权限，没有其他权限，测试模式的密钥也会有标注。

d967a024ddc5.source: Create a restricted key in Stripe
d967a024ddc5.text: 在 Stripe 中创建受限密钥

5bb0201d4cd8.source: Developers → API keys → Create restricted key. Name it QRdx, set Payment Links to Read and leave every other permission at None.
5bb0201d4cd8.text: 开发者 → API 密钥 → 创建受限密钥。命名为 QRdx，将 Payment Links 设为读取，其余所有权限保持为无。

b747a6f6373c.source: Settings → Integrations → Stripe. QRdx checks the key with one read call and stores it encrypted. Full secret keys (sk_…) are refused.
b747a6f6373c.text: 设置 → 集成 → Stripe。QRdx 会通过一次读取调用验证密钥，并加密存储。完整的私钥（sk_…）会被拒绝。

7615f0b57284.source: In the editor's URL type, open Use a link from… and choose Stripe. In Dashboard → New code, click From your account → Stripe. Then choose a link.
7615f0b57284.text: 在编辑器的网址类型中，打开“使用来自…的链接”并选择 Stripe。在控制台 → 新建二维码中，点击“来自你的账户”→ Stripe。然后选择一个链接。

5a72c461fc51.source: Name, amount and currency of every active link.
5a72c461fc51.text: 每个有效链接的名称、金额和币种。

7d32c23d7b86.source: Payment Links: Read only. Delete the key in Stripe to cut access.
7d32c23d7b86.text: 仅限 Payment Links: Read。在 Stripe 中删除该密钥即可切断访问。

9ca76d2117c3.source: Encode the link directly, or make a dynamic code you can repoint later.
9ca76d2117c3.text: 可直接对链接编码，也可生成之后能重新指向其他链接的动态二维码。

ead98a893fab.source: Search your Shopify products and make a QR code for a product page, or for all of them.
ead98a893fab.text: 搜索你的 Shopify 商品，为某个商品页面或所有商品生成二维码。

1fc67dd1b8d8.source: Connect your store with an app that has the read_products scope. The URL content type lists your active products with their image and price, and encodes each product's page on your online store (your primary domain).
1fc67dd1b8d8.text: 使用具有 read_products 权限范围的应用连接你的店铺。URL 内容类型会列出你在售的商品及其图片和价格，并对每个商品在网店（你的主域名）上的页面进行编码。

6466e662efc6.source: Need codes for the whole catalog? Download a CSV of every product in the format the bulk importer reads, and create all the dynamic codes at once.
6466e662efc6.text: 需要为整个商品目录生成二维码？下载包含所有商品的 CSV，格式与批量导入工具读取的格式一致，即可一次性创建所有动态二维码。

a48336cb1b76.source: Uses an app you create for your own store; no app store install.
a48336cb1b76.text: 使用你为自己店铺创建的应用，无需从应用商店安装。

acc6e5a9bd37.source: Create an app for your store

d24e3d38d06c.source: Shopify admin → Settings → Apps → Develop apps → Build apps in Dev Dashboard. Create an app, add the read_products scope, release it and install it on your store.
d24e3d38d06c.text: Shopify 后台 → 设置 → 应用 → 开发应用 → 在 Dev Dashboard 中构建应用。创建应用，添加 read_products 权限范围，发布并安装到你的店铺。

d015bfccf057.source: Paste the store domain and credentials

fee2d20f7f48.source: Settings → Integrations → Shopify: your store's myshopify.com domain plus the app's client ID and secret (or an Admin API access token from an older custom app). Stored encrypted.
fee2d20f7f48.text: 设置 → 集成 → Shopify：填写店铺的 myshopify.com 域名，以及应用的客户端 ID 和密钥（或旧版自定义应用的 Admin API 访问令牌）。加密存储。

94137e6b54ee.source: Pick a product, or export all

303e5aa91143.source: In the editor's URL type, open Use a link from… and choose Shopify (in Dashboard → New code, it's From your account → Shopify). Or download the product CSV and import it under Codes → Import.
303e5aa91143.text: 在编辑器的 URL 类型中，打开“使用来自……的链接”并选择 Shopify（在控制台 → 新建二维码中，路径为“来自你的账户 → Shopify”）。或者下载商品 CSV，然后在“二维码 → 导入”中导入。

60db28f94c32.source: Active products with image and price.
60db28f94c32.text: 在售商品，含图片和价格。

22756bbfb5ba.source: Your primary domain's product page; unpublished products are labeled.
22756bbfb5ba.text: 你的主域名下的商品页面；未发布的商品会有标注。

07057156d64d.source: A CSV of every product for the bulk importer.
07057156d64d.text: 包含所有商品的 CSV，供批量导入工具使用。

23f416fea32f.source: Pick a Cal.com event type and get a QR code that opens its booking page.
23f416fea32f.text: 选择一个 Cal.com 活动类型，生成可打开其预约页面的二维码。

489a10e5086d.source: Connect Cal.com with an API key and the Cal.com content type lists your event types with their length. One click encodes the booking page, so a scan goes straight to your calendar.
489a10e5086d.text: 使用 API 密钥连接 Cal.com 后，Cal.com 内容类型会列出你的活动类型及其时长。一键即可编码预约页面，扫描后直接跳转到你的日历。

c4f92ac81241.source: You can still paste any Cal.com booking link without connecting.
c4f92ac81241.text: 即使不连接，你也仍然可以粘贴任意 Cal.com 预约链接。

ee615bde752b.source: Create an API key in Cal.com
ee615bde752b.text: 在 Cal.com 中创建 API 密钥

8157067a66e6.source: Settings → Developer → API keys → Add. Copy the key; Cal.com shows it once.
8157067a66e6.text: 设置 → 开发者 → API 密钥 → 添加。复制密钥；Cal.com 只会显示一次。

3fa5bb74106f.source: Settings → Integrations → Cal.com. Stored encrypted; delete the key in Cal.com to cut access.
3fa5bb74106f.text: 设置 → 集成 → Cal.com。加密存储；在 Cal.com 中删除该密钥即可切断访问。

0e94ee76fcfc.source: In the Cal.com content type, click From your account and choose one.
0e94ee76fcfc.text: 在 Cal.com 内容类型中，点击“来自你的账户”并选择一个。

d6798bd2282f.source: Every visible event type with its length.
d6798bd2282f.text: 所有可见的活动类型及其时长。

9cd97772b753.source: The exact booking URL Cal.com gives each event type.
9cd97772b753.text: Cal.com 为每个活动类型提供的准确预约 URL。

fe347a0a24f7.source: Pick a Calendly event type and get a QR code that opens its scheduling page.
fe347a0a24f7.text: 选择一个 Calendly 活动类型，即可生成打开其预约页面的二维码。

f17cb3889d32.source: Sign in with Calendly and the URL content type lists your active event types. One click encodes the scheduling link, so people can book you from a poster, a table tent or a business card.
f17cb3889d32.text: 使用 Calendly 登录后，URL 内容类型会列出你当前可用的活动类型。只需点击一下，就能将预约链接编码进二维码，别人可以通过海报、桌牌或名片直接向你预约。

fb5f55791cb9.source: QRdx asks only to read your profile and event types.
fb5f55791cb9.text: QRdx 仅请求读取你的个人资料和活动类型。

9fdf8d865b08.source: Settings → Integrations → Calendly, then approve QRdx in Calendly (users:read and event_types:read).
9fdf8d865b08.text: 依次进入“设置 → 集成 → Calendly”，然后在 Calendly 中授权 QRdx（users:read 和 event_types:read）。

50bb3eadc60e.source: In the editor's URL type, open Use a link from… and choose Calendly. In Dashboard → New code, choose From your account → Calendly.
50bb3eadc60e.text: 在编辑器的 URL 类型中，打开“使用来自……的链接”并选择 Calendly。在“控制台 → 新建二维码”中，选择“从你的账户 → Calendly”。

1dc3b49673c6.source: Name and length of each one, with its scheduling link.
1dc3b49673c6.text: 显示每个活动类型的名称和时长，以及对应的预约链接。

d713973ff9ff.source: No bookings or invitee data. Disconnect revokes the token.
d713973ff9ff.text: 不读取预约或受邀人数据。断开连接时会撤销令牌。

a2c4e242f13d.source: Paste any YouTube link and QRdx cleans it up: videos, Shorts, playlists, channels and timestamps.
a2c4e242f13d.text: 粘贴任意 YouTube 链接，QRdx 会帮你整理干净：视频、Shorts、播放列表、频道和时间戳均可。

aa93d414a604.source: The YouTube content type recognizes youtu.be links, Shorts, live streams, embeds, YouTube Music and @handles, keeps the start time and playlist, drops tracking parameters and shows the title and thumbnail before you print.
aa93d414a604.text: YouTube 内容类型可识别 youtu.be 链接、Shorts、直播、嵌入链接、YouTube Music 和 @用户名，保留起始时间和播放列表，去除跟踪参数，并在打印前显示标题和缩略图。

91c812a14e01.source: You can also name your channel and pick one of its latest uploads.
91c812a14e01.text: 你还可以填写频道名称，并选择其最新上传的视频之一。

8fc189e25399.source: Pick the YouTube type and paste a link
8fc189e25399.text: 选择 YouTube 类型并粘贴链接

3db1b7b2843f.source: Any share link works, with or without a timestamp.
3db1b7b2843f.text: 任何分享链接都可以，无论是否带有时间戳。

ec86b9386ff7.source: QRdx shows what the link is (video, Short, playlist, channel) and its title, and offers the clean link.
ec86b9386ff7.text: QRdx 会显示链接的类型（视频、Short、播放列表、频道）及其标题，并提供整理后的干净链接。

e33ab3ce5ac2.source: youtu.be, Shorts, live, embed, nocookie and Music links.
e33ab3ce5ac2.text: youtu.be、Shorts、直播、嵌入、nocookie 和 Music 链接。

15ba2d4c4e4e.source: Start time and playlist kept, tracking removed.
15ba2d4c4e4e.text: 保留起始时间和播放列表，去除跟踪参数。

49455eb37da1.source: Title and thumbnail from YouTube's public oEmbed.
49455eb37da1.text: 标题和缩略图来自 YouTube 的公开 oEmbed。

cd8cedb5bb6a.source: Paste any Spotify link or URI and get a clean link with a cover preview.
cd8cedb5bb6a.text: 粘贴任意 Spotify 链接或 URI，即可获得简洁链接和封面预览。

57c4aae5d43a.source: The Spotify content type reads open.spotify.com links (also /intl-xx/ and embed links) and spotify: URIs for songs, albums, artists, playlists, podcasts and audiobooks, removes the ?si= tracking and previews the title and cover art.
57c4aae5d43a.text: Spotify 内容类型可识别 open.spotify.com 链接（包括 /intl-xx/ 和嵌入链接）以及 spotify: URI，支持歌曲、专辑、艺人、播放列表、播客和有声书，会去除 ?si= 跟踪参数，并预览标题和封面。

b8e018c3c610.source: You can also paste your profile link and pick one of your public playlists.
b8e018c3c610.text: 你也可以粘贴自己的主页链接，并从公开播放列表中选择一个。

43dda6415058.source: Pick the Spotify type and paste a link
43dda6415058.text: 选择 Spotify 类型并粘贴链接

ec99629c6f52.source: Use Share → Copy link in Spotify, or a spotify: URI.
ec99629c6f52.text: 在 Spotify 中使用“分享 → 复制链接”，或使用 spotify: URI。

d9a0803509ee.source: QRdx shows the kind (song, album, playlist…), the title and the cover, and offers the clean link.
d9a0803509ee.text: QRdx 会显示类型（歌曲、专辑、播放列表等）、标题和封面，并提供简洁链接。

a1d46886c204.source: Tracking parameters removed, the app opens when installed.
a1d46886c204.text: 去除跟踪参数，已安装应用时会直接打开应用。

2be14369f515.source: Title and cover art from Spotify's public oEmbed.
2be14369f515.text: 标题和封面来自 Spotify 公开的 oEmbed。

b2bcb8b92ec3.source: A styled QR code for the current tab, any link, image or selected text, one click away in Chrome.
b2bcb8b92ec3.text: 当前标签页、任意链接、图片或所选文字，都能在 Chrome 中一键生成带样式的二维码。

17453f216a2a.source: The extension shows a QR code for the page you're on. Edit the value, pick one of 12 style presets, set colors and size, then download a PNG or SVG, copy the image, or open it in QRdx.
17453f216a2a.text: 该扩展会为你当前所在的页面显示二维码。你可以修改内容，从 12 种样式预设中任选一种，设置颜色和尺寸，然后下载 PNG 或 SVG、复制图片，或在 QRdx 中打开。

9978e7fbc90a.source: Right-click a link, an image or selected text to get its QR code. Everything runs in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.
9978e7fbc90a.text: 右键点击链接、图片或所选文字，即可获得对应的二维码。一切都在浏览器中运行，不会向任何地方发送数据。

6392ab301b54.source: Add it from the Chrome Web Store
6392ab301b54.text: 从 Chrome 网上应用店添加

e13aaeca25cd.source: Open the QRdx listing in the Chrome Web Store and click Add to Chrome. It's free and needs no account.
e13aaeca25cd.text: 在 Chrome 网上应用店打开 QRdx 页面，然后点击“添加至 Chrome”。免费使用，无需账号。

bc9b39e0207c.source: Pin it from the puzzle-piece menu, then click its icon on any page.
bc9b39e0207c.text: 通过拼图图标菜单将其固定，然后在任意页面点击它的图标。

73b5dfe31358.source: Current tab or anything you right-click
73b5dfe31358.text: 当前标签页或任何右键点击的内容

3565577aea4a.source: Links, images and selected text from the context menu.
3565577aea4a.text: 可通过右键菜单处理链接、图片和所选文字。

e7b7f1961935.source: The playground's styles, with your own colors and 256–2048 px exports.
e7b7f1961935.text: 沿用 Playground 的样式，可自定义颜色，并支持 256–2048 px 导出。

d15652ef8118.source: Download either format, copy the image, or open it in QRdx.
d15652ef8118.text: 可下载任一格式、复制图片，或在 QRdx 中打开。

89fae4817360.source: Only activeTab, contextMenus and storage permissions; runs entirely in the browser.
89fae4817360.text: 仅需 activeTab、contextMenus 和 storage 权限，完全在浏览器中运行。

0347b2ff2691.source: Insert styled QR codes into Figma as editable vector layers, and update them in place.
0347b2ff2691.text: 将样式丰富的二维码作为可编辑的矢量图层插入 Figma，并支持原位更新。

0e04e606ae16.source: Enter a URL or text, pick a style preset, colors and size, and the plugin inserts the QR code as vector layers at the center of your viewport. It stays sharp at any zoom.
0e04e606ae16.text: 输入网址或文本，选择样式预设、颜色和尺寸，插件就会把二维码以矢量图层的形式插入视口中央。无论如何缩放，都保持清晰。

9a00e7e8e882.source: Select a code you inserted earlier to replace it while keeping its size, position and rotation, or reopen it with the Edit QR code button in Figma's right panel. The plugin has no network access.
9a00e7e8e882.text: 选中之前插入的二维码即可替换，并保留其大小、位置和旋转角度；也可以通过 Figma 右侧面板中的“编辑二维码”按钮重新打开。该插件没有网络访问权限。

8299d5e3bb18.source: Not in Figma Community yet. Import it from source.
8299d5e3bb18.text: 尚未上架 Figma Community，请从源码导入。

0a8a9dc4d4bf.source: Import it in the Figma desktop app
0a8a9dc4d4bf.text: 在 Figma 桌面应用中导入

13c6d0f68541.source: Open a design file, then Plugins → Development → Import plugin from manifest… and select plugins/figma/manifest.json.
13c6d0f68541.text: 打开一个设计文件，然后依次选择“插件 → 开发 → 从清单导入插件…”，并选择 plugins/figma/manifest.json。

5f168bad0369.source: Codes are editable vectors that stay sharp at any size.
5f168bad0369.text: 二维码是可编辑的矢量图形，任何尺寸下都保持清晰。

81c17e9e154f.source: Swap a selected code and keep its size, position, rotation and constraints.
81c17e9e154f.text: 替换选中的二维码，并保留其大小、位置、旋转角度和约束。

3209550df881.source: Each code remembers its content and style behind an Edit QR code button.
3209550df881.text: 每个二维码都会在“编辑二维码”按钮背后记住它的内容和样式。

c66e62b5bd12.source: No network access. Its playground link carries only a web address.
c66e62b5bd12.text: 无网络访问权限。其 Playground 链接仅包含一个网址。

465ca54392f5.source: Generate, save and export customized QR codes from Raycast, or describe one to Raycast AI.
465ca54392f5.text: 在 Raycast 中生成、保存并导出自定义二维码，也可以向 Raycast AI 描述你想要的二维码。

97f0bae06b2e.source: Generate QR codes with body patterns, corner styles, colors, templates and logos from the Raycast launcher, keep a library of saved codes, and export them.
97f0bae06b2e.text: 在 Raycast 启动器中生成带有主体图案、定位角样式、颜色、模板和 Logo 的二维码，保存二维码库并随时导出。

cec6cdb6b996.source: Generate QR with AI turns a plain-English description into settings, and Raycast AI can call the extension's tools directly.
cec6cdb6b996.text: Generate QR with AI 可以把一段简单的英文描述转换为设置，Raycast AI 也可以直接调用该扩展的工具。

44537c685949.source: Not in the Raycast Store yet. Install it from source.
44537c685949.text: 尚未上架 Raycast Store，请从源码安装。

d10bb2e1b4c1.source: Install it as a development extension

72374988eef7.source: With Raycast installed, run this and Raycast imports the extension.
72374988eef7.text: 已安装 Raycast 的情况下，运行以下命令，Raycast 会导入该扩展。

9af1727da193.source: Search for Generate QR, Saved QR Codes or Generate QR with AI.
9af1727da193.text: 搜索 Generate QR、Saved QR Codes 或 Generate QR with AI。

d9bbc2449c00.source: Body patterns, corner styles, colors, templates and logos.
d9bbc2449c00.text: 主体图案、定位角样式、颜色、模板和 Logo。

03a50dcd8c2f.source: Browse, preview, edit and export saved configurations.
03a50dcd8c2f.text: 浏览、预览、编辑并导出已保存的配置。

173fabd368a8.source: Describe the code in plain English and Raycast AI sets it up.
173fabd368a8.text: 用英文描述二维码，Raycast AI 会为你完成设置。

e25be3f05245.source: Style a QR code in a Canva side panel and add it to your design in one click.
e25be3f05245.text: 在 Canva 侧边栏中设计二维码样式，一键添加到你的设计中。

d0d10e8c9d03.source: Enter a URL or text, then pick a template, dot, eye and eye-dot patterns, colors from Canva's color picker, error correction and an optional logo. The preview updates as you go.
d0d10e8c9d03.text: 输入网址或文本，然后选择模板、点阵、定位眼和眼点图案，使用 Canva 取色器选择颜色，设置纠错级别，还可以添加 Logo。预览会随你的操作实时更新。

923a9e672ee5.source: Add to Design places the code on your page as a 1024 px PNG with alt text.
923a9e672ee5.text: “Add to Design”会将二维码以 1024 px 的 PNG 图片放置到你的页面上，并附带替代文字。

aa6a3185091f.source: Not in the Canva Apps Marketplace yet. Run it from source.
aa6a3185091f.text: 尚未上架 Canva Apps Marketplace，请从源码运行。

83bd44f72080.source: This serves the app at http://localhost:8080.

9c628ae9a771.source: Create an app in the Canva Developer Portal
9c628ae9a771.text: 在 Canva Developer Portal 中创建应用

e19ba6611b7a.source: At canva.com/developers/apps, create an app and set its Development URL to http://localhost:8080.
e19ba6611b7a.text: 在 canva.com/developers/apps 创建一个应用，并将其 Development URL 设置为 http://localhost:8080。

4e23f3242fb4.source: Click Preview: the Canva editor opens with QRdx in the side panel.
4e23f3242fb4.text: 点击 Preview：Canva 编辑器会打开，QRdx 就在侧边栏中。

6ade53fc92db.source: The code redraws as you change its content or style.
6ade53fc92db.text: 修改内容或样式时，二维码会随之重新绘制。

aa722a07cfa6.source: Frame templates and body, eye and eye-dot shapes, each shown as a thumbnail.
aa722a07cfa6.text: 边框模板，以及码身、定位眼和眼点形状，均以缩略图展示。

7961b765c7e2.source: Foreground, background, eye and dot colors from Canva's color picker.
7961b765c7e2.text: 前景色、背景色、定位眼和点阵颜色均来自 Canva 取色器。

eb3dabf38b95.source: A 1024 px PNG with alt text, placed on your page.
eb3dabf38b95.text: 一张带替代文字的 1024 px PNG 图片，直接放置到你的页面上。

376c5fc48f7f.source: Create, update and archive dynamic codes and read their scans from your own code.
376c5fc48f7f.text: 通过你自己的代码创建、更新和归档动态二维码，并读取它们的扫描数据。

6d9648ee71e7.source: The codes API under /api/v1/codes lists, creates (one or up to 100 at a time), updates and deletes dynamic codes, and returns scan analytics for any range your plan includes.
6d9648ee71e7.text: /api/v1/codes 下的 codes API 可以列出、创建（一次一个，最多 100 个）、更新和删除动态二维码，并返回你的套餐所包含的任意时间范围内的扫描分析数据。

3514b906ee98.source: Requests use an OAuth access token with the codes:read or codes:write scope and act on your own workspace. Errors share one JSON shape.
3514b906ee98.text: 请求使用带有 codes:read 或 codes:write 权限范围的 OAuth 访问令牌，并作用于你自己的工作区。所有错误都采用同一种 JSON 格式。

296880b10fc2.source: Authorize your app with QRdx OAuth and request the codes:read and codes:write scopes.
296880b10fc2.text: 通过 QRdx OAuth 授权你的应用，并申请 codes:read 和 codes:write 权限范围。

be5419e13779.source: Put the response's shortLink in your QR code, for example with the qrdx React library. Change destinationUrl later with PATCH and the printed code follows.
be5419e13779.text: 把响应中的 shortLink 放进你的二维码，例如使用 qrdx React 库。之后用 PATCH 修改 destinationUrl，已印刷的二维码会随之指向新地址。

a31e96c6a0d0.source: List, create, update (destination, title, style, domain) and delete.
a31e96c6a0d0.text: 列出、创建、更新（目标地址、标题、样式、域名）和删除。

cf81504f5c72.source: Up to 100 codes per request on Pro and Business.
cf81504f5c72.text: Pro 和 Business 每次请求最多 100 个二维码。

80ee1ee9c993.source: Totals and individual scans per code, limited by your plan's history.
80ee1ee9c993.text: 提供每个二维码的扫描总数和单次扫描记录，受套餐历史数据范围限制。

8b7f435b254e.source: 1,000 requests a day on Free, 10,000 on Pro and 100,000 on Business.
8b7f435b254e.text: 免费版每天 1,000 次请求，Pro 为 10,000 次，Business 为 100,000 次。

54e63d6cd916.source: Turn any URL into a QR code image for Markdown, HTML or email. No account or key.
54e63d6cd916.text: 将任意 URL 转为二维码图片，可用于 Markdown、HTML 或电子邮件。无需账号或密钥。

be68f5861080.source: GET /api/v1/qr returns an SVG, PNG or print-ready EPS. Everything is in the query string, so the URL itself is the image: paste it into a README, an tag or an email template.
be68f5861080.text: GET /api/v1/qr 会返回 SVG、PNG 或可直接印刷的 EPS。所有参数都在查询字符串中，因此 URL 本身就是图片：可以直接粘贴到 README、 标签或邮件模板中。

2a2623546424.source: Choose size, colors, module and corner shapes, error correction, margin and frame templates.
2a2623546424.text: 可选择尺寸、颜色、模块和边角形状、纠错等级、边距以及边框模板。

3da620d184f1.source: URL-encode data when it contains &, #, + or spaces, for example with encodeURIComponent.
3da620d184f1.text: 当 data 包含 &、#、+ 或空格时，请对其进行 URL 编码，例如使用 encodeURIComponent。

0243f8509fce.source: Vector EPS sized in points for print and design tools.
0243f8509fce.text: 以点为单位的矢量 EPS，适用于印刷和设计工具。

c55ce845d7a2.source: Colors, module and corner shapes, error correction, margin and frames.
c55ce845d7a2.text: 颜色、模块和边角形状、纠错等级、边距和边框。

1f965d2cc48c.source: The same URL always returns the same image.
1f965d2cc48c.text: 相同的 URL 始终返回相同的图片。

a59c27572b44.source: Generate styled SVG or PNG QR codes from the terminal or in CI with @qrdx/cli.
a59c27572b44.text: 通过 @qrdx/cli，在终端或 CI 中生成带样式的 SVG 或 PNG 二维码。

c48cd9a5247f.source: Run npx @qrdx/cli to render a QR code with the same patterns, colors, gradients, logos, templates and frames as the playground. Flags make it fully non-interactive for scripts and CI; in a terminal it can guide you with prompts.
c48cd9a5247f.text: 运行 npx @qrdx/cli，即可生成与 Playground 相同的图案、颜色、渐变、Logo、模板和边框的二维码。通过参数可完全非交互地用于脚本和 CI；在终端中也可以通过提示逐步引导你完成。

11f7baa1ee60.source: npm install -g @qrdx/cli gives you the qrdx command.
11f7baa1ee60.text: npm install -g @qrdx/cli 会为你提供 qrdx 命令。

5f0b4ad0a616.source: The output file's extension sets the format.
5f0b4ad0a616.text: 输出文件的扩展名决定格式。

6937dcc8d9d1.source: Patterns, colors and gradients, logos, templates and call-to-action frames.
6937dcc8d9d1.text: 图案、颜色和渐变、Logo、模板以及行动号召边框。

8bdc44f04d35.source: Non-interactive with flags; invalid values exit with code 1 and list the accepted ones.
8bdc44f04d35.text: 通过参数实现非交互运行；传入无效值时会以代码 1 退出，并列出可接受的值。

389b132bfbdb.source: Render customizable QR codes in React with qrdx: patterns, gradients, logos and templates.
389b132bfbdb.text: 使用 qrdx 在 React 中渲染可自定义的二维码：图案、渐变、徽标和模板。

5f38dba094b3.source: qrdx is the open-source library behind QRdx. Render QR codes as SVG or canvas with custom body patterns, corner eyes, gradients, logos and frame templates, and export them as images.
5f38dba094b3.text: qrdx 是 QRdx 背后的开源库。可将二维码渲染为 SVG 或 canvas，支持自定义主体图案、定位点、渐变、徽标和边框模板，并可导出为图片。

7e14cc035ccd.source: react and react-dom 18 or newer are peer dependencies.
7e14cc035ccd.text: react 和 react-dom 需为 18 或更高版本（peer 依赖）。

da38454a3189.text: 提供 QRCode、QRCodeSVG 和 QRCodeCanvas 组件。

338d05064262.source: Body patterns, corner eyes and dots, gradients, logos and templates.
338d05064262.text: 支持主体图案、定位点和圆点、渐变、徽标及模板。

3af18b92d8c5.source: The same renderer as the QRdx playground.
3af18b92d8c5.text: 与 QRdx Playground 使用同一个渲染器。

4d100b965fdb.source: Add QR code components (codes, cards, downloads, share dialogs, a generator and a scanner) to a shadcn/ui project.
4d100b965fdb.text: 为 shadcn/ui 项目添加二维码组件（二维码、卡片、下载、分享对话框、生成器和扫描器）。

814f45a55946.source: The QRdx registry has eight components built on qrdx. The shadcn CLI copies their source into your project, so you own the code.
814f45a55946.text: QRdx 注册表提供八个基于 qrdx 构建的组件。shadcn CLI 会把它们的源码复制到你的项目中，代码完全归你所有。

c4306aa8f6ab.source: They cover a styled QR code with downloads, a framed card, a download menu, a share dialog, a live generator, an in-browser scanner, and Wi-Fi and contact codes. Each has a docs page with a live preview, install steps and examples.
c4306aa8f6ab.text: 组件涵盖带下载功能的样式化二维码、带边框的卡片、下载菜单、分享对话框、实时生成器、浏览器内扫描器，以及 Wi-Fi 和联系人二维码。每个组件都有文档页面，包含实时预览、安装步骤和示例。

170ee109f950.source: Command copied — run it in your project
170ee109f950.text: 命令已复制，请在你的项目中运行

03cb69442276.source: This adds components/qr-code.tsx and installs qrdx.
03cb69442276.text: 这会添加 components/qr-code.tsx 并安装 qrdx。

61c832d92986.source: Source is copied into your project, ready to change.
61c832d92986.text: 源码会复制到你的项目中，可随意修改。

fe1dc71f181b.source: PNG and SVG download buttons with an accessible SVG.
fe1dc71f181b.text: 提供 PNG 和 SVG 下载按钮，SVG 支持无障碍访问。

5b2707e337c2.source: Decode QR codes from uploaded images in the browser.
5b2707e337c2.text: 在浏览器中解码上传图片里的二维码。

d10512bb7fa3.source: Desktop app for macOS and Windows
d10512bb7fa3.text: 适用于 macOS 和 Windows 的桌面应用

772b315ea189.source: /qr, mentions, direct messages and a message shortcut, plus tracked codes.
772b315ea189.text: 支持 /qr、提及、私信和消息快捷操作，另可生成带追踪的二维码。

a5b23b7333ff.source: Message the bot, call it inline in any chat, or use /qr in a group.
a5b23b7333ff.text: 可直接给机器人发消息，在任意聊天中以内联方式调用，或在群组中使用 /qr。

b07522721ba1.source: /qr and Make QR code, in servers, DMs and group DMs.
b07522721ba1.text: 支持 /qr 和 Make QR code，可用于服务器、私信和群组私信。

66077a227143.source: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the open standard that lets AI assistants use outside tools. Connect QRdx once, ask for a QR code in plain words, and get the image back in the chat.
66077a227143.text: MCP（Model Context Protocol）是让 AI 助手使用外部工具的开放标准。只需连接一次 QRdx，用日常的话说出想要的二维码，图片就会直接返回到聊天中。
