a6f01d2a53d1.source: One command or a few lines of config in Claude, Cursor, VS Code or any other MCP app. No account or API key.
a6f01d2a53d1.text: 在 Claude、Cursor、VS Code 或任何其他 MCP 应用中，只需一条命令或几行配置。无需账号或 API 密钥。

2daffec00b4d.source: In plain words: the link or details to encode, colors and shape. It picks the right QRdx tool.
2daffec00b4d.text: 用日常的话描述：要编码的链接或信息、颜色和形状。助手会选择合适的 QRdx 工具。

a1c4d8f4a8f2.source: A PNG image in the chat, plus SVG, PNG, WebP and EPS links ready for Markdown, HTML or print. Apps that support MCP Apps also show the code as a card you can save or open in the editor.
a1c4d8f4a8f2.text: 聊天中会返回一张 PNG 图片，另有 SVG、PNG、WebP 和 EPS 链接，可直接用于 Markdown、HTML 或印刷。支持 MCP Apps 的应用还会把二维码显示为卡片，你可以保存，或在编辑器中打开。

f58610704fe0.source: Any content type (link, Wi-Fi, contact, payment, social and more) with the style your assistant picks: colours and gradients, shapes, a frame with its text or a community frame, a border, a logo icon. Can start from a built-in theme or a community item. Validates the content like the editor, checks the scan score and repairs the style until it is Great. Returns the score, what changed, the style JSON, a playground link, a PNG and the SVG.
f58610704fe0.text: 支持任何内容类型（链接、Wi-Fi、联系人、支付、社交等），样式由助手选择：颜色和渐变、形状、带文字的边框或社区边框、描边、Logo 图标。可以从内置主题或社区项目开始。像编辑器一样校验内容，检查扫描评分，并修复样式直到评分为 Great。返回评分、改动内容、样式 JSON、Playground 链接、一张 PNG 和 SVG。

256903128f5e.source: Every value design_qr accepts: content types and their fields, shapes, frames, borders, logo icons, built-in themes, error correction levels and limits.
256903128f5e.text: design_qr 接受的所有取值：内容类型及其字段、形状、边框、描边、Logo 图标、内置主题、纠错等级和限制。

a507c2437064.source: Renders the code and returns a PNG image plus public SVG, PNG, WebP and EPS image URLs ready for Markdown or HTML. Takes the image API options: colors or gradients, body, eye and dot shapes, error correction, margin, a border, a frame and a logo icon, or a whole style from design_qr. Set include_svg for the SVG markup.
a507c2437064.text: 渲染二维码，返回一张 PNG 图片，以及可直接用于 Markdown 或 HTML 的公开 SVG、PNG、WebP 和 EPS 图片链接。支持 Image API 的选项：颜色或渐变、主体、码眼和圆点形状、纠错、边距、描边、边框和 Logo 图标，也可以使用来自 design_qr 的完整样式。设置 include_svg 可获得 SVG 标记。

6834f5cf57aa.source: Finds community frames and themes, free under CC0, by words, type or tag. Item text is written by members and comes back short, without links.
6834f5cf57aa.text: 按关键词、类型或标签查找社区边框和主题，均以 CC0 免费提供。项目文字由成员撰写，返回时会被精简，且不含链接。

c2e6ca9f32b5.source: One frame or theme with the style it applies, ready to pass to design_qr or generate_qr_code.
c2e6ca9f32b5.text: 一个边框或主题及其应用的样式，可直接传给 design_qr 或 generate_qr_code。

35f9a7f12b6f.source: Saves a design as a theme in your workspace, under the plan's saved-theme limit. Needs a QRdx API key on the connection; every other tool works without one.
35f9a7f12b6f.text: 将设计作为主题保存到你的工作区，受当前套餐已保存主题数量的限制。连接中需要 QRdx API 密钥；其他所有工具无需密钥即可使用。

018b7893a107.source: EAN-13, UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-8, ITF-14, GS1-128, Code 128, Code 39, Data Matrix, PDF417 or Aztec. Checks the value (check digits, lengths, characters) and returns a PNG plus public SVG, PNG, PDF and other image URLs.
018b7893a107.text: EAN-13、UPC-A、UPC-E、EAN-8、ITF-14、GS1-128、Code 128、Code 39、Data Matrix、PDF417 或 Aztec。校验数值（校验位、长度、字符），返回一张 PNG，以及公开的 SVG、PNG、PDF 等图片链接。

88506c9a05c5.source: Keeps a barcode in your workspace's Barcodes to edit and download later. Needs a QRdx API key on the connection.
88506c9a05c5.text: 将条形码保存到工作区的“条形码”中，方便日后编辑和下载。连接中需要 QRdx API 密钥。

be0229246e65.source: Body patterns, corner eye and eye dot shapes, frame templates, error correction levels, defaults and limits.
be0229246e65.text: 主体图案、角码眼和码眼圆点形状、边框模板、纠错等级、默认值和限制。

13d7414fe8cb.source: A WIFI: payload (WPA, WEP or open, optionally hidden) with special characters escaped.
13d7414fe8cb.text: WIFI: 载荷（WPA、WEP 或开放网络，可选隐藏），并对特殊字符进行转义。

35a90e148646.source: A vCard 3.0 contact: name, organization, title, phones, email, website, address and note.
35a90e148646.text: vCard 3.0 联系人：姓名、单位、职位、电话、邮箱、网站、地址和备注。

61964d1b5f82.source: A mailto: link with optional cc, bcc, subject and body.
61964d1b5f82.text: mailto: 链接，可选抄送、密送、主题和正文。

32f3122a67d4.source: An sms: link with an optional message, or the older SMSTO: form.
32f3122a67d4.text: sms: 链接，可附带消息，也可使用较旧的 SMSTO: 格式。

22a6188ed915.source: A geo: location from latitude and longitude.
22a6188ed915.text: 根据纬度和经度生成 geo: 位置。

1385eac80167.source: Do I need an account or an API key?
1385eac80167.text: 我需要账号或 API 密钥吗？

f538f592cdab.source: No, for designing and rendering codes and browsing the community: the QRdx MCP server is public and free, and it keeps no session state. Saving a design to your themes (save_template), saving a barcode (save_barcode) and using a logo you uploaded need a QRdx API key, sent as Authorization: Bearer qrdx_… in your app's settings for the server.
f538f592cdab.text: 设计、生成二维码和浏览社区内容不需要：QRdx MCP 服务器公开且免费，也不保存会话状态。将设计保存到你的主题（save_template）、保存条形码（save_barcode）以及使用你上传的 Logo，则需要 QRdx API 密钥，并在应用中该服务器的设置里以 Authorization: Bearer qrdx_… 的形式发送。

d13545262ca7.source: Which AI tools does it work with?
d13545262ca7.text: 它支持哪些 AI 工具？

21d38422b406.source: Any MCP app that supports remote servers over Streamable HTTP, such as Claude, ChatGPT (as a custom MCP server, where your plan allows it), Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf), Gemini CLI and Codex. Apps that only run local stdio servers can connect through the mcp-remote bridge.
21d38422b406.text: 任何支持通过 Streamable HTTP 连接远程服务器的 MCP 应用都可以使用，例如 Claude、ChatGPT（作为自定义 MCP 服务器，需所在套餐支持）、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code、Devin Desktop（原 Windsurf）、Gemini CLI 和 Codex。只能运行本地 stdio 服务器的应用，可以通过 mcp-remote 桥接连接。

7b6f0071dd58.source: Can it add logos or gradients?
7b6f0071dd58.text: 可以添加 Logo 或渐变吗？

9aae8c31adb9.source: Yes. Linear and radial gradients, frames and borders work without a key, and so do the quick logo icons (Wi-Fi, link, phone and others). A logo you uploaded to QRdx works by its file id with your API key. QRdx never fetches a logo from a web address. Logo QR and Image QR art are made in the playground.
9aae8c31adb9.text: 可以。线性渐变和径向渐变、边框和外框无需密钥即可使用，快捷 Logo 图标（Wi-Fi、链接、电话等）也一样。你上传到 QRdx 的 Logo，可凭文件 ID 配合你的 API 密钥使用。QRdx 绝不会从网址获取 Logo。Logo QR 和 Image QR 艺术码需在 Playground 中制作。

eb8611405036.source: Can it create dynamic QR codes?
eb8611405036.text: 可以创建动态二维码吗？

142c39e85294.source: No. The MCP tools render static QR codes and format payloads. Dynamic codes, whose destination you can change later, are created in the QRdx dashboard or with the REST API.
142c39e85294.text: 不可以。MCP 工具生成的是静态二维码，并负责格式化内容。目标可以日后更改的动态二维码，需要在 QRdx 控制台或通过 REST API 创建。

4522fedddff3.source: Does the code show up in the chat?
4522fedddff3.text: 二维码会显示在聊天中吗？

6524470caca3.source: design_qr and generate_qr_code return the code as a PNG image, so apps that display images show it in the chat. Apps that support MCP Apps also show a QR card: the code, what it encodes (for Wi-Fi, the network name, never the password), its size or scan score, an Open in editor button, and PNG and SVG buttons where the app can save or open them. Apps without MCP Apps get the same text and image as before.
6524470caca3.text: design_qr 和 generate_qr_code 会以 PNG 图片返回二维码，所以支持显示图片的应用会直接在聊天中展示。支持 MCP Apps 的应用还会显示二维码卡片：二维码、其编码内容（Wi-Fi 只显示网络名称，绝不显示密码）、尺寸或扫描评分、“在编辑器中打开”按钮，以及应用可保存或打开时的 PNG 和 SVG 按钮。不支持 MCP Apps 的应用，则和之前一样显示文字和图片。

3862376c7e81.source: Does QRdx store the codes I generate?
3862376c7e81.text: QRdx 会保存我生成的二维码吗？

9ccc8cb2303b.source: No. The tools render images, format text and read the public community. Only save_template and save_barcode write anything: the theme or barcode you ask them to save, in the API key's workspace. The server doesn't save the codes. The image URLs it returns contain the encoded data, so don't share them if the data is private, such as a Wi-Fi password.
9ccc8cb2303b.text: 不会。这些工具只负责生成图片、格式化文本和读取公开社区内容。只有 save_template 和 save_barcode 会写入数据：即你要求保存的主题或条形码，保存在该 API 密钥所属的工作区中。服务器不会保存二维码本身。它返回的图片 URL 包含编码的数据，因此如果数据属于隐私内容（例如 Wi-Fi 密码），请不要分享这些 URL。

b0fa61113848.source: Requests are limited to 120 per minute per IP address, and design_qr to 20. Calls with an API key also count toward the workspace's daily API quota. Very long data may not fit in a QR code; the tool then returns an error suggesting a lower error correction level.
b0fa61113848.text: 每个 IP 地址每分钟最多 120 次请求，其中 design_qr 最多 20 次。使用 API 密钥的调用，也会计入工作区的每日 API 配额。过长的数据可能无法放进二维码；此时工具会返回错误，并建议降低纠错级别。

fc6bc91ce6c8.source: Yes. The MCP server is part of the QRdx web app, so a self-hosted instance serves it at /api/mcp on your own domain.
fc6bc91ce6c8.text: 可以。MCP 服务器是 QRdx 网页应用的一部分，因此自托管的实例会在你自己域名下的 /api/mcp 提供该服务。

7c269c1edcf4.source: QRdx decodes every image on the server. If the model's version doesn't scan, QRdx strengthens its corner eyes, border and modules only as much as it takes, redrawing it as Image QR only as a last resort, and nothing that fails is delivered or charged.
7c269c1edcf4.text: QRdx 会在服务器上解码每一张图片。如果模型生成的版本无法扫描，QRdx 只会在必要的范围内加强其角上的定位点、边框和模块，仅在万不得已时才将其重绘为 Image QR，未通过验证的图片不会交付，也不会扣费。

821019a182d1.source: Download SVG, PDF or EPS that stays sharp at any print size, and test it with a phone camera.

75553b2b8482.source: Will the QR art actually scan?
75553b2b8482.text: 二维码艺术图真的能扫描吗？

447883ded94b.source: Every image you receive has been decoded back to your exact content on our server, both as it is and through a simulated phone camera (smaller, blurred and lower in contrast). The model starts from a QR code with the highest error correction level (H) and is told to keep its grid. If its image doesn't pass, QRdx strengthens the corner eyes, the border and then the modules of that image only as far as it takes to scan, and redraws it as an Image QR code only as a last resort. An image that still fails isn't delivered and uses no credit. Your browser then scores each variation and picks the best. Still test the final image with a phone camera before printing it.
447883ded94b.text: 你收到的每张图片，都已在我们的服务器上解码并还原为你的确切内容，既按原图解码，也通过模拟手机摄像头（更小、模糊、对比度更低）解码。模型从最高纠错级别（H）的二维码出发，并被要求保留其网格。如果图片未通过验证，QRdx 只会在能够扫描的必要范围内加强该图片的角上定位点、边框，然后是模块，仅在万不得已时才将其重绘为 Image QR 二维码。仍然失败的图片不会交付，也不占用额度。随后你的浏览器会为每个变体打分并选出最佳的一张。打印前，仍请用手机摄像头测试最终图片。

6d178c8df156.source: How many images can I make?
6d178c8df156.text: 我可以生成多少张图片？

8ff8809a8fda.source: Each delivered image uses one AI art credit; the print-size download is free. Free accounts get 3 credits a month, Pro 30 and Business 150, shared by everyone in the team. Credits reset on the first of each month (UTC), and there is also a safety limit of 25 images per person per day. If a generation fails or doesn't pass the scan check, no credit is used.
8ff8809a8fda.text: 每张交付的图片使用 1 个 AI 艺术图额度，下载打印尺寸图片免费。免费版账户每月 3 个额度，Pro 为 30 个，Business 为 150 个，由团队所有成员共用。额度在每月 1 日（UTC）重置，另有每人每天 25 张图片的安全上限。如果生成失败或未通过扫描检查，不会使用额度。

62fd234e6010.source: Yes. Each image is a paid call to OpenAI's GPT Image 2, so you need to sign in. AI art credits are separate from AI theme generation.
62fd234e6010.text: 需要。每张图片都是对 OpenAI 的 GPT Image 2 的一次付费调用，因此你需要登录。AI 艺术图额度与 AI 主题生成的额度是分开的。

e31813ec0367.source: No. The content is part of the artwork, so AI art codes are static. For a destination you can edit later, with scan analytics, create a dynamic code in your dashboard and use its short link as the content of your AI art code.
e31813ec0367.text: 不能。内容是画面的一部分，因此 AI 艺术二维码是静态二维码。如果你想要之后可以修改的目标地址，并查看扫描分析，请在控制台中创建动态二维码，并把它的短链接作为 AI 艺术二维码的内容。

053d7e10ac84.source: What do QR visibility and creativity do?
053d7e10ac84.text: 二维码可见度和创意度有什么作用？

0de9123d88e2.source: QR visibility sets how strongly the model is asked to favor the code: higher keeps the modules close to black and white, lower lets the scene's light and shadow form them. It also sets how far QRdx may change the image to make it scan. At 50 and below, an image that scans is delivered as it is; otherwise QRdx strengthens the corner eyes and the border, then the modules, only as far as needed. Below 50 it stops sooner rather than cover the scene, so a run can fail (using no credit). Above 50 the code is strengthened even when the image already scans. Creativity sets how freely the model interprets your prompt: lower follows your words closely, higher improvises.
0de9123d88e2.text: 二维码可见度决定模型在多大程度上偏重二维码：数值越高，模块越接近纯黑白；数值越低，模块越多由场景的光影形成。它还决定 QRdx 为了让图片可扫描，最多可以在多大程度上改动图片。数值在 50 及以下时，能扫描的图片会原样交付；否则 QRdx 只会在必要的范围内加强角上的定位点和边框，然后是模块。低于 50 时，QRdx 宁可更早停止也不会遮盖场景，因此一次生成可能失败（不占用额度）。高于 50 时，即使图片本身已能扫描，也会加强二维码。创意度决定模型对你的提示词的自由发挥程度：越低越贴近你的文字，越高越随性发挥。

ebde72c4d152.source: Each run makes 1 to 4 variations, each its own image and credit. GPT Image 2 doesn't take a seed, so the same prompt and settings give a different image every time: download the ones you want to keep.
ebde72c4d152.text: 每次运行会生成 1 到 4 个变体，每个变体都是独立的图片，各占一个额度。GPT Image 2 不支持种子，所以相同的提示词和设置每次都会得到不同的图片：请下载你想保留的图片。

ef1d0068e74b.source: What does the reference image do?

2c1c1f108888.source: It's sent to the model next to the QR code, so its colors, shapes or logo can carry over into the artwork. It's resized to 512 pixels in your browser first. Only images you upload are accepted, never links.
2c1c1f108888.text: 它会和二维码一起发送给模型，因此它的颜色、形状或标志可以融入画面。它会先在你的浏览器中缩放到 512 像素。只接受你上传的图片，不接受链接。

27ddba8236f9.source: Images are 1024 × 1024 pixels, about 8.7 cm (3.4 in) at 300 dpi. The print-size download is 2048 × 2048 pixels, resampled in your browser and checked to scan again before it saves, for about 17 cm (6.8 in) at 300 dpi. It doesn't add detail. For any size, the vector Logo QR and Image QR modes in the playground export SVG, PDF and EPS.
27ddba8236f9.text: 图片为 1024 × 1024 像素，300 dpi 下约 8.7 厘米（3.4 英寸）。打印尺寸的下载文件为 2048 × 2048 像素，在你的浏览器中重新采样，并在保存前再次检查可扫描性，300 dpi 下约 17 厘米（6.8 英寸）。它不会增加细节。若需要任意尺寸，可使用 Playground 中的矢量 Logo QR 和 Image QR 模式，导出 SVG、PDF 和 EPS。

7834fde94ef7.source: Any link or text up to 300 characters. Shorter content produces fewer, larger modules, which gives cleaner artwork and more reliable scans.
7834fde94ef7.text: 任何不超过 300 个字符的链接或文本。内容越短，模块越少也越大，画面更干净，扫描也更可靠。

2411f5b0953c.text: 使用的是哪个 AI 模型？

828fb382c058.source: OpenAI's GPT Image 2, through Vercel AI Gateway, with 39 style presets. QRdx draws a plain black-and-white QR code on the server, the model repaints it as your scene, and QRdx's own scan check makes sure the result decodes, strengthening the code only as much as it needs.
828fb382c058.text: 使用的是 OpenAI 的 GPT Image 2，通过 Vercel AI Gateway 调用，提供 39 种风格预设。QRdx 先在服务器上绘制一个普通的黑白二维码，模型将它重绘为你描述的场景，再由 QRdx 自带的扫描检测确认结果可以被解码，并且只在必要时才加强二维码。

d054c5dbcf04.source: Does QRdx store my prompt or image?
d054c5dbcf04.text: QRdx 会保存我的提示词或图片吗？

c39a25bf842f.source: QRdx doesn't save your prompt, reference image or the generated images; it only counts your credits. The prompt, the QR code image and any reference image are sent through Vercel AI Gateway to OpenAI's GPT Image 2 to create the artwork, and the result comes straight back to your browser, so download the ones you want to keep.
c39a25bf842f.text: QRdx 不会保存你的提示词、参考图片或生成的图片，只会统计你的额度用量。提示词、二维码图片和所有参考图片会通过 Vercel AI Gateway 发送给 OpenAI 的 GPT Image 2 以生成作品，结果会直接返回到你的浏览器，因此请下载你想保留的图片。
